For remote workers and freelancers established a single rate of personal income tax
MOSCOW, July 21 — RIA Novosti.
The State Duma adopted a law that establishes a single personal income tax rate of 13-15% for employees working for Russian organizations remotely both in Russia and abroad.
The document introduces comprehensive amendments to the Tax Code in order to implement certain provisions of the main directions of tax policy.
In particular, it determines the procedure for taxation of income of employees who work remotely under labor contracts or under civil law contracts for Russian organizations.
The personal income tax rate for them is set at a standard rate of 13% (for incomes over 5 million rubles per year - 15%), regardless of the status of their tax residence.
Clarification of the types of income of remote employees and the application of a single rate will significantly simplify the administration of personal income tax for tax agents, explained Deputy Minister of Finance of the Russian Federation Alexei Sazanov.
Now, if a taxpayer works with a Russian organization, it is a tax agent and must determine the personal income tax rate depending on each specific situation.
However, when an employee works remotely, it is difficult for companies to check whether he is a Russian tax resident.
Therefore, the rules of taxation of such employees decided to unify, explained the Deputy Minister.
With regard to the income of full-time employees, these rules will come into force from 2024, and freelancers from 2025.
In addition, the law provides for the provision of a standard tax deduction on personal income tax to parents whose children or wards are recognized as incapable.
At the same time, the procedure for obtaining social tax deductions for personal income tax is simplified.
Organizations that provided the service will be able to independently transfer to the tax service the information necessary for citizens to receive such a deduction.
The same individuals for its receipt will be enough to send an application to the tax office at the place of residence.
The law, which contains other norms, comes into force from the date of official publication, except for the provisions for which other terms are established.

About 40% of working remotely Russians between forced return to the office and dismissal will choose the second.

Almost half of working-age Russians working remotely are ready to write a letter of resignation if the management forces them to return to the offices.
Fulfillment of labor tasks from the office or open space, imposed by the authorities, will force four out of ten Russians to leave the company.

The strongest thing for the opportunity to see their colleagues only by video link and never to appear in the office is held by Russian IT specialists.
Persistent reluctance to go to work in the classical sense of it, along with them experienced webmasters and site administrators, as well as technical support specialists.
It is much easier for them to go in search of a new employer, more loyal to the desire of employees to work from home, than to put up with the need to travel from home to the office and back every day.
Similar views are held by design engineers and designers, as well as representatives of the humanitarian professions - recruiters, accountants, call center employees, customer and sales managers, middle managers.
For women - home, for men - office
Of the respondents surveyed, 40% said they were more likely to quit than they would agree to return to the office.
In this group, among women, 53% voted for removal, among men - 31%.
64% of those who are ready to quit chose a full-fledged remote job, 20% could agree to a hybrid format, when the office needs to be visited once or several times a week.

The SuperJob survey was conducted in more than 330 localities in Russia.
The results were based on responses from 1,600 people over the age of 18.
How in Russia there was a remote
The mass transition of people to work from home with their subsequent reluctance to return to offices is a trend of the past three years, and it was formed thanks to the coronavirus pandemic.
In March 2020.
Russia went into a regime of self-isolation, as a result of which many had to work from home.
By the end of 2020, amendments to the current legislation regulating the relations between employers and remote employees were adopted, and in the first drafts of the bill there were more benefits for employees, but in the final version the balance shifted in favor of bosses.

RSHB: Africa in 2022 became the only region that attracted more investment in agrotech than a year earlier
Kira FILIPPOVA
Photo: press service of JSC "Rosselkhozbank".
Analysts of the Center for the Development of Financial Technologies (CRFT) of the Rosselkhozbank conducted an analysis of the volume of world investments in the segment of agricultural technologies for the past 2022.
According to the data obtained, against the background of the global investment downturn and the slowdown in economic development, Africa was the only continent with a positive trend in attracting financing for agricultural innovation.
The increase was 22% - $640 million.
The agricultural sector plays a key, structure-forming role in many African countries in active employment, food security, and international sectoral involvement.
On the platform "RSHB in digital" in the framework of the analytical service "AgroBit" presented a new panel of data visualization dedicated to investments in the segment of agricultural technologies in Africa, including the distribution of funding by years (since 2012) and categories, agrotech areas in 2022.
Among other things, there is an opportunity to get acquainted with the dynamics of attracting funds to agrotech by regions of the world (2021-2022).
All relevant information on the above-mentioned areas will be updated annually within the platform “RSHB in digital ”.
The results of the analysis conducted by the RSHB showed that in 2022, there was a fairly sharp decline in the flow of investments in the agro-technology segment worldwide compared to the previous year.
This state of affairs in 2022 was typical not only for the agricultural innovation sector – it was a reflection of a negative trend in the global economy as a whole (against the background of many factors, such as slowing GDP growth in Asian countries, high inflation and concomitant growth in interest rates, the real estate market crisis in China, etc.).
The only region with positive investment dynamics in 2022 was the African continent - the volume of investments amounted to 640 million dollars (22% more than in 2021 - 526 million dollars).
African agriculture has the highest growth rates compared to similar indicators in other continents.
About 60% of the total economically active population of Africa is engaged in agriculture.
On average, 15% of Africa ’ s total GDP comes from agriculture.
The development of agriculture in Africa is closely linked to the challenge of urgently addressing food security on the continent.
According to the study, investment in agro-tech countries in Africa has increased steadily since 2012.
A slight “subsidence ” of investments took place only in 2019 against the background of the destructive impact of the coronavirus pandemic and the extremely large-scale destabilization of international food chains.
Rosselkhozbank experts estimated that in 2022, investments of $640 million in Africa were attracted for a total of 142 investment transactions.
The vast majority of all agricultural investments were concentrated in three key areas: retail and restaurant technology ($197 million, share - 30.8%), "midstream technologies" ($170 million, share - 26.6%), as well as agricultural marketplaces and agrofintech ($131 million, share - 20.5%).
As a consequence of the influence of Covid-19 and the need to comply with the rules of social distance, global consumer preferences and buying habits were inevitably displaced and transformed.
The African continent was no exception in this regard.
The priority was the comfort, efficiency and clarity of transactions to ensure the best customer service.
In addition, one of the key problems for African farmers is the lack of channels to market their food.
Agrofintech, in turn, allows farmers to get support (in the form of loans, loans, leasing programs) for the development of their farms in the long term.
“Africa is aware of the importance of increasing agricultural productivity through technology.
Traditional ways of achieving efficiency no longer work.
By 2050, one in four people on Earth will be African.
As the population grows, the need for food will inevitably increase.
In such conditions, agrotech is the key to solving the food problem, ” said Elena Baturova, Director of the Center for the Development of Financial Technologies of the Rosselkhozbank.
More information about investments in agrotech in Africa and other analytics can be found in the project “AgroBit ” on the platform“ RSHB in digital ”.
JSC "Rosselkhozbank" is the basis of the national credit and financial system of servicing the agro-industrial complex of Russia.
The bank was established in 2000 and today is a key creditor of the country ’ s agro-industrial complex, is among the largest and most stable banks in the country in terms of assets and capital, as well as among the leaders in the reliability rating of the largest Russian banks.

Why does TikTok sell so well?
Stories
Elena Likhanova
Senior Editor RB.RU
Elena Likhanova
Influencers easily force subscribers to buy, sharing with them finds and favorite products.
Let ’ s see what makes them so convincing.
Why does TikTok sell so well?
TikTok is not the most obvious place to find a good cleaning agent.
However, the hashtag # cleantok, as well as # dogtok, # beautytok and others, are popular.
Consumers are increasingly turning to social media to learn more about products, and spending money following the recommendations of major influencers and microbloggers.
A striking example is the hashtag # booktok, where you can find reviews of books and recommendations.
The data shows that users promoting certain books using a hashtag actually increase their sales.
The popularity of # booktok has inspired specialized exhibitions in major international bookstores, changed the approach of cover designers and marketers to new editions, and this summer even pushed parent company TikTok to launch a new publishing house.
However, experts believe that the incentive to buy is not only an approval review.
The subtle psychological connection to the face on the screen and the underlying mechanisms of TikTok play an important role in convincing users to buy what they see in their feeds.
Confidence in the source
“Video platforms like TikTok and Instagram * have greatly changed the way we consumers make purchasing decisions, ” said Valeria Penttinen, assistant professor of marketing at Northern Illinois University.
Importantly, these platforms provide unprecedented access to products and services for users, allowing them to consume large amounts of content in very short periods of time.
There are several elements that attract users.
One of the main experts is called “trust in the source ”.
All relocation-related services and companies on one map
Most likely, people will be inclined to buy products from the screen if they perceive the author as competent and trustworthy.
If a product or service “matches ” the author, it seems sincere, explains Angelina Scheinbaum, associate professor of marketing at Wilbur O and Ann Powers College of Business at Clemson University in South Carolina, USA.
Kate Lindsay, a journalist covering Internet culture, gives this example: “When a woman like you says she ’ s a mom, she ’ s tired and helped by this cleaning agent … there ’ s a level of connection and trust and you say, ‘ You ’ re like me and it ’ s good for you, it ’ s good for me too. ’ ”
Trust in the author ’ s source increases dramatically when his recommendation is not paid.
“Organic influencers are much more authentic … their motivation is to talk about the product or service that has made their lives happier or more comfortable.
They genuinely want to share it with others, ” Sheinbaum says.
This authenticity is particularly effective in driving purchases in niche categories, as often content writers are deeply passionate and have specific expertise in a narrow area.
“With microinfluencers, the consumer feels like they ’ re buying from someone who ’ s using the product … it ’ s more of an emotional relationship, ” Scheinbaum says.
Generally, videos also gain more trust than still images or text.
Penttinen says the video creates a special “personal storytelling ” environment that attracts users: even small elements such as the ability to see the creator ’ s face, hands, or hear him speak make them feel more trusted.
Indeed, studies have shown that YouTube influencers supplement their reviews with personal information to look more like a close friend or family member — and the more the viewer thinks they “know ” a blogger, the more they trust him.
Scheinbaum adds that posts containing both actions and verbal cues — especially demos and conversions in TikTok videos that practically serve as 30-60-second microcommercials — can encourage “particularly effective persuasion. ”
Parasocial effect
One of the main elements that inspire buying is the emotional connection with bloggers.
This phenomenon, called parasocial relationships, causes members of the audience to believe that they have a close connection or even friendship with a person, when in fact it is a one-way relationship – often the content creator may not even be aware of the person ’ s existence.
Such non-reciprocal relationships often show up on social media, especially with influencers and celebrities, and occur more often as more users become familiar with their content.
“Parasocial relationships are so strong that they encourage people to buy, ” Scheinbaum says, referring to both influencers promoting sponsored products and organic bloggers talking about favorite personal things.
Penttinen explains that as consumers begin to learn the creator ’ s preferences and values and watch him disclose personal information, they begin to treat his recommendations the same way they would treat their own real-life friends.
In addition, parasocial relationships often encourage users to make repeat purchases, especially on TikTok; the platform ’ s algorithm often downloads users ’ content from the same accounts, and repeated interaction with it can contribute to one-way relationships.
She adds that parasocial relationships at TikTok can also cause fear of missing out on something that stimulates purchasing behavior: “As falling in love with these people grows, there is an increased fear of not benefiting from these relationships or showing your loyalty to those relationships. ”
Perfect packaging
The pitch is also important.
The very form of content in TikTok is product-oriented, which adds to its appeal.
“TikTok can make shopping a bit like a game, because everything is served as part of the aesthetic, ” Lindsay says.
This may cause the user to want to become a part of the trend or to participate in the discussion, including trying the product.

She adds that certain genres of content on TikTok can be very persuasive: for example, the headings “things you didn ’ t know you needed them ” or“ things that saved my … ”.
The short and trusting video format in TikTok makes recommendations more natural, pushing users to trust the authors.
Unlike ideal Instagram profiles, the opposite rule applies here: the less perfect the content, the more consumers will feel that they themselves make purchase decisions based on recommendations.
Warning to buyers
However, consumers can often find themselves involved in these emotional purchases at their own expense, says Scheinbaum, author of The Dark Side of Social Media: A Look at Consumer Psychology.
In some cases, the parasocial effect and subsequent sense of intimacy that social media causes can be so strong that users don ’ t even take the time to figure out whether the ads are sponsored or not, she said.
In particular, younger or less savvy consumers may not know the difference between advertising and regular recommendation.
The nature of TikTok ’ s fast videos can also make it harder to recognize ads, Linsday said.
In addition, these emotional attachments that encourage purchases can lead to excess spending, Penttinen says.
Many of the products described in TikTok are inexpensive, which makes it easier to decide on a purchase.
That could be a problem, she adds, because what one author might find good for themselves isn ’ t necessarily good for the user — after all, you might not like the novel you bought because it was on # booktok.
Consumers shouldn ’ t feel like they should scrutinize every purchase they make at TikTok, but experts say it ’ s important to know why the platform can inspire users to spend money — especially before they place an order.

Researchers at the University of California, San Francisco (UCSF) have developed a special brain-computer interface with support for artificial intelligence (AI) that allowed a woman with severe paralysis as a result of a brain stem stroke to speak through her digital “avatar. ”
This is reported by the portal Medical Xpress.
The translation of the main provisions of the publication is presented by discover24.ru.
Edward Chang, MD, chair of the Department of Neurological Surgery at the University of California, San Francisco, has been working on a technology known as a brain-computer interface (BCI) for more than a decade.
“The goal of our research project is to help patients who have lost their speech restore the full way of communication that is most natural for people.
New achievements bring us closer to making it real, ” he said.
Earlier, Chang ’ s research team showed the possibility of decoding brain signals into text in a person who had a brain stem stroke many years ago.
The latest study demonstrates something more ambitious: decoding brain signals into natural speech and facial expressions that animate a person ’ s face during a conversation.
Chang implanted a paper-thin rectangular mini-board consisting of 253 electrodes on the surface of the brain in areas that are critical for speech functions.
The electrodes intercepted the patient ’ s brain signals, which, if not for a previous stroke, would have reached her tongue, jaw and larynx muscles, as well as facial muscles that form facial expressions.
A cable connected to a port attached to the patient ’ s head from the outside connected the electrodes to the computer unit.
For several weeks, the participant of the experiment worked with researchers on training AI algorithms for the recognition system of unique signals of her brain, providing speech functions.
This involved repeatedly repeating various phrases from a conversational set of 1024 words until the AI achieved confident recognition of patterns of brain activity associated with sounds.
Instead of teaching the AI to recognize whole words, the researchers created a system that decodes words from phonemes — stable subunits of speech that form spoken words in the same way that letters form written words.
Using this approach, the computer had to learn just 39 phonemes to decipher any word in English.
This simultaneously increased the accuracy of the system and made it three times faster.
Next, to mimic the voice, the researchers developed a speech synthesis algorithm that they personalized so that it sounded like the patient ’ s voice before the injury, using her archived video recordings.
Chang ’ s research team eventually animated the avatar with software that mimics and animates facial muscle movements developed by Speech Graphics based on AI technology.
The researchers created tailor-made machine learning processes that allowed the standard software to process signals sent from a woman ’ s brain as she tried to speak and adequately translate them into facial expressions on the avatar ’ s face, including reflections of facial movements in happiness, sadness, and surprise.
"Essentially, we are making up for the connections between the brain and the vocal tract that have been severed by a stroke.
When the patient first used this system to speak and move the face of the avatar at the same time, it was expected to have a real effect, ” said researchers working with Professor Chang, PhD student Kylo Littlejohn, and Dr. Gopala Anumanchipalli, a professor of electrical engineering and computer science at the University of California, Berkeley.
As an important next step, the UCSF researchers called the creation of a wireless version that does not require the user to physically connect to the BCI.
“Giving people the ability to more freely manage their computers and phones with this technology will have a profound impact on their independence and social interaction, ” said study co-author David Moses, associate professor of neurological surgery at UCSF.

What danger can popular diets carry: the benefits and harm to health, how to properly apply
We tell you what the harm of severe restrictions in nutrition.
Why is there no universal diet?
Video of the day
The fact is that diets are built on the introduction of some products, the rejection of others or on the reduction of the diet as a whole.
Nutrition should be based on the nutritional deficiencies and surpluses of a particular person, as well as his characteristics.
For example, someone who has serious liver problems is contraindicated in a protein diet.
It can cause tremendous harm to physical health and become life-threatening.
By the same principle, other diets harm the mental and physical health of a person, sick and healthy organs, as well as general well-being.
Harmful effects can occur due to improper “entry ” into the diet.
For example, too abrupt refusal of certain products, the need to follow certain rules - all this is a great stress for the body.
Therefore, every piece of food that enters the stomach is deposited in fat, and weight is gained at the same rate as it was shed.
Thus, the diet is a very dangerous and individual diet, which can be prescribed only after passing tests to a dietitian and other doctors.
What Happens to Your Body During Diets
When we arbitrarily go on a diet without training and recommendations of specialists, the level of cortisol in the blood sharply increases, since the body is not ready for rapid changes in nutrition.
Cortisol is a hormone that destroys proteins, increases glucose levels and promotes the formation of new adipose tissue.
It is produced in response to emergency situations that occur with the body, including starvation and stress.
This hormone literally fights against our desire to sit on a diet.
The body should be ready for unforeseen circumstances, and it should not be blamed for the accumulation of reserves “for a rainy day ”.
Nevertheless, we do not need glucose and fat reserves - our desires run counter to the processes of self-preservation of the body.
On low-calorie diets, metabolism slows down, the body multiplies the lost calories at the first opportunity.
If a person has health problems, diets often increase them.
Harm of intermittent fasting
At the heart of the diet interval fasting (fasting) is the work, awarded the Nobel Prize in medicine and physiology.
In 2016, Japanese Yoshinori Osumi received an award for the discovery of the mechanisms of autophagy (the process of processing by a cell of its own components).
At the same time, there are no unequivocal scientifically proven advantages in diet-schemes of interval fasting.
Among the adverse effects are most common: fatigue, insomnia, nausea and headache.
In some people, these symptoms are temporary and appear only in the adaptive period, and someone notes them as permanent.
Interval fasting can cause irreparable harm to the health of a person who has a sick liver, diabetes, thyroid disease, gastrointestinal disease (even gastritis).
The list of contraindications is so wide that we can draw a confident conclusion that the number of people for whose health it will be useful is incredibly small, and it is not worth the risk here.
The harm of ketodiet
Keto diet is a diet plan for weight loss.
The main principle is the consumption of products with a minimum amount of carbohydrates.
The norm of carbohydrates on the keto diet is 10%.
If you turn to, you can see in the recommendations information about the rate of carbohydrate intake, which is 45-65% in order for a person to be healthy, full of strength during the day and not experience physical ailments.
Why does the body need carbohydrates?
Carbohydrates are a key source of energy in the human body, with just one gram accounting for four calories of energy.
When carbohydrates are broken down, glucose is formed in the body, it is extremely important for the preservation of tissue protein, fat metabolism and nutrition of the central nervous system.
What happens when there are not enough carbohydrates in the body?
The minimum reaction of the body that is experienced on the ketodium: weakness, apathy, headaches, constipation, bad breath.
What are the dangers of the keto diet for human health in a global sense?
In 2018, Polish professor Maciej Banach presented a report on the dangers of low-carbohydrate diets at the Congress of the European Society of Cardiology.
Studies showed that in a control group of 24,000 participants, the risk of dying from heart disease, stroke and oncology was 50%, 51% and 35% higher among those who followed a high-fat, low-carb diet.
Also for ketodiet there is a huge list of contraindications for health, that is, to adhere to it, you need to go through a full check-up of the body from a doctor.
Harm of protein diet
The essence of the protein diet is that it is necessary to exclude completely simple carbohydrates, proteins should make up 60% of the daily diet, fats (exclusively vegetable) are present in a minimum amount.
Proteins (proteins) are vital for humans.
They make up the bulk of the dense substances of the muscles, supporting tissues and protective formations (hair, nails).
They consist of immune bodies that protect the body from infections.
The body does not know how to accumulate proteins, so a person must constantly eat protein food.
But for the normal functioning of all systems and organs, fats and carbohydrates are no less necessary.
Undergetting vital substances with food, the body is faced with their deficiency.
Trying to make up for the missing carbohydrates, a person first spends their own reserves (glycogen) accumulated in the muscles and liver.
Then the deferred fat reserves are spent.
The harm of a carbohydrate-free diet
The difference between a carbohydrate-free diet and a keto-diet is in the amount of daily carbohydrates consumed.
The harm of carbohydrate-free and keto-diet is approximately the same, since the principle of their work and construction is similar to each other.
The main danger - the risk of cardiovascular diseases increases.
If you have kidney problems: pyelonephritis, urolithiasis, have had injuries or have a hereditary predisposition to their disease, eating too much protein creates an additional burden on the organs.
This can worsen kidney function: chronic pathologies may worsen.
An unbalanced diet with a deficiency of carbohydrates can provoke osteoporosis and the formation of kidney stones.
As well as a decrease in blood glucose levels, which is especially dangerous for people with diabetes, prediabetes or some metabolic disorders.
Even healthy people against this background feel irritability, aggression and weakness, malaise.
This is especially important if you play sports, work hard and you need concentration and attention, sufficient physical strength.

There is a risk that Argentina will not become a member of the BRICS
15: 36 04.09.2023
VALENTIN KATASONOV
The likely future president is set to change the current vector of foreign policy of the Latin American country
The next BRICS summit has ended in South Africa.
The main decision of the summit is the admission of new members.
On August 24, South African President Cyril Ramaphosa announced that from January 1, 2024, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Iran, Ethiopia, Egypt and Argentina should become full members of the BRICS.
But for Argentina, it was immediately doubtful that she would take advantage of the invitation.
The application to join the organization was submitted by the current government and President of Argentina Alberto Fernandez.
But just a week or so before the BRICS summit, Argentina held a primaries, a preliminary round of presidential elections.
And according to the results of the primaries, it became clear that a radical “change of the guard ” could occur in the country.
The best chance of becoming the next president of the country was demonstrated by Javier Miley, representing the movement under the beautiful name "Forward to Freedom".
Miley received 30.04% of the vote.
The government alliance "Union for the Homeland", which is nominated by the Minister of Economy, Agriculture and Industrial Development Sergio Massa, was supported by 27.27% of voters.
The Alliance "Together for Change", which nominated two candidates for the primaries, received a total of 28.27% of the vote.
Bullrich will represent him in the election.
Mileus, in his ideological position, is a “libertarian, ” that is, he adheres to views close to anarchism.
He seeks for the sake of "freedom" to rid a person of an excess of state guardianship and supervision.
He chose the United States as the “standard of freedom. ”
Javier Miley in the presidential race is actively supported by former security Minister Patricia Bullrich, who has a good chance to take third place in the election.
And then give their votes to Miley, having received from him at least the post of vice president.
Elections are due to take place on October 22.
According to the regulations, there are two rounds.
But if a convincing victory is recorded in the first round (at least 45% of the votes), then a second round will not be required.
Miley ’ s supporters are confident that their protege will be announced as president in the first round.
For the authorities, the first place of Javier Miley was a complete surprise.
Almost no one knew about Miley for another six months.
This new politician very successfully used all the problems that have accumulated in the country to date.
Miley blamed them on the incapacity of the ruling party, President Alberto Fernandez and Vice President Cristina Kirchner.
He promises to put the latter on trial for corruption as soon as she is deprived of her official immunity.
As for socio-economic problems, these are mass poverty (40 percent of the country ’ s population is classified as poor), galloping inflation (this year it reaches 115%), growing public debt and the threat of a new default, high unemployment, etc.
Miley is determined to change the current vector of Argentina ’ s foreign policy.
He has already said loudly that he does not need BRICS.
There is no need not only for membership in the organization, but also for further deepening of trade and economic relations with the BRICS countries.
The bloc currently accounts for 30% of Argentina ’ s exports.
Today, for 8-10 provinces of Argentina, the main direction of supply is China, a lot of agricultural products go to India.
Brazil is the traditional main trading partner of Argentina.
Javier Miley is not going to get closer to either Beijing or Moscow.
He accused Russia and China of creating “problems for all free countries. ”
In addition, he promised to deal with “refugees ” from Russia.
These are those who left our country after February 24, 2022, as well as after the September mobilization of last year, and, taking advantage of the visa-free regime, settled in Argentina.
There are about 35,000 such people today.
Here Patricia Bullrich fully supports Miley.
"We must ensure the safety of Argentines from external influence.
And the representatives of those countries that threaten the United States, threaten Argentina, ” she said.
And with whom does this candidate for president of Argentina intend to approach?
with the United States and Israel.
Miley, in particular, said: "Stop flirting with those who create chaos and instability in the world.
“The freest country in the world is the United States, and we will work closely with them on all key international issues. ”
Also in an interview with El Pais, he said: “My natural allies are the United States and Israel.
I do not want to deal with the communists of Cuba, China and North Korea.
What does that mean?
Trade with whomever you want, but I will not strengthen relations with them. "
And what is Javier Miley going to do inside the country?
What any libertarian would do in his place.
The politician said that “the state should not interfere in the life of citizens – freedom should be complete and unconditional. ”
Accordingly, he proposes to sharply reduce budget expenditures, conduct almost 100 percent privatization of state-owned enterprises, reduce the state apparatus and liquidate a number of ministries (primarily the Ministry of Labor and the Ministry of Education), abolish the severance payments to employees upon dismissal, etc.
And also to introduce the free sale of weapons.
As the politician noted, “we should have everything as in the United States, then there will be order and corruption will disappear. ”
But Javier Miley is not an ordinary libertarian.
He promised the Argentines something that other libertarians would never have thought of.
For example, to legalize the free trade in children and human organs.
“Who are you to determine what a person does with his life? ” the politician answers the question, whether such trade is permissible.
Unorthodox ideas Javier Miley also expresses about the problems of financial, currency and monetary credit.
He proposed, first, to liquidate the Central Bank of Argentina.
Second, cancel the Argentine peso and define the US dollar as the national currency.
In Argentina, Miley famously said, “Central banks fall into four categories: bad, like the Fed; very bad, like in Latin America; terribly bad; and the Central Bank of Argentina. ”
As Javier Miley said, the latter "has no reason to exist."
In an interview with El Pais, the politician explained his position on the Central Bank: “Argentina became the richest country in the world when it did not have a Central Bank.
From 1880 to 1935, average inflation was 0.9% per year.
In 1935, the Central Bank was created as a way to deceive people and benefit those close to power: inflation then jumped to an average of 6% per year.
And the abandonment of the peso in favor of the US dollar will deprive the ruling class of Argentina of the opportunity to print money: "You take away the printing machine from politicians...
This is what will end inflation.
Because inflation is everywhere and always a monetary phenomenon generated by an excess of money.
However, in addition to the dollar as the official currency, the country will allow the free use of private cryptocurrencies, primarily bitcoin.
Miley believes that bitcoin is a reaction to central bank scammers.
True, if all the world ’ s central banks, according to Miley, are crooks, why does he agree to deal with the dollar, which, following the logic of politics, is also created by a fraudulent structure called the “US Federal Reserve ”?
Miley cites as examples worthy of imitation countries such as Ecuador, El Salvador and Panama, where there are no national currencies, and the dollar, in his opinion, provides these countries with financial stability.
However, if you look at these countries, the situation there is not very different from the situation in Argentina.
When asked about the problems that Ecuador faces today, the politician replied that the reason for this is the populist policy of former President Rafael Correa.
The Argentine politician calls not all countries and jurisdictions that do not have national currencies, but the US dollar instead.
To the list should be added Puerto Rico, the American Virgin Islands, the Northern Mariana Islands, Guam, American Samoa, Micronesia, American Samoa, Zimbabwe East Timor and something else by little.
Of all the countries that have adopted the US dollar, the largest in terms of population are Ecuador (18 million people) and Zimbabwe (16 million people).
More than 46 million people live in Argentina.
In terms of economic development (GDP), it is the third country in Latin America after Brazil and Mexico.
Of course, the transition of Argentina to the US dollar would be a real sensation, not only for Latin America, but for the whole world.
Especially considering that the prospects for the US dollar are not so rosy.
And yet Miley is a supporter of the US dollar: “What does it matter to us that dollars are printed in the US?
The main thing is that we will no longer wake up and see what the peso to the dollar exchange rate was yesterday and what it will be tomorrow.
The US dollar will bring financial order to our country.
And by doing so, we will end the games of socialism and the groveling before the trade unions. "
This is the logic of the contender for the presidency of Argentina.
In order to achieve financial stability in the country, to end the games of socialism and stop squabbling in front of the trade unions, Javier Miley is ready to sacrifice such a "trifle" as the national sovereignty of Argentina.
P.S. In social networks, there is a discussion of the question: what guided the participants of the summit in South Africa, when they made the decision to accept Argentina as a member of the BRICS?
The results of the primaries were already known to them.
One version is that in a similar way, the summit participants tried to provide indirect support to the government alliance “Union for the sake of the Motherland ” in the October elections.
After all, the alliance is unequivocally in favor of Argentina ’ s membership in the BRICS.
It is also important that, according to opinion polls, the majority of Argentine citizens also support the idea of ​ ​ the country's membership in the BRICS.

Neighbors from the future: the top 5 most unusual robots
2: 58
The flight of human imagination is not limited.
Every day, scientists and developers offer us new ideas in the field of robotics that allow us to solve both local human assignments and perform important tasks in various sectors of the economy.
We offer a selection of the 5 most unusual robots ever presented to the general public.
What are the specifics of these robots, how functional they are - this is what Pravda readers will learn about.
Andrey Natashkin, founder and CEO of Mirey Robotics, will tell Ru.
Top 5 Most Unusual Robots
Robot Cats and Robot Dogs
The first prototypes of robot dogs appeared in the 60s of the twentieth century.
These models were used primarily for military purposes.
There was hardly any external resemblance.
They were called dogs conditionally, because the prototype was able to perform several commands.
At a serious level, the development of robotic dogs began to engage the Japanese manufacturer of equipment SONY.
In 1993, the company announced the development of a robotic dog.
And only 6 years later, the AIBO robot was released on the market, which means “friend ” in Japanese.
Initially, the project was not commercial in nature, but the active interest from the market forced the company to look at its development from a new angle.
Even then, it became clear that the robot dog can be used in the context of several spheres.
On the one hand, this is an excellent demonstration of the development of the IT industry.
On the other hand, robots have taken a significant share in the market for children ’ s toys.
In addition, marketers saw the potential of using dogs in brand PR campaigns.
In 2017, a new model of the dog from SONY was presented, which already fully fits into the concept of IoT (Internet of Things) in the framework of personal use.
The robot using Wi-Fi and LTE is controlled using an application installed on the user ’ s smartphone.
The development of robotic dogs is not limited to SONY.
In 2005, Boston Dynamics brought to the market robotic dogs performing tasks for the military.
The development has proven itself extremely well in dangerous and hard-to-reach locations.
After 11 years, the Swiss developer introduced his product to the market - ANYbotics dog, which performed a large layer of tasks in the industrial direction.
Three years ago, the Vision 60 was presented, which was already equipped with weapons for combat.
An interesting project was presented by the world developer Xiaomi, who in his robot tried to keep two directions - personal use and industrial-military.
This was achieved through open source.
“Children and adults are always touched by robot dogs.
We see it from our practice.
At our exhibitions, real queues are lined up for such robots.
There are 8 such dogs in the park.
If we talk about the modern market, then I would single out the Go1 robot from the Chinese manufacturer Unitree Robotics.
In terms of its characteristics, it is not inferior to the Japanese, but the price is much lower.
Cats are not a simple story.
Historically, robotics has evolved dogs.
There are cats in the market.
Some models are similar to dogs in their technology.
Other models try to imitate external similarities and are more like children ’ s soft toys, ” notes Andrei Natashkin.
Housekeeping Assistant Robots
Homework is a tiresome task for most people.
Therefore, it is quite logical that robotics is trying to shift some of the household tasks to robots.
One of the most famous developments is the PR2 robot from Willow Garage.
It was developed on the basis of Stanford University.
Initially, the robot performed simple operations, for example, cut fruits and vegetables.
He was later taught:
• oven pancakes,
• open the doors,
• fold towels,
• load the laundry into the washing machine.
Another interesting development is a robot gardener Wall-Ye from France.
The robot literally controls the entire crop.
It is sold in different configurations - both for personal use and for the agricultural sector.
Telepresence robots
The coronavirus pandemic actualized remote technologies, when most people were forced to isolate themselves and arrange a working space inside an apartment.
The Wehead robot was presented on the market.
Due to several displays and rotation mechanisms, this robot reproduces all the elements of a personal meeting.
A person sees completely the face of his interlocutor in full size, emotions and reactions, all gestures.
In fact, in front of you is the head of your interlocutor, who can communicate from anywhere in the world.
The only requirement is Wi-Fi.
“The real trend has been the rental and purchase of such robots for the commercial segment in the United States.
Given the trend for remote work, this robot is very relevant, ” the expert stressed.
Humanoid robots
Humanoid robots are often called androids.
It is believed that for robotics - this is one of the most difficult areas.
For the first time such a robot was introduced by the Japanese concern Honda in the early 2000s.
A significant disadvantage was the lack of face.
Since then, it is the imitation of facial expressions and live communication that has become a key skill of humanoid robots.
Several experimental models have been released, but one of the most successful cases is the Sophia robot from developers from Hong Kong.
The project was presented in 2015.
The robot can copy gestures and emotions, answer questions.
Sophia has more than 60 different emotions in her arsenal.
And the neural network that is embedded in it is constantly evolving, accumulating new data.
In fact, the more people Sofia embraces, the smarter it gets.
The development was very loudly presented in the world market.
Sofia took part in the largest business events, TV programs.
He also obtained Saudi citizenship.
There are only two such robots in the world.
And one of them we presented at our exhibition in North Carolina.
Sofia is an excellent synthesis of robotics and artificial intelligence.
This is a really interesting object.
I have seen many different developments of humanoid robots due to my activity, but I can say unequivocally - Sofia is one of the flagships.
I would also single out the humanoid robot Ameca from the UK, ” notes Andrei Natashkin.
Robots as Players
In 2010, the world got acquainted with a project from Vietnam - a robot TOSY, which skillfully plays table tennis.
TOSY ’ s artificial intelligence helps him make decisions about the strike technique most suitable for a given moment in the game.
TOSY does not need to rest, because he does not get tired.
He is not distracted from the game, because table tennis is his primary goal.
There are a lot of sports games in the robotics market.
Robots are designed for gymnastics, running, high jump, basketball, baseball, swimming.
Football is a separate direction.
A few years ago, football robots developed at the Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology won the Robot Soccer Championship.
“I recently got acquainted with a very interesting development – this is self-propelled chess with artificial intelligence technology.
It is clear that we have long known that you can play this intellectual game with a computer, but here the developers went much further.
Introduced Bluetooth into the chessboard, magnets for the movement of figures, lighting for the training mode.
A person has a complete feeling that he is playing chess with a real person.
There is no man in front.
And everything is done by the neural network, ” the expert says.

Fantasy cycles from the 80s, which are worth paying attention to today
October 8, 2023
08.10.2023
13911
6 minutes to read
Among fans of fantasy, there is an opinion that the 80s were a time of decline of the genre: writers know yourself forged the same type of adventures of heroes of sword and magic according to the patterns of the great Professor, until George Martin came and changed everything.
There is some truth in this, and yet in that decade, too, there were quite original and influential works.
Today Galina Beltyukova tells about several cycles of that time, which still deserve attention.
Ted Williams, "Memory, Grief, and the Spike"
This large-scale cycle is not for nothing considered a transitional stage from Tolkien to Martin: Ted Williams was a big fan of the Professor, but sought to bring something new to his modern fantasy, and Martin was subsequently inspired by his cycle when creating "A Song of Ice and Fire".
Memory, Grief, and the Spike may seem like a traditional epic fantasy about the fight between good and evil, but Williams focuses much more on politics, diplomacy, and the structure of the society he invented than on adventures or the search for magical artifacts.
This gives his world a more gloomy atmosphere and allows you to show all its diversity – from the brutal struggle for power in the upper strata of society to poverty and injustice in the lower strata.
The heroes of Williams are also far from the standards of fantasy: Simon, who is destined to play the main role in the fate of Bright Arda, is not a knight without fear and reproach, but a young man, constantly insecure in his abilities, complaining about life and not enjoying success with girls.
Princess Miriamel is not an ordinary “maiden in trouble ”, but a skillful politician: she successfully builds alliances from completely opposite groups and makes a significant contribution to the victory over the dark forces.
Even the antagonists of the cycle — the powerful Norn race — end up not as creatures of hell, like the servants of Sauron, and even their leader, the Storm King, who sought to destroy humanity, gets, if not redemption in the eyes of the reader, then at least a chance to tell the story from his point of view.
David Gemmel as Jon Shaddow
David Gemmel is a classic of heroic fantasy, which became famous in particular due to the fact that he wrote out deep and ambiguous characters.
They were often influenced by the deep Christian faith of Gemmel himself, which was combined with the harsh lessons he learned as a child in the doorways of London's slums.
Jon Shaddow, the protagonist of the eponymous trilogy, in a sense, the alter ego of the writer himself: despite his sincere faith, he is not at all one who will turn the other cheek.
Jon, like a lonely cowboy, travels the Midwest in search of the holy city of Jerusalem, lying somewhere behind the post-apocalyptic devastation.
And it soon begins to seem that the Apocalypse in this world occurred in the most literal sense: the antagonists of the novel are sectarian devils, convinced that Satan during the last battle defeated God and now the earthly world is completely in his control.
Although Shaddow often has to stand up for the defenseless and fight the Satanists with their own weapons, later he will begin to reflect more often on his actions, wondering whether he himself multiplies the violence in the world.
Glen Cook, "The Black Squad"
American Glen Cook began to write fantasy as a vent after working at the car factory.
In the Black Squad series, which brought him fame, he was largely inspired by The Lord of the Rings, but turned the classic story around so that it turned out to be one of the first significant dark fantasy.
Many years before the beginning of the events of the cycle, the powerful wizard Lord built an empire of terror and chaos, relying on the ten Taken, the strongest wizards of their time, enslaved by them - does it remind you anything?
But in the end the Lord, his wife the Mistress and the Taken were defeated and imprisoned in mounds far to the north.
One day, by chance, the Mistress manages to break free, but instead of awakening the Lord, she frees only the Taken and forces them to obey her in order to establish their tyranny.
As a result, the world is mired in a decades-long war of all against all, in which mercenary units acquire special importance - each with its own history and its own pride.
The series tells the story of the Black Squad - one of the most dangerous teams in the world, which has to stand in the service of the Mistress.
The Master, the chronicler of the detachment, has yet to learn, and that the Mistress is not as terrible and cruel as it seems, and that the Lord does not sleep and even from the afterlife tries to return to destroy all that exists.
Glen Cook managed to make his characters so alive and realistic that in the 80s his cycle was one of the most popular fantasy among American veterans: they saw in a squad of mercenaries thrown into the heat of bloody magical battles, as simple warriors as they were themselves.
Caroline Cherry, The Dream Tree
American writer Caroline Cherry is famous for her talent for creating complex and multidimensional worlds and writing on behalf of nonhuman characters with striking persuasiveness.
She usually used this talent in the creation of sci-fi universes, but turned to fantasy several times.
Dilogy "Dream Tree" equally takes a lot from the "Lord of the Rings" and Celtic mythology, and the main character of Cherry becomes an elf and all the events we observe it through her eyes.
Arafel, the last remaining elf queen, lives in a mysterious forest full of ancient magic and magical creatures.
But the age of magic approaches sunset, and people begin to invade the forest.
The book is poor for events: Arafel lives in the forest year after year, observes the change of seasons, sometimes encounters people, both good and evil, willingly or involuntarily takes part in their lives, though to the end and is not sure whether it is worth it to help them.
The slow narration gives the cycle a special charm, allowing you to truly feel the worldview of the immortal elf queen: if the events of the Lord of the Rings were told on behalf of Galadriel, perhaps something similar to the Dream Tree would have happened.
Gene Wolfe, The Book of the New Sun
Wolf, a fan of experiments and literary games, wrote his cycle as if specifically for those who like to look for a double bottom in reading: “The Book of the New Sun ” will not disappoint them.
At first glance, this is an ordinary fantasy story about how a young hero, a student of the executioner ’ s guild, gradually ascends to the very top of the empire and becomes a ruler.
But the traditional plot hides serious reflections on faith and religion, freedom and necessity, mercy and morality, unusual for the fantasy of the 80s.
And the plot is not so simple: the reader soon notices that Severian, the main character, despite the fact that he boasts an ideal memory, quite selectively approaches the memories and is an unreliable storyteller.
And the world of the cycle itself makes the reader think more about what is happening: the planet Urd, despite the presence of magic and magical creatures, suspiciously looks like a post-apocalyptic Earth, and in the course of the plot there are heroes more familiar to science fiction, not fantasy.
And although there is an explanation for all this in the final, it will be so unexpected and brainless that some readers immediately re-read the cycle for the second time in order to catch all the hints that were not noticed at first.
Marion Bradley, "The Mists of Avalon"
In his classic cycle, Marion Bradley reinterprets the legends of Camelot from the point of view of the antagonist of traditional Arturian - the sorceress Morgana.
Combining fantasy with real history, Bradley creates a world of ancient Britain, in which Christianity and paganism, the adherent of which Morgan is shown, are fighting among themselves.
Unlike the mainstream fantasy of the 80s, The Mists of Avalon represent a truly feminine view of the genre: the life of the heroines here revolves around household chores, gossip, childbirth, and the men present in the book merge into one indistinguishable mass, even there are practically no battles in the books or they occur somewhere on the periphery of the narrative.
Nevertheless, the cycle can not be called boring: one has only to get used to how slowly Morgana talks about her childhood, and a completely new, unusual world opens up to the reader, unlike the traditional “male ” fantasy.
Margaret Weiss, Tracy Hickman, The Saga of the Spear
This multi-volume inter-second cycle, also known under the original name Dragonlance, appeared almost by accident: spouses and novice writers Tracy and Laura Hickman were going to submit a resume to the manufacturer of the famous board game Dungeons & Dragons, and the idea of a new world came to them right in the car.
Once they got the job, they were able to polish their ideas in numerous game games, in which other Hickman writers participated: they all passionately discussed each other ’ s ideas and thus contributed to the creation of the universe.
The first novel in the world, The Spear Saga, appeared in 1984 and immediately gained popularity, and since then more than 190 novels have been published from a variety of authors.
Understanding the entire chronology of Dragonlance is not easy even for hardcore fans, but the first three novels, conventionally called “Chronicles of the Spear ” can easily be read as an introduction to the universe, and as a completed fantasy cycle.
The vast magical world of Krynn is attacked by an army of Darkness consisting of ruthless draconids destroying everything in its path.
Six friends, meeting in the tavern after a long separation, decide that only they can stop the invasion, and go on a long journey full of adventure.

October 16 is World Healthy Eating Day.

Bloggers, newly-minted nutritionists without medical education advise either to starve, that is, six times, then drink coffee with butter instead of cream, then avoid fats.

“Now we have the problem of excess nutrition. ”
- What should you focus on when creating a healthy diet?
What menu for the day can be considered optimal?
Nutrition is the fundamental, leading factor that ensures human health from the inception of life to old age.
In second place in importance is physical activity.
The balance of these two factors is the basis of health.
Nutrition should be optimal – we should get everything necessary for our body!
There are two basic laws: the first law of the science of nutrition is the correspondence of the energy value of the diet to our energy expenditure, how much you spent, how much you received with food.
We now face the problem of overeating: accessibility, diversity, advertising, temptation and, yes, we love to eat are part of our culture.
Excess energy leads to excess body weight, obesity, which in turn leads to the risk of cardiovascular and other chronic diseases.
When we eat something tasty, high-fat, high-calorie, we have to spend it, walk more than usual.
The second law of nutrition science is the correspondence of the chemical composition of the diet to the physiological needs of your body, the deficiency of which can lead to anemia, hypovitaminosis and dystrophy.
The more diverse your diet, the better.
“There are no more useful products. ”
- Are there any top 5 most useful products that should be included in the menu for everyone?
There are no healthiest foods, just as there are no healthiest ones.
It all depends on the quality, quantity, on your individual characteristics.
It is necessary to consume a variety of food, vegetables and fruits, preferably fresh (at least 400 g / day).
Control your fat intake: Replace fatty meats and meat products with fish, poultry, or lean meats.
Daily consume milk, cheese, fermented milk products with low fat and salt content.
Choose foods that are low in sugar by limiting the frequency of sugary drinks.
Observe the correct water regime.

- 3 main meals and snacks.
The best time for breakfast is 6-7 in the morning, dinner 2-3 hours before bedtime.
Intermittent fasting – the question for what?
Hunger – like any other diet – is a calorie deficit, as we remove one meal, fewer calories – weight loss, so intermittent fasting can be used as a weight loss.
But it is not suitable for everyone, it can not be used by children, pregnant and lactating women, the elderly, people with a deficit of body weight with chronic diseases of the gastrointestinal tract, with diabetes mellitus.

It ’ s hard and boring and I ’ ll get bored of it someday.

And when a person is on limits, he can usually fail.

We use our fist to determine the size of a portion of vegetables and fruits, dairy products.
A handful of cereals, pasta, potato nuts.
We use two handfuls for greens and berries.
The phalanx of the thumb determines the size of the fatty part: butter, cheese and sour cream.

First of all, during this period, our body needs vitamins and trace elements.
With their lack, the human body is weakened and is not able to fight even the slightest diseases that come along with cooling.

Presidential and parliamentary elections to be held in Argentina
The vote comes amid an economic crisis exacerbated by the coronavirus pandemic and one of the worst droughts in the country's history.
BUENOS AIRES, 22 October.
/ TASS /.
Presidential and parliamentary elections will be held in Argentina on Sunday.
In addition to the head of state, the citizens of the country will elect 130 deputies and 24 senators of the Congress.
There are five candidates for the highest public office.
The main struggle will unfold between the Minister of economy Sergio Massa, nominated from the ruling coalition “Union for homeland ”, ex-Minister of security Patricia Bullrich, representing the largest opposition coalition“ Together for change ”, and MP Javier Miley, who heads the Libertarian party, which is part of the alliance “Freedom comes ”.
In addition, Juan Schiaretti, Governor of the Province of Córdoba, and Miriam Bregman, a member of the Left and Workers Front coalition, are running for the presidency.
The current head of state, Alberto Fernandez, whose approval rating fell below 20%, announced in April that he would not be nominated for a new term, although the constitution allowed him to do so.
According to the results of the primaries held in August, the highest number of votes (31%) was received by Miley, who was not considered one of the favorites before.
According to most polls, he remains the leader of the election race, but the gap between the candidates indicates a likely second round.
The greatest chances to get into it, according to the results of public opinion studies, Miley and Massa.
About candidates
Economist by education Miley advocates minimal state intervention in life, wants to abolish the Central Bank and proposes to replace the national currency with the dollar.
To solve economic problems, the candidate, who chose a chainsaw as his symbol, intends to seriously cut budget expenditures, while promising not to reduce social support for the population.
He also wants to reduce the number of ministries.
At the center of his campaign, the candidate puts a protest against the country ’ s political establishment, which he calls a caste.
Miley has repeatedly stated that he does not intend to promote interstate relations with China, Brazil and Russia because of disagreement with the policies of these states, but at the same time argued that he will not prevent private business from doing business with these countries.
According to the candidate, he considers the priority allies of the United States and Israel.
At the same time, Miley ’ s foreign policy adviser Diana Mondino told TASS that if he wins, Argentina will “maintain relations with all countries. ”
Massa intends to continue to follow the basic principles of the current government's policy.
He promises to focus on job creation and the development of national industry and the oil and gas sector in order to increase the flow of foreign currency to the country.
Gustavo Pandiani, the candidate ’ s foreign policy adviser, said that Argentina needs to develop relations with the world and that refusing to join the BRICS, where the country was accepted at the end of the group ’ s summit in August, would be a big mistake.
Bullrich, who served as security minister in the government of former President Mauricio Macri (2015-2019), advocates the abolition of currency restrictions in order to stimulate investment, the abolition of duties for exporters and the reduction of social programs, followed by redirecting the budget to stimulate the entry of citizens into the labor market.
During the election campaign, the candidate pays much attention to the fight against crime, proposing to involve the military in the tasks of ensuring order and create special prisons for drug traffickers.
Bullrich is in favor of improving relations with the United States, criticizes the current government for, in her opinion, excessive rapprochement with China and promises to refuse to join the BRICS.
On the situation in the country and the election procedure
The elections are taking place amid an economic crisis that has been exacerbated by the coronavirus pandemic and one of the worst droughts in Argentina ’ s history.
At the end of the year, inflation in the country is expected to be at least 100%.
The rise in prices spurs the fall in the value of the national currency on the stock exchange and the black market, which exists due to the current restrictions on the purchase of the dollar in the country, which were introduced due to the lack of foreign exchange reserves.
The poverty rate in the country is 40%.
Polling stations will open at 08: 00 local time (14: 00 MSK) and will work until 18: 00 (00: 00 MSK).
Voting is compulsory for all Argentine citizens over the age of 16.
Preliminary results will be announced in the evening of the same day.
To win the first round, the candidate with the most popular support needs to get more than 45% of the vote or 40%, provided that the gap from his nearest rival is at least 10 percentage points.
If none of the candidates for the highest office achieve this result, the second round of voting will take place on November 19.
The inauguration of the elected president will take place on December 10.

The demand of Russian IT professionals for rental housing in Thailand has quadrupled in two years
Another center of attraction for IT specialists in Asia was Kuala Lumpur, said the leading expert of Tranio branch in Phuket Svetlana Romanyuk
Moscow, October 30.
/ TASS /.
The demand for rental housing in Thailand from Russian IT professionals has quadrupled over the past two years.
This was reported to TASS by the leading expert of the branch Tranio (international real estate broker) in Thailand (Phuket Island) Svetlana Romanyuk.
“The demand of employees of IT companies for rental housing in Thailand this fall is high, especially in light of the increase in the period of visa-free entry for Russians.
We can say that over the past two years (October 2023 to October 2021), demand in this segment has grown about four times, but a more pronounced surge occurred in 2022, "Romanyuk said.
According to her, more often, relocants prefer renting rather than buying real estate, but now they rent housing not only for the winter, but also for a long time.
With a long-term contract, renting an apartment in Phuket costs an average of $500 to $1 thousand per month.
She recalled that Russians are now available visa-free entry to Thailand for 90 days with the right to free extension for 30 days.
After that, it is permissible to cross the border and re-enter the country for another 90 + 30 days, which in total gives 240 days of stay.
Therefore, many IT specialists this year are moving families to Phuket, solving the issue of placing children in local international schools, and the areas of the island are gradually becoming "Russian", the interlocutor of the agency added.
Another center of attraction for IT professionals in Asia was Kuala Lumpur, which can be called “budget Singapore ”, Romanyuk believes.
According to her, this metropolis is actively developing, there are large technological universities and coworking places, but the cost of living is still low.
“A large community of remote operators has also formed on the island of Bali, which, due to the profile of local IT companies, has become a kind of“ crypto capital ” in Southeast Asia.
Some remote workers from Russia and European countries work in the Philippines and Vietnam, but so far more often in the format of “wintering ”, rather than permanent residence, ” the expert added.
The top three areas of Southeast Asia that are of interest to Russian relocants, including IT specialists, include Bali, Thailand (Phuket) and Vietnam (Nha Trang), said Oleg Morozov, head of the Homeapp office in Vietnam, in an interview with TASS.
According to him, since February 2022, the flows of “remote workers ” to the region have increased significantly.
"If earlier the so-called" winterers "in Vietnam rented real estate on the principle of the cheapest - conditionally, they were interested in the budget for renting $200-300 per month, now, for example, in one of the complexes, where rent starts from $800, half of the two hundred apartments are inhabited by Russian citizens," the expert said.
According to Morozov, for Russian citizens visa-free regime in Vietnam is valid for 45 days, then you can get a visa online for three months with the possibility of extension for three months on the spot.

Guide dogs are a real salvation for visually impaired people, but it takes years to train them.

The All-Seeing Eye
Researchers have created a robotic equivalent of a guide dog for the visually impaired, which can even react when a user pulls it on a leash.
In the experiments, the robot dog, developed by researchers at Binghamton University, was able to guide a person along the corridor, reacting to input data, such as light tremors, to avoid obstacles.

Due to global warming caused by human activities, the habitat on Earth is changing more and more.

In the response of animals to climate change, their nervous system plays a key role.

It is likely that this will also affect their basic senses, from sight and taste to smell and touch.
Mammals partially perceive temperature with the help of special receptor proteins in their nervous system.
These proteins respond to heat and cold, helping to distinguish between moderate and extreme temperatures.
Due to these proteins, animals can also look for a suitable habitat.
GETTY

Because of climate change, animals can change their habitat.

It is known that the brain of animals is very flexible and can significantly change even in adults.
However, studies have revealed a strong influence of the environment on the evolution of the brain.
Most likely, the new climatic regimes will eventually form nervous systems, causing them to develop.

If Argentina abandons its own currency, it will join the nine countries that already use the dollar at the official level.
In addition to the United States itself, the currency is used by Panama (since 1904), Micronesia, the Marshall Islands and Palau (since 1944), East Timor and Ecuador (since 2000) and El Salvador (2001).
The most recent move was to the Zimbabwean dollar in 2009.

Its GDP at the end of last year amounted to 633 billion dollars, which is almost 5.5 times more than the largest economy at the moment, Ecuador ($115 billion) and 30 times larger than the Zimbabwean economy ($20.7 billion).
Like Argentina, Ecuador and Zimbabwe switched to the dollar due to high inflation.
In Ecuador, it reached 91% at the time of transition, and it took the country four years to bring it to 1.9%.
In Zimbabwe, inflation in 2008 reached 79.6 billion percent per month, but in 2009 the country moved to an annual deflation of 7.7%.
At the same time, the use of the dollar did not save the country from a new round of price growth that began in 2018, when inflation accelerated 12 times.
The Zimbabwean government even tried to abandon the dollar in 2019, but eventually extended its use until 2030.

Recent studies show that intermittent fasting can have dangerous health effects and have a negative impact on the endocrine system.
Endocrinologists warn of the risks associated with this type of diet and recommend being cautious when using it.
“Diseases of the gastrointestinal tract associated with erosive and ulcerative processes, as well as cholelithiasis can worsen against the background of interval fasting.

One of the main dangers of intermittent fasting is that it can lead to hormonal imbalance.
Fasting for long periods of time can cause stress in the body, which can lead to an increase in cortisol levels.
This can cause a variety of problems, including a change in appetite, sleep disturbance, and deterioration of the thyroid gland.
In addition, intermittent fasting can reduce the metabolic rate, which can make weight loss more difficult.
The body can begin to store energy and slow down metabolism, which can lead to a weakening of fat burning.

Deputy Mayor of Rakova: Robocats are now helping patients and doctors in Moscow hospitals
Digital transformation of healthcare continues in the capital
Deputy Mayor of Moscow for Social Development Anastasia Rakova
Doctors and patients of three hospitals in Moscow have assistants - robotic couriers.
They look cute, with cat ears and eyes, so they have already been called “robot cats ”.
Details were shared by the Deputy mayor of Moscow for social development Anastasia Rakova.
“Now in test mode in the City Clinical Hospital No. 67 named after L.A. Vorokhobov, SRI SP named after N.V. Sklifosovsky and City Clinical Hospital No. 15 named after N.V. Sklifosovsky.
O.M. Filatova patients and doctors began to help "robot cats" - said Rakova. - They are able to deliver food and medical supplies, escort patients, for example, to the elevator and to the rest room, and on the way to share useful tips on maintaining their health.

The deputy mayor recalled that the digital transformation of healthcare has been actively underway in Moscow for several years.
"What used to be high-tech and futuristic has already become ordinary everyday life, - said Rakova. - Polyclinics refuse paper documents, hospitals become" digital clinics ", doctors and patients are helped by digital services and artificial intelligence."
According to her, the capital hospitals are not the first year using robots.
Among them, for example, the most famous is DaVinci.
The current experiment confirms that robots can be not only surgical.
Robocats are equipped with video cameras, 3D sensors, as well as a battery designed for a day of continuous operation.
Such assistants are safe and reliable.

He was instructed to deliver medical products, food for children, parenteral drugs from the treatment room to the wards, medicines and supplies to the operating rooms.
And in the flagship center of the Sklifosovsky Research Institute, the “robot cat ” in the receiving department takes the things of patients and visitors to the observation room.
If the pilot project is successful, it will be expanded to other Moscow hospitals.

MOSCOW, 29 Nov — RIA Novosti, Renat Abdullin.
The winner of the presidential elections in Argentina, Javier Miley, arrived on a visit to the United States to establish contacts.
However, in Buenos Aires, judging by some reports, already refuse excessive rapprochement with Washington.
About what has changed, in the material RIA Novosti.
"Spiritual" trip
Before the inauguration more than a week, however, Miley already felt himself the owner of the country and actively took up work.
© AP Photo / Natacha PisarenkoJavier Miley
Javier Miley
The libertarian (as he positions himself) came to power with a far-right populist agenda, tied primarily to the economy.
This is a big problem in the country - inflation has exceeded 60% only since the beginning of the year.
Miley promised to literally destroy the Central Bank and move from the peso to the dollar.
He is also against joining the BRICS, which was agreed in August.
Now it's in question.
It is symptomatic that Miley made his first foreign visit to the United States.
However, as noted by the publication La Nacion, the main purpose of the trip is “spiritual ”, namely, a visit to the grave of the leader of the Lubavitcher Hasidim Menachem Mendl Schneerson in New York.
Miley has repeatedly spoken of his closeness to Jewish faith and traditions.
Then he plans to go to Israel.
The dollar will wait.
The company he was made by the former Minister of Finance of Argentina Luis Caputo (who is expected to be the head of the Ministry of Economy), as well as Nicolas Posse (likely Prime Minister).
The delegation met with representatives of the US Treasury, the International Monetary Fund (IMF), White House National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan and the US Deputy Assistant Secretary of State for Western Hemisphere Affairs.
Shortly before the trip, Miley had a telephone conversation with IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva.
The parties did not disclose the details of the conversation, but they have something to talk about: Buenos Aires owes the fund $44 billion.
On the postponement of payment in 2018 agreed Mauricio Macri, then the President of Argentina, and now one of the main allies of Miley.
As for the US representatives, according to AFP, citing sources in Buenos Aires, the purpose of the conversations with them was “to explain the economic plan of the new (Argentine) administration, including financial adjustment, monetary reform, state reform and deregulation. ”
There is no question of loans or any kind of mutual preferences.
In addition, Miley had lunch with Bill Clinton, who “is pretty much on the other side of the ideological barrier, ” notes U.S. News.
The meeting was "a particularly unexpected part of the first overseas trip."
This behavior of Miley went against his recent rhetoric and promises to switch to the dollar.
Moreover, according to the Financial Times, this idea can be shelved at all.
As the FT reminds, the newly elected president wanted to appoint Emilio Ocampo, an ardent supporter of dollarization, as head of the Argentine Central Bank.
Now, says a source close to the economist, the candidacy was withdrawn from consideration.
So, Miley does not intend to “change ” the peso to the US currency in the short term.
"Communists" - non-alternative partners
This is not the first signal about softening the position of the president compared to pre-election plans.
At the end of last week, his office called the rumors about the promised "destruction" of the Central Bank false and not negotiable.
The head of state himself noted that before the transition to the dollar, it is necessary to study "whether the situation (this) allows."
The layout on the outer perimeter also changes.
If recently Miley called the President of Brazil Lula da Silva “a communist with whom he would not deal ”, now called to the inauguration on December 10.
Foreign policy adviser Diana Mondino went to Brasilia with the appropriate invitation.
“The main message is that we are fraternal countries.
And we will remain them, ” — said the diplomat. — We must work hard together to ensure the growth of both countries. ”
“It is one thing to criticize ideology, and another to criticize the person, ” Mondino quotes Bloomberg.“ We must separate the state, the government and the people. ”

However, she did not tell whether she discussed with her Brazilian colleagues the Argentine future in the BRICS.
She added: “We are already working with almost all countries (associations). ”
One such state is China, which was also the target of criticism of the new Argentine leader.
"I am a defender of freedom, peace and democracy.
Communists, the Chinese do not relate to this, ” he said in September in an interview with American journalist Tucker Carlson.
Now Miley has changed his anger to mercy.
The other day in the social network X (former Twitter), he thanked President Xi Jinping for congratulating on his election and sent "the most sincere wishes for the well-being of the Chinese people."
Brazil and China are the main trading partners of Argentina, so the desire to maintain relations with them is understandable.
The question is how the United States will react.
Washington is used to seeing Latin America as a backyard.
But the last bet on Miley, even nicknamed the local Trump, obviously does not work yet.
