Lamborghini is the first in the industry to introduce a 4-day work week.
And raise the premiums!
Growing revenues and record sales allowed Lamborghini to be the first company in the European automotive industry to start transferring employees to a 4-day working week, while employees will receive no less, but more money.
Employees of other car companies can only envy colleagues from Lamborghini.
“Work less, work better ” – under the motto of the Italian trade union organizations announced a historic deal with Automobili Lamborghini S.p.A., whose employees will be the first in the industry to be transferred to a shortened, 4-day working week.
The transition is still incomplete, but even it will give people dozens of “extra ” free days a year.
According to Reuters, Lamborghini employees working on a rotating two-shift schedule will alternate a 5-day work week with a 4-day one, giving them 22 extra days off a year.
Employees working on a three-shift schedule, where there are night shifts, a 5-day working week will alternate with two 4-day ones, the number of days off per year for such employees will increase by 31.
In addition, Lamborghini ’ s plan to optimize the work regime implies an increase in regular bonus payments by 50% and a one-time bonus of 1,000 euros at the end of this month.
In short, the new year of seamstresses, motorists, collectors, cutters, fashion designers, cleaners, other employees of the factory in Sant ’ Agata Bolognese will meet on a high note and with excellent prospects - you can only rejoice for them.
The transition to a 4-day work week is an emerging pan-European trend, but the automotive industry does not support it yet, Lamborghini has become a pioneer in this sense.
The experience of this transition in other industries (for example, in the banking sector) shows that employees who work four days a week instead of five are better motivated, have better and better rest and therefore often achieve greater success than their colleagues who work five or more days a week.
Lamborghini today can afford the industry ’ s first experiment with reducing working hours, and even in combination with increasing employee pay.
Last year was a record year for the Italian company in terms of profit and sales, and 2023 is likely to be even more successful.
According to the results of the first three quarters of this year, Lamborghini sold 7,744 cars in the world (+ 4.2% compared to the APPG), turnover for the same period for the first time exceeded 2 billion euros, the order book is full for several years ahead.
Meanwhile, the parent brand of the Volkswagen concern, which includes the company Lamborghini, is now on the contrary - losing money, is forced to reduce costs and reduce employees.

“Sibrostock ” – with care for the health of Siberians
• 12 / 12 / 2023, 10: 00
For more than 12 years, the Novosibirsk company has been successfully developing in a fairly narrow niche of healthy food products and is constantly expanding its range.
At 100 years old, there is something to talk about.
Each brand has its own story of origin.
Family company LLC "Russian Sprout.
Siberia ", known on the market under the brand" Sibrostock ", appeared in 2011 due to the fact that its creators were looking for a way out of a personal tragic situation.
A family member had health problems, and at one of the conferences, the founder of the company, Anastasia Bessonova, met entrepreneurs from Krasnoyarsk who were engaged in the cultivation of microgreens.
- I was interested in their case, and I decided that this product can really help, - recalls Anastasia. - At that time, neither I nor my family members had any experience in doing business, business education.
In general, I was a person with a humanitarian education, far from the numbers and the economy.
I had 15 years of teaching experience in high school.
The mission of the company was formed very quickly and organically.
The goal of its existence and development, the creators of "Sibrostock" set the improvement of the inhabitants of Siberia.
- We give Siberians the opportunity to get vitamins from live greens to maintain and maintain health, - says the interlocutor Infopro54. - A week ago, I also formulated my personal mission for myself, as I realized why I have been doing this business for so many years, I promote the culture of eating microgreens, even despite the fact that this business cannot be called very profitable.
I want, if God willing and I will live to be 100 years old, to be surrounded by people about my age who will share my values and with whom I will have something to talk about.
The main problem of centenarians today is that they do not have their own circle of communication.
Everything around us is changing very quickly, and young people find themselves in a different category.
I periodically communicate with older people who are in good health, and they say that they have no one to talk to about their own.
That is why I am now forming a circle of people around me who support a healthy lifestyle, and I plan to develop it so that in 100 years we have something to talk about.
The turning point
The first time after the creation of the project "Sibrostock" was unprofitable.
However, as Anastasia Bessonova admits, at that time no one thought about profit in the family.
The main thing was to support health, and this task was eventually solved.
In 2013, two years after its creation, Lenta entered Sibrostock as part of the local supplier development program and offered cooperation.
As the entrepreneur recalls, at that time, the Novosibirsk people were completely unprepared for this.
The retailer presented a large list of requirements for products, for the technology of work, about which entrepreneurs had no idea.
— During the year, we solved this problem, connected electronic document management, changed the label, studied the information on labeling.
The work was huge then.
Moreover, "Lenta" on a gratuitous basis provided us with great support in business transformation, - says the interlocutor Infopro54. - In 2014, we began to introduce the HACCP system into production, a specialist of "Lenta" from St. Petersburg came to us, made a free audit of production, showed growth points - and a year later we met all the standards of HAASP.
Soon we signed a cooperation agreement with Lenta and reached another level of recognition and quality of work.
For our company, it was a huge progress and a step forward.
The second important milestone is that in 2018, Sibrostock began to cooperate with Auchan, which also works well with local manufacturers.
Director of the Novosibirsk "Auchan" Alexander Chirkov himself is a supporter of a healthy lifestyle and therefore willingly experiments.
At the site of the retailer, Novosibirsk residents implemented a mini-farm project so that visitors could observe the process of growing microgreens.
This was the second big step, after which the recognition and capabilities of the company increased dramatically.
The secret to success is intuition
My secret to success is strange.
I'm a humanist and I don't know much about numbers, but I have a great accountant at my company.
When we gather, she periodically says: “Nastya, we work only because you do not understand anything in mathematics.
When things are bad, I grab my head and think about what to do, and you say that you have a new idea and we will develop something new.
And then this idea shoots, ” laughs Anastasia Bessonova. – I do not know what to call this secret of success, perhaps it is intuition, but I see new niches and interesting opportunities, I see how the market opens up, I understand the prospects.
I constantly communicate with customers who travel a lot around the world and bring breakthrough ideas from their travels, give feedback.
All this allows us to continuously develop, think about what we can still offer our customers, so that not only them, but also our lives become even better.
By the way, we constantly eat our own products.
New niches
12 years ago, Sibrostock began work on a rented site of 50 square meters. Today, the company has 350 "squares" of its own production areas.
At the same time, due to the high automation of production, 13 employees work in the project, 5 of them came in 2023.
The range of products has expanded from 4 to 63 positions:
• Sprouts, from which the history of the company began.
• Microgreens, now only gaining popularity.
• Several years ago, thanks to METRO Cash and Carry, Novosibirsk residents released an interesting product - boxes of salads with microgreens and sprouts, which can be used as a snack at home or at work.
This is fast and ready food, rich in vitamins.
• Frozen semi-finished products from legumes, vegetarian cutlets (chickpeas, lentils), which the company buys "Farmer-Center" and sells under its own brand.
That is, Sibrostock is actively developing the STM direction.
• Concentrated wheat germ juice – live chlorophyll.
This direction Novosibirsk has been developing for a long time, but the product began to be popular only recently.
Now it is implemented through the "Farmer Center" and private customers, but in the future the company plans to go into large networks.
• This year, Sibrostock began to produce edible flowers.
The client told about them to entrepreneurs 5 years ago, but at that time the Siberians were not morally ready for such a product.
So far, trial batches are coming to the market, and they are in good demand among restaurateurs.
— Another area that we are implementing as part of the company ’ s mission is lessons in schools on healthy eating.
At one time, I received the education of a nutritionist, so now on a professional basis I meet with schoolchildren of different classes, talk about the culture of nutrition.
Since the beginning of September, I have taught almost 50 lessons.
We get a very positive connection from parents, - comments Anastasia Bessonova. - For example, earlier the child did not want to eat properly, and after our lesson he began to understand why he needs to eat greens, and learns to make an informed choice in favor of high-quality natural products.
Our body gets used to sugar and carbohydrates very quickly, and they are necessary for it as doping.
There is no habituation to greens, and in order to eat it, you need to make conscious efforts.
But this is for an adult.
If the child in childhood was not taught to eat greens, then this is a separate ― complex ― direction of work.
Meanwhile, 50% of our diet in Siberia should be greens and vegetables.
So our company meets the important need of Siberians in the fight against vitamin and fiber deficiency.
Ready for change
To date, Sibrostock has already issued 5 patents for its products and is preparing several more developments for licensing.
Today, the world is changing very quickly, so it is difficult to set strategic goals.
But we have a few ideas that we intend to implement.
So, in 2024, we plan to launch a line of marinades with sprouts, because I see how these products are in demand on the market.
We plan to produce vegetarian sausages from sprouts based on legumes and vegetable protein.
This requires a lot of investment, but I am sure that with the support of the center "My Business" such projects are quite feasible.
The state today helps entrepreneurs not only to see opportunities, but also gives funds for business development, ” says the interlocutor of Infopro54.
For 12 years, Sibrostock received a lot of support from the state.
Next year, the company expects to take part in another project to modernize production and launch a new line.
- We have our own free areas, where we plan to restructure the engineering equipment and install a new line for the production of sausages, - explains Anastasia Bessonova.
Now the company "Sibrostock" works for the entire Siberian region, including through partnership with large federal networks.
Novosibirsk delivers products to distribution centers of retailers, and they send it to their stores in other regions of the district.
For example, Sibrostka products can be bought in Auchan Omsk.

On Tuesday, December 12, the Minister of economy of Argentina Luis Caputo said on television about the depreciation of the peso against the US dollar from 400 pesos / $1 to 800 pesos / $1.
The devaluation of the peso will continue at a monthly rate of 2%.
How the policy of the new government will affect the place of Argentina in the international arena and what is the forecast of relations between Russia and this South American country — found out with experts “Izvestia ”.
Unprecedented measures
“Shock therapy ” is the only chance to deal with the economic crisis, there is no time for alternative measures, says the new President of Argentina Javier Miley.
The peso has been weakening for a long time.
Annual inflation exceeded 140%, the national debt amounted to $45 billion, and until the beginning of April, its maintenance will require $10.6 billion.
President of Argentina Javier Miley
Photo: Global Look Press / dpa / Guido Piotrkowski
As part of the new policy, a sharp reduction in spending on the state apparatus is also promised.
So, according to Luis Caputo, in the near future the government will cancel tenders for state projects, massively reduce the bureaucratic apparatus, cut transport and energy subsidies.
There will be no indexation of pensions.
Meanwhile, individual social programs will increase.
In the International Monetary Fund, these measures, which will “avoid disaster ”, approved.
A Long Way to Nowhere
Most of the experts interviewed described the state of the Argentine economy with the word “chaos ”.
Chaos that has a long history.
As Luis Caputo recently confirmed, the country has had a deficit budget of 113 out of the last 123 years.
The current deficit has reached 5.5% of GDP.
This is extremely much, Doctor of Economics, Senior Researcher of the Center for International Trade Studies of the RANEPA Alexander Firanchuk is sure.
“Usually the level of 3% is already considered as high, ” he said.
Argentina holds the record for the number of defaults.
The direct consequence is that the possibility of external borrowing with such a reputation is low, the country simply does not lend.
“In part, therefore, the financing of state spending was largely due to the emission of pesos, which led to high inflation — about 150%, ” says Firanchuk.
Photo: Global Look Press / dpa / Claudio Santisteban
According to the expert, attempts to hold the peso and contain inflation with a chronic budget deficit in the long term have not been successful.
The peso has depreciated about 220 times since 2000.
There are multiple courses - and this is a sure sign of the crisis, - says the respondent of the publication.
In Argentina until now, there have been several peso rates against the dollar: the official, the rate of the “black ” market, the rate for exporters, for the financial market, for tourist trips, said Alexander Potavin.
- In fact, now the authorities of Argentina bring the official course in line with the course of the black market.
That ’ s exactly what President Mauricio Macri did earlier in 2015, he says.
According to the expert, thanks to the measures of the government, the peso now goes into “free swimming ”.
“The situation is winning for local exporters, but losing for importers of preferential goods, for which dollars were sold at a discount, ” the analyst comments.
It will help or not.
The devaluation of the peso, coupled with the reduction of the budget for the maintenance of the state, are shock measures aimed at overcoming the consequences of the current crisis in the country.
This plan is painful in the short term, but it is necessary to reduce the budget deficit and reduce too high inflation, says Finam analyst Alexander Potavin.
“By devaluing the peso, the country is trying to cope with a deep budget deficit, which is largely the cause of its economic problems, ” the expert says.
Photo: Global Look Press / ZUMA Press / Claudio Santisteban
The fact that the problem can be solved in this way does not agree with the economist, director of communications at BitRiver Andrei Loboda.
According to him, the economy of Argentina over the past 120 years has been constantly under pressure, and inflation at 100-150% has become commonplace.
“The next round of devaluation of the peso is unlikely to help stabilize the economy and begin its recovery, ” the economist believes.
The main beneficiaries of the current ongoing economic crisis, he calls the key institutions of the Bretton Woods system, primarily the World Bank and the IMF.
Over the past seven years, Argentina ’ s national debt has grown by almost 50% and exceeded $275 billion.
To drive such a rich natural and human resources of the country into credit bondage and take control of the country ’ s strategic industries, including lithium mining, is a very real scenario, which is already being implemented by the US and EU stakeholders, notes Loboda with regret.
Alternative
The factor that can help Argentina out of the crisis can be the crypto industry – industrial mining.
According to Andrey Loboda, the industry has been actively developing in the country in recent years.
Photo: Izvestia / Zurab Javakhadze
— In particular, against the background of the depreciation of the national currency, bitcoin has gained popularity.
Often, the first cryptocurrency in local exchangers is traded at an overvalued rate due to high demand, he told Izvestia.
In 2023, this South American country entered the top 10 countries in terms of computing power.
What about Russia
Due to the geographical remoteness and heterogeneous structure of the economies, the international relations between Argentina and Russia are weak, the experts interviewed agree.
According to Alexander Firanchuk, the share of Argentina in the Russian trade turnover in the previous decade amounted to 0.17%.
“And there are no prerequisites for a significant development of trade with it. ”
On January 1, 2024, according to the agreements reached earlier, Argentina should join the BRICS + association.
However, these prospects with the election of President Javier Miley seem vague, says Firanchuk.
Photo: Global Look Press / imageBROKER / Jeremy Graham
Russian-Argentine economic relations can not be called smooth - estimates the head of sales and customer support department of Alfa-Forex Alexander Shneiderman.
- Year by year, the size of exports and imports could differ significantly.
Thus, according to the Argentine side, according to the results of 2021, the export of Russian products to Argentina showed a threefold increase compared to 2020 ($651 million against $166 million), and in 2022 it dipped twice ($249 million).
But in general, the trade turnover did not exceed $750 million, and by the end of 2023, a breakthrough is not expected.
Nevertheless, from the point of view of the expert, Argentina is a country that has not severed either economic or political relations.
“Russia needs to maintain and increase the pool of business partners as much as possible, ” the speaker added.

“No money ”: the new President of Argentina introduced the first economic reforms
Elena Kondratieva about the shock measures of Javier Miley in a country with 40% poverty
President of Argentina Javier Miley
Argentina ’ s new president, Javier Miley, in his first speech as head of state, warned the country of the need for shock measures, and in December the first phase of his plan to save the economy took shape.
True, it does not contain many election promises and there are things absolutely opposite – the new government is going to raise export duties and taxes contrary to the ideals of libertarianism, which the Argentine leader calls himself a representative of.
The authorities attribute the inconsistencies to the difficult economic situation, which requires the adoption of unpopular measures.
Both Miley and his economy minister, Luis Caputo, said the measures they were taking ran counter to their beliefs.
But, according to them, this is the lesser evil – on the other side of the scale they call hyperinflation and catastrophic impoverishment of the population.
On the third day of the government, December 13, Caputo announced the first steps of the new government, including a devaluation - the official rate of the dollar soared from 366 pesos to 800 pesos.
Currency restrictions in force in the country since 2019 have been maintained.
The authorities admit that there are no conditions for their cancellation until the government solves the problem with the debt instruments of the Central Bank.
Nevertheless, the devaluation, stronger than many experts and ordinary people expected, allowed to narrow the gap between the official and the so-called blue exchange rate, which is used in the informal exchange market.
Today, the latter is about 1,000 pesos per dollar.
About the same time he was on the eve of the announcement of Caputo.
The devaluation, combined with the end of the programs of freezing of prices, spurred the already high inflation.
According to experts, by the end of December it will be about 30%.
In November, the price increase was 12.8%.
Miley ’ s government calls its main task for next year a zero budget deficit.
The task is extremely ambitious, given that in October the International Monetary Fund (IMF) predicted that Argentina, with the necessary reforms, will be able to reach a surplus budget only by 2028.
To achieve this goal, the new government, apparently, will have to work hard with the same chainsaw, which has become a symbol of Miley ’ s election campaign.
In the course of the election campaign, the president has already emphasized that the state and the so-called caste, the establishment of the country, will pay for his spending reduction program, and "people will not be touched."
As the first measures show, this principle has proved to be very broadly interpreted.
So, among the first measures, Caputo announced the gradual abolition of subsidies for electricity, gas and public transport.
Today, Argentinian households with low and middle incomes pay about 15-20% of the cost of electricity.
According to the plan of the authorities, the subsidies will be completely abolished by December 2026, but in 2024 they are going to spend $2.5 billion less on them.
Transportation subsidies are expected to save $1 billion next year.
Another article for saving will be government orders for infrastructure projects.
The government promises to abandon them completely.
“There is no money ” is a phrase that Miley constantly repeats and which his supporters print on T-shirts.
Reductions also affected the state apparatus.
The government of Miley changed the number of ministries from 18 to 9, almost halved the number of departments and announced the termination of more than 5 thousand labor contracts concluded in 2023.
Reforms signed by the President
The next step of the Mileus government was an emergency presidential decree, which was signed on December 20.
The Argentine Constitution gives the Head of State the power to change legislation without the prior approval of Parliament in an exceptional situation.
Miley, under this pretext, decided to include in the decree more than 300 articles that cancel or amend existing laws.
The head of state called the main goal of the document deregulation of the economy
For example, the government abolished price controls, including on food and health insurance programs.
Suppliers of the latter after the publication of the decree have already announced an increase in the cost of services by 40%.
Introducing his decree, Miley said that the state will no longer be able to restrict exports.
Deregulation also affected the aviation industry, the rental market, labor relations, tourism and various industries, including wine and sugar.
Some paragraphs raised serious questions about the justification of their inclusion in the emergency decree.
Thus, the document gives football clubs the right to become joint-stock companies.
Miley himself in an interview with LN + explained the need for this item by the fact that the measure will attract foreign investment to the country.
For the sake of investment, the government also repealed a law restricting the ownership of land by foreigners.
The decree is due to come into force on December 29 and can only be repealed by parliament if both chambers vote in favor.
It is not yet clear what will happen to the bill in Congress.
Miley's "Freedom Comes" coalition holds 37 of 257 seats in the Chamber of Deputies and 8 of 72 in the Senate.
They have allies in the opposition, mainly in the Alliance Together for Change (24 senators and 93 deputies), but they may not be enough.
The public also met the decree ambiguously, although Miley himself believes that he can successfully bring it to a referendum if blocked by parliament.
After the announcement of the reform in different parts of the capital, there was a noise from blows to pots - a traditional form of protest in Latin America.
In addition, opposition to the decree was expressed by the largest trade unions in Argentina, not excluding the strike, restrictions on which, incidentally, were imposed by the signed decree.
Mega-bill
Miley ’ s government completed the month with the introduction of a bill to parliament with a package of reforms covering not only the economy, but also criminal law, as well as electoral law, health care, education and defense.
In total, the document contains more than 660 articles.
Especially for its consideration, the executive branch convened an extraordinary session of parliament, which will last from December 26 to January 31.
Among the proposed reforms, I will highlight the increase in export duties.
In his first speech as head of state, Miley promised that the tightening of belts will fall on the shoulders of the state, not private business.
Nevertheless, the first package of bills included the establishment of a duty of 15% for agricultural products, which are now not subject to fees, and an increase from 31% to 33% of the duty for flour and oil.
The authorities promise to subsequently cancel the fees from exporters, but for now the government, they say, needs funds to get rid of the budget deficit.
There is no deadline for the fulfillment of the promise made to exporters.
The bill also included a tax amnesty and the privatization of 41 state-owned companies, including oil and gas YPF, airline Aerolineas Argentinas, Banco Nación Bank, geostationary communications operator ARSAT and railway company Ferrocarriles Argentinos.
Miley noted that the YPF process will take place after reforms within the company, which should increase its value.
This will be his second privatisation.
In 2012, the government of Cristina Fernández de Kirchner decided to return YPF into the hands of the state, expropriating 51% of the shares of the Spanish company Repsol under the pretext of insufficient investment in the country ’ s oil and gas sector.
The conflict with the Spaniards was settled by the payment of compensation in the amount of $5 billion back in 2014, but in 2023 the consequences of the expropriation made themselves felt again – in September, the court of the southern district of New York ordered Argentina to pay $16 billion to the Burford Capital fund, which bought the bankrupt after the nationalization of the company, which owned 25% of the shares of YPF.
Miley ’ s emergency decree stated that the state ’ s share in Aerolineas Argentina ’ s shares would be transferred to its employees.
After that, the country ’ s largest airline, which has also been through privatization and renationalization, will stop receiving support from the budget, thanks to which, in particular, air traffic on not the most popular routes was maintained.
Given the emergence of new competitors in the context of deregulation of the aviation industry, Aerolineas Argentina is likely to be forced to reduce the number of destinations in the country.
At the same time, despite the declared "No Money", the bill provides for a reduction in tax on personal property and exemption from tax on the sale of real estate purchased before 2018.
Where to find money
The bill also included a painful topic for Argentina's foreign debt.
The government proposes to abolish the rule that obliges the executive branch to obtain permission from Parliament to issue dollar bonds in excess of the amount specified in the budget.
Argentina ’ s debt remains an acute problem for the country.
On December 21, the country made another payment as part of an agreement to settle its debt to the IMF.
The loan was issued to the country at the request of Mauricio Macri, who in May 2018, as head of state, turned to the IMF for help against the background of a sharp fall in the national currency.
The funds for the December tranche of $921 million to Argentina were provided by the Andean Development Corporation (ACR).
The country cannot afford to pay from its own reserves.
Already in the period from January 9 to February 1, 2024, Argentina will have to make new payments totaling more than $2.8 billion.
The government is trying to negotiate with the fund to change the agreement, but this does not negate the need to find funds to repay the payments.
One of the sources could be the $6.5 billion currency swap that China has promised to provide to the past government of Argentina.
The Miley administration is trying to gain access to it, but there seems to be little progress so far.
The situation for Argentina is complicated by the numerous statements of Miley and members of his coalition about relations with China.
During the election campaign and after the election, the head of state repeatedly said that he did not intend to promote relations with Beijing, because he did not want to do business with the Communists.
In addition, the foreign Minister of Argentina Diana Mondino said that the country will not enter the BRICS, where it was accepted at the end of the August summit of the group.
Beijing may also be concerned about the Miley administration ’ s refusal to accept government orders for infrastructure projects that fall under the purview of Chinese investors.
After taking office, Javier Miley and his team tried to mitigate past statements.
The new administration invited Chinese President Xi Jinping to the inauguration, which took place on December 10.
He himself, however, did not come, but Miley held a meeting with the Chinese delegation and sent a letter to the Chinese leader, in which he asked him to help gain access to the currency swap.
Another source of financing for Argentina could be the New Development Bank (NDB) of the BRICS, a formal application for accession to which was submitted in October by the then President of the country Alberto Fernandez.
However, the Miley administration apparently decided to freeze the process, since at the end of November Mondino said that Argentina was unable to join the NDB due to the inability to contribute capital.
It is possible that the government of Miley will decide to change its position, but so far this has not been reported.

How the development will bring closer the emergence of a domestic quantum computer

Russian scientists have launched and tested the first domestic 12-qubit quantum processor on superconductors.
While the development will be used exclusively for research purposes, it brings closer the creation of a quantum computer that will be able to solve problems that are inaccessible to modern computers.
Work on the processor took scientists about a year.
Their next step will be to create a 16-qubit device.
According to experts, the result obtained can be called a noticeable success on the way to creating a technology for the production of quantum devices with hundreds of qubits.
Count to 12
Specialists of the Moscow University of Physics and Technology (MIPT) began testing Russia ’ s first 12-qubit quantum processor based on superconductors (materials conducting electric current without resistance and loss of electricity), the computing elements of which are made of pure aluminum.
The development process took about a year.
By the end of 2024, scientists plan to present the first 16-qubit processor created using the same technology.
According to experts, these days, scientists around the world are working on the creation of quantum processors.
These are computing devices, the principle of which is based on the phenomena of quantum mechanics.
In the future, they will be able to be used in quantum computers, which are designed to solve problems that are not able to cope with the usual electronic computers.
This is, for example, the modeling of natural processes or very complex mathematical calculations.
The direction of so-called quantum machine learning is also actively developing.
In a classical computer, the unit of information is a bit — an element that can be either “turned on ” or“ turned off. ”
In a quantum device, this role is performed by a qubit, which can be in two states at the same time.
This opens up new opportunities for the creation of innovative computers.
For us, this is another stage, another important step.
Phystech already has a well-established technology with which we produced five-qubit and eight-qubit quantum chips.
This is a complex process, including, in particular, electronic lithography.
But this time we had to change the technological drawings, because instead of linear we used a two-dimensional architecture of the scheme, — said senior researcher of the laboratory of artificial quantum systems MIPT Gleb Fedorov.
That is, previous versions of the processors were built as a one-dimensional line - a chain with a connection of only the nearest neighbors, and the 12-qubit version - two-dimensional, located on a plane, the scientist explained.
Over the past year, scientists have been developing blueprints for the processor, calculating its electromagnetic characteristics.
Then they carried out quantum-mechanical calculations and in several stages produced samples, and then measured their parameters in room conditions.
The final version was received after the fourth repetition.
Development opportunities are already being tested in practice.
A quantum integrated circuit is the “heart ” of a prototype computing device consisting of a classical computer and a quantum accelerator.
Now the system is being tested: learning algorithms for a quantum neural network are being launched.
The program can determine the variety of wine by its chemical composition and make medical diagnoses.
The tests are necessary for a detailed comparison of the characteristics of the new system with the results obtained by scientists earlier on an eight-qubit sample.
In the third dimension
According to scientists, while their invention can only be used for research purposes.
For practical application and the achievement of new computing capabilities, a quantum processor of at least 100 qubits is required.
But to create it, you need equipment that allows you to place elements in three dimensions, and not only on the plane.
Now it is produced only in a few countries that are not friendly to us, such as Germany and South Korea.
However, Russian developers are trying to find an opportunity to buy it.
With the help of these devices, it is possible to approach the control lines individually to each qubit much more freely than with a two-dimensional architecture.
This avoids the crosstalk that occurs when the signal lines are crossed and prevents the correct control of the device.
Work on the creation of prototypes of quantum computers and simulators is underway at MIPT as part of the implementation of the Quantum Computing Roadmap for 2021-2024.
The launch of a 12-qubit processor is an important achievement, because it is the most powerful superconductor processor that is now in Russia, said Stanislav Straupe, associate professor of the Faculty of Physics of Moscow State University, head of the scientific group of the Russian Quantum Center.
This is another step towards further scaling.
IBM and Google already have processors with hundreds of qubits, but there ’ s a long way to go to get these results.
This is necessary to have both the technology of manufacturing processors, and the electronics controlling them.
The transition from eight qubits to 12 is a gradual movement in this direction.
Further exponential growth is possible, ” said Stanislav Straupe.
The new processor is a good result for Russian science, as it opens up prospects for building medium-scale quantum computers.
Here we have something to strive for: in the world, this technology is developed somewhat better, said Sergey Kulik, Scientific Director of the Laboratory of Quantum Optical Technologies of Lomonosov Moscow State University.
In December 2023, IBM announced the creation of a 1121-qubit computer, that is, two orders of magnitude more than our achievement.
But for the development of scientific research, any increase in the number of qubits is an important step, ” said Sergey Kulik.
The strengths of the development include multi-stage study, including theoretical and numerical calculations, the manufacture of prototypes and the measurement of their properties, said Nikolai Ushakov, associate professor at the Higher School of Applied Physics and Space Technologies of SPbPU.
— The ability to use standard microelectronic technologies in the basis of the manufacture of such a processor is an important factor in the further scaling of the processor.
Since for the implementation of a full-fledged, close to universal quantum device, it is necessary, first, to ensure the desired state of all qubits, and secondly, to achieve the joint evolution of their states, he said.
The next development of MIPT scientists - a 16-qubit processor - will also be two-dimensional.
When creating it, scientists intend to focus on the accuracy of calculations and the correct simultaneous operation of all computing elements, which is no less important than their number.

Is China ’ s military aircraft capable of countering the US Air Force?
In the new conditions of the international situation, domination of airspace is becoming more and more relevant.
The political and military leadership of the leading scientific-technical countries pays close attention to the development of national air forces, which in many countries are the most advanced component of the armed forces.
At the same time, the most significant results in the development of the air force (both qualitatively and quantitatively) have been achieved in recent decades by two countries - the United States and China.
In the military conflicts of the XXI century, the aircraft of the US Air Force and the PRC did not take part in air battles against each other.
This fact makes it problematic to compare the real combat capabilities of the aircraft (LA) of the two countries.
Most of the comparative assessments of experts regarding the American and Chinese military aviation are subjective and are based mainly on the study of the declared tactical and technical characteristics.
At the same time, the tasks, goals, development plans of the air forces of the two countries remain outside the estimates, as well as possible military conflicts in which the aircraft of the two countries can meet in battle.
MILITARY WINGS OF AMERICA
An analysis of the composition of the US Air Force fleet, according to the annual bulletin reviewing the military capabilities of the world's states, The Military Balance 2023, shows that at the beginning of this year, the US Air Force had 328,600 active personnel.
In addition, 117,497 were in reserve, and 106,700 were in the US National Guard Air Force.
In service there were 4093 manned aircraft (as well as 1289 in the Air National Guard and 396 in reserve), 156 unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), 2130 air-launched cruise missiles (ALCMs), 450 intercontinental ballistic missiles (ICBMs).
A study of the official website of the US Department of Defense shows that the unpredictable military-political situation forces the US leadership to continuously improve the national air force.
In particular, the US Air Force has the largest fleet of strategic bomber aircraft in the world.
According to The Military Balance for 2023, the US Air Force is armed with B-52H, B-2A and B-1B bombers.
At the same time, according to experts, B-1B aircraft are reoriented to perform non-nuclear tasks.
The fleet of strategic American bombers allows you to operate beyond the reach of enemy air defense assets.
Today, only B-2A bombers have sufficient range and are able to penetrate with impunity into areas protected by modern air defense and missile defense systems.
But the fleet of such aircraft is not enough to defeat all targets in the Asia-Pacific theater of operations, which the US military and political leadership considers a priority in the 21st century.
At the same time, not all indicators of this component of the US Armed Forces speak of unambiguous American superiority in the air.
So, for 2024, it is planned to write off at least 310 aircraft (150 were on the list for 2023), but the US Congress does not fully approve these plans.
In particular, the Americans want to get rid of 42 A-10 Thunderbolt II attack aircraft, whose survivability on the modern battlefield is questionable.
It is also expected to decommission 260 fighters by 2028.
This list includes 57 F-15C / D Eagle aircraft under the age of 40 years.
They are planned to be partially replaced by the F-35A and F-15EX after complete decommissioning by 2026.
Maybe even the F-15E.
Their reduction is expected in 2025.
Some F-22As will also be decommissioned, namely 32 Block 20 units decommissioned and used exclusively for training purposes.
Further reductions will affect the aircraft long-range radar detection (AWACS) E-3G, of which at the moment 13 decommissioned.
It is planned to get rid of the last 24 KC-10 Extender tankers.
Also considered superfluous are the last three combat control and targeting aircraft E-8 Joint STARS, 48 modular reconnaissance and strike drones MQ-9 Reaper Block 1, three “aircraft of psychological warfare ” EC-130J Commando Solo and three almost museum light bombers A-29.
In terms of helicopters, the US Air Force intends to abandon 37 HH-60G Pave Hawk aircraft, which will be gradually replaced by the HH-60W Jolly Green II.
52 T-1 Jayhawk (Beechjet business jets) are also to be reduced.
Finally, the decision was made not to repair one B-1B after the engine fire, leaving 44 such bombers in the fleet operating.
NOAC AIR ARMADS
According to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI), in terms of the quantitative composition for 2023, the PLA aircraft fleet is in third place in the world.
As for the qualitative composition, the percentage of aircraft of previous generations and foreign production is still quite high.
The PLA bomber aircraft is 100% equipped with more than once modernized, but obsolete aircraft "Hun-6".
In tactical aviation, up to 70% falls on aircraft such as “Jian-7 ”,“ Jian-8 ”, “Jianghong 7 ” and“ Qiang-5 ” (they are gradually withdrawn from the Air Force).
At the same time, China is experiencing a shortage of heavy transport aircraft, patrol aircraft and tanker aircraft.
Since the beginning of the 2000s, a systematic qualitative improvement of the PLA air fleet has been carried out.
It became possible not only due to the purchase of foreign aircraft and the deployment of licensed production at national enterprises, but also the creation of their own models of aircraft on their basis (and in many cases copying).
Chinese engineers are trying to get the most advanced technologies from the leading (especially in terms of engine building and the development of on-board equipment) states in order to master them and create the latest competitive samples of national aircraft.
The re-equipment of the aircraft fleet is also linked to the implementation of the reform of the Chinese Armed Forces, which is divided into three stages: 2000-2020, 2021-2035 and 2036-2049.
At the first stage, the number of personnel and obsolete equipment was reduced, work on the modernization of existing and the development of new models of weapons and military equipment was intensified.
The tasks of the second and third stages are to reach the level of the leading countries of the world.
According to the British publication Jane ’ s Information Group, the military-political leadership of China not only retains the combat capabilities of old aircraft, but also initiates the development of new models – for example, strategic bombers.
Modification of the bomber "Hun-6" has the designation "Hun-6K" and significant differences from the previous versions.
In the bow (in front of the cockpit), a long-range detection and fire control radar is installed.
"Hun-6K" uses Russian turbofan engines D-30KP-2 with a capacity of 12 thousand kgf / cm2, which have changed the shape and size of the air intakes.
The study of SIPRI databases allows us to state that currently the designers of the Xi'an Aircraft Manufacturing Enterprise are developing the first strategic supersonic stealth bomber under the designation "Hong-20" (the number 20 indicates a maximum speed of 2.0 MAX).
COMPARISON OF POTENTIALS
According to the SIPRI Institute, today the US Air Force is much more powerful than the Chinese Air Force already due to the tactical and technical characteristics of the aircraft used.
The British resource FlightGlobal published a report according to which the United States retains the advantage, having more than 13 thousand military aircraft, 5,163 of which are operated by the US Air Force.
American fighters F-35 Lightning and F-22 Raptor are considered one of the most advanced combat in the world.
China ’ s air force is the third largest in the world with more than 2,500 aircraft, of which about 2,000 are combat aircraft (according to China ’ s 2022 Military Power Report).
Thus, the obvious strategic air superiority is on the US side.
Although China is rapidly increasing its power and stubbornly creates promising models of weapons.
The Pentagon and the American aviation industry so far demonstrate a clear superiority in terms of aircraft of the latest generations.
According to open sources, the United States in 2017 produced 50 multi-role aircraft of the 5th generation F-35 and 26 aircraft of the 4th generation F-18.
In 2018, 70 F-35s and about 14 F-18s were built in the United States.
On average, the United States produces between 75 and 85 jet fighters per year.
In addition, in these years, other military aircraft for various purposes were produced in the United States.
Among them are 15 KC-46A tankers, five E-2D Advanced Hawkeye AWACS aircraft, 24 P8A reconnaissance and jammer aircraft, 28 C-130J transport aircraft.
In total, the United States produces about 130 manned aircraft annually, not counting helicopters.
Analysts give cautious estimates of the quantitative indicators of the Chinese aviation program, explaining its traditional Chinese closeness.
According to their estimates, China built approximately 100 aircraft in 2017, including two-thirds of combat aircraft.
China plans to establish the production of the fifth-generation J-31 aircraft and the J-20 stealth fighter.
China ’ s military budget is expected to double by 2030.
It is growing at a rate of about 5-10% per year.
Therefore, China can catch up with the United States in terms of production of fifth-generation aircraft by 2025.
But so far, the United States is ahead of both Russia and China in terms of the construction of fifth-generation aircraft.
Today, China has about 700 fourth-generation combat aircraft and up to 25 fifth-generation fighters.
By 2025, China will be able to increase the number of 4th generation aircraft to 1,100 and have from 60 to 120 5th generation aircraft.
By 2030, China may already have 1,200 – 1,600 generation “4 ” aircraft and 200 – 500 generation“ 5 ” aircraft.
The U.S. Air Force has about 450 5th generation aircraft (F-22 and F-35) and approximately 1,500 Generation 4 and 4 + aircraft (F-16 and F15s).
Plus, the US Navy has about 800 F-18s, and the Marine Corps has 260 F-18s.
It is estimated that the US will have approximately 1,000 5th generation aircraft in 2025 and up to 1,500 in 2030.
IF THE WAR IS TOMORROW
In the annual report of the US Department of Defense to Congress for 2023, “Military and security events with the participation of China, ” it is noted that the most possible scenario of a collision between the US Air Force and the PLA Air Force in real combat may be tension in the Taiwan Strait.
As part of its offensive operations, the Chinese Air Force can launch missile and air strikes against American targets and those of its allies in the region.
It is noted that the joint offensive operation of the PLA will include missile and air strikes, cyber attacks and a blockade of the island.
The objectives of the operation will be to limit Taiwan's defensive capabilities, as well as to suppress the morale of the island's population and break its ties with the outside world.
The latest report by the US International Center for Strategic Studies (CSIS), “China Strategy and Armed Forces in 2023, ” noted that the main goal of the Chinese is to destroy the island ’ s air defense system, missile bases, military airfields and aircraft located on the runways and hangars of Taiwan.
The main goal of the PLA at this stage is to gain air superiority.
US military experts claim that China is capable of launching missile and air strikes, as well as conducting an offensive operation in cyberspace.
Another possible option is to launch missile strikes against command posts and critical infrastructure, followed by a rapid airborne and naval landing operation, as well as the seizure of Taiwanese military facilities by Chinese special forces.
In this case, the PLA will have difficulty attacking without warning.
WHERE THE UNITED STATES WILL RESPOND
The analysis of open sources shows that against the background of escalating confrontation between the great powers and general turbulence in the field of security, the Pentagon continues to reorganize the national air force.
First of all, we are talking about the confrontation between the United States and China in the Asia-Pacific region.
The changes will affect the organization, equipment and training of the US Air Force.
The top leadership of the United States approved the formation of three new air force tactical groups, which represent the implementation of the experiment for the deployment of integrated units.
Two of these groups will be under the control of the Central Command of the US Armed Forces, whose area of ​ ​ operational responsibility primarily includes the Middle East.
The third group will be subordinated to the Indo-Pacific Command.
In the foreseeable future, these are precisely the locations where the US Air Force and the PLA Air Force will compete for air supremacy.
CONCLUSIONS AND SYNTHESIS
As a result of comparing the US Air Force and the PLA Air Force, it is possible to draw the following conclusions and generalizations:
1.
The political and military leadership of both the United States and China pays close attention to the development of new models of combat aircraft.
It is believed that the presence of modern aircraft in the national air forces of both countries will allow to hit enemy targets outside the range of air and missile defense systems.
2.
The presence of US and PRC aircraft bomber aircraft allows in peacetime to perform the task of nuclear strategic deterrence.
Given the possible unacceptable damage, a potential enemy (represented by the United States and China) will be forced to refuse to participate in hostilities in advance.
3.
The conflict in Ukraine is the first case in history where the situational awareness of even junior commanders is absolute.
The main part of the samples of aircraft, consisting of the military aviation fleet, is produced in China at the national enterprises of the defense industry.
Despite the fact that a significant part of the fleet consists of aircraft with a development period of more than 30 years, some of these samples have not exhausted the opportunities for modernization.
4.
Regular work on the modernization of aircraft and helicopters allows China to significantly improve the flight performance and operational characteristics of the existing fleet.
In particular, this applies to auxiliary aircraft: military transport and special vehicles on their base, multi-purpose helicopters.
As for combat aircraft, at present, the Chinese aircraft industry provides their annual production in the amount that allows for the planned re-equipment of aviation parts with new types of aircraft, as well as their repair and modernization.

In St. Petersburg, scientists trained the neural network to recognize emotional speech
The training was based on interviews with victims of the Holocaust.
ST. PETERSBURG, January 26.
/ TASS /.
Scientists of St. Petersburg State University (SPbU) have taught the neural network to recognize the speech of people who talk about a strong emotional shock.
She was trained on the basis of interviews with victims of the Holocaust, TASS reported in the press service of the university.
Linguists at St. Petersburg State University have modified the Wav2Vec 2.0 neural network, “teaching ” it to recognize the speech of people who talk about the strong emotional shock they experienced.
The neural network was trained in interviews with Holocaust victims recorded by the Yad Vashem Holocaust Memorial Complex Foundation, "the report said.
Speech recognition is an important task for computer automatic systems, as it allows you to form subtitles, generate a retelling of basic thoughts.
Modern technologies allow you to do this, but when a person in his speech clearly expresses emotions, cries or shouts loudly, the task becomes much more complicated.
According to the press service, SPbU scientists found a way to solve the problem and were able to train the Russian-language model of speech recognition of Professor of Novosibirsk State University Ivan Bondarenko on the materials of interviews with victims of the Holocaust, which are published in public access by the Israeli state national memorial Yad Vashem.
Video testimonies have been collected by the memorial for more than 50 years, where people talk about the events they witnessed.
SPbU specialists processed more than 26 hours of conversations.
To do this, a sociolinguistic markup was compiled, gender, age, approximate region of origin and mother tongue of the interviewees were determined.
As the experts explained, these signs significantly affect the accent with which people speak, what vocabulary they use, and how qualitatively their speech will be recognized by automatic models.
As a result, the technology is applicable to recordings of other people, but the quality of recognition may differ due to different recording conditions and in the case of speech was poorly represented in the sample, such as child speech.
"We used the deep neural network Wav2Vec 2.0, which was trained in Russian.
The idea of ​ ​ her work is to learn how to match each sound of a person ’ s oral speech with the corresponding letter of the alphabet.
Specifically, this architecture of the neural network also uses the so-called attention mechanism in order to learn to “pay attention ” to the significant signs for determining a particular letter by sound, which significantly improves the quality of the result, ” said Mikhail Dolgushin, a graduate student of the Department of Mathematical Linguistics at St. Petersburg State University.

This is the directorial debut of a California couple Sam and Andy Zucchero ’ s “Love Me ” – science fiction with an intriguing plot.

Alfred P. Sloan for his outstanding portrayal of technology and science in film.
The main roles in it are played by almost the most fashionable actors of our time, Kristen Stewart and Stephen Ian, and they play a smart buoy and an orbital satellite.
The plot of this enchanting story is like this.
A few centuries after the death of mankind in a global catastrophe swaying on the waves of the Hudson buoy trying to establish a connection with at least someone or something.
And stumbles upon a signal from an orbiting satellite aimed at searching for any form of life in the universe and overflowing with information about humanity.
Since a new acquaintance is interested only in organic matter, the buoy finds a popular blogger ’ s website on the Internet and is represented by it.
And then persuades the satellite to simulate a virtual room and communicate with avatars.
Moreover, the blogger has a husband, and the satellite can take his form.
The relationship of people, this rattling couple imagines by posts in social networks.
Not knowing that this is not a real relationship, but a fabricated presentation of a beautiful life.
Which will not prevent them from achieving a real feeling and carrying it through a few billion years, until the earth collapses in the sun.
This movie is an obvious homage to the famous Pixar WALL-E animated film.
Hence the very acquaintance of the two mechanisms on the deserted Earth, where one of them arrived in order to find life, and quickly lost interest in everything else.
Moreover, here both characters do not seem anthropomorphic at all, and this is bold from the point of view of design.
After all, Pixar animators at one time actively worked just to humanize their heroes.

Like any great movie or book, Love Me offers many associations and interpretations.
It is about our obsession with social networks and what will remain in them after us, and how outsiders will interpret all this.
That is, the avatars chosen by the heroes seem cute, but in fact they are based on bloggers and their cats, which in the Network is an order of magnitude more than something serious, which means that in the future the descendants, studying us, will stumble upon cats in the first place.
And about how we socialize and how different media shape our expectations about relationships and marriage.
But first of all, it is still fiction - about the apocalypse and the death of mankind, about the possibility for the remaining mechanisms or even an alien mind to understand us and reconstruct our meaning to such an extent that the reconstruction turns into a new life.
And our perception of time.
In the opening shots in front of the viewer flashes the birth of the Earth and the Moon, an asteroid and dinosaurs, the appearance of noisy humanity and its equally noisy disappearance.
In this first minute, all our nothingness against the background of the time by which the universe lives.
And yet we were.

Jane Goodall is a British ethologist, primatologist and anthropologist, UN Peace Ambassador, and an honorary member of the Council for the Future of Peace (a German non-profit foundation created with the goal of passing on a healthy planet with a just and peaceful society) to the next generations.
On February 4, the author of the Telegram channel “Voice of Mordor ” (41,000 views at the time of writing this analysis) specifically for the TV channel“ 360 ” (72,000) published a column about the proposed proposal of the scientist.
In the text, the blogger clarifies: Goodall made such a statement at the World Economic Forum in Davos, which was held in mid-January 2024.
"It turns out that solving the climate issue is quite simple - you just need to reduce the population of the Earth by... 90%.
Of course, Jane doesn ’ t suggest directly killing 90% of the people on Earth, ” says the text, which is still titled “Kill 90% of the world ’ s population ” on the 360 website.
The environmental agenda has driven the West crazy. ”
Moreover, at the beginning of the material it is separately said: “Biologist Goodall is ready to kill 90% of earthlings for the sake of climate ” .In the Telegram channel of the leading“ First channel ” Olesya Loseva (25,000 views) the following quote is given: “If we reduce the population by 90%, we can reach zero level of climate change ”.
At the same time, the post clarifies: “Although she said (Goodall – Approx. ed.) it is a long time, but the essence does not change. ”
As proof, Loseva cited a screenshot of a December news article by Slay News — this ultra-conservative English-language resource systematically disseminates disinformation and conspiracy theories, including fakes about the WEF.
The online edition, in turn, referred to a tweet swirling in September 2023 with a 15-second recording of Goodall ’ s performance, which scored almost 2 million views.
Similar publications appeared in the Telegram channels Banksta (107,000 views), Anatoly Nesmiyan (64,000), Fund for Strategic Culture (24,000) and Zapashny (12,000).
For example, in May 2023 about the “assumption ” of the scientist that“ all problems of mankind will be solved if the population of the Earth will decrease by 90% ”, wrote the Telegram-channels “Militarist ” (98,000 views),“ Zhirinovsky ’ s Notes ” (55,000), “What ’ s happening? ” (55,000),“ Bad news ” (47,000), “Freshness ” (25,000), Lomovka (19,000) and others.
In December 2022, businessman Elon Musk commented on one of the similar posts that appeared then on Twitter: “This philosophy is the death of humanity. ”
However, the most popular video was back in July 2022, but then the publications quoted another quote: “We can ’ t hide from the growth of the human population, because you know that this is at the heart of all the problems.
Such records were placed by Telegram-channels “Russia Now ” (248,000 views),“ Special Operation Z ” | Yuri Podolyaka + “(199,000), Voblya (150,000), MediaPost (102,000),“ RIA Katyusha ” (92,000), “Skeptic ” (92,000)“ Buyan – What ’ s in the World? ” (73,000), “DPR Info ” (71,000), TG Team Russia (63,000),“ Patron ” (60,000), “First Kharkiv ” (59,000),“ Andrey Fursov ” (55,000), “Saffron ” (24,000),“ Ukraine. (24,000), Zapashny (21,000), Kuchera (18,000) and Yana Poplavskaya (11,000).
Among the media, the alleged Goodall proposal was reported by the Public News Service, Morning South (it is specified that the scientist made a statement at the WEF 2022), Tsargrad, as well as Shari.net.
Former State Duma deputy Valery Rashkin wrote in his column on the CPRF party ’ s website that Goodall “publicly advocated a 90 percent reduction in the world ’ s population ” from the rostrum of the WEF on July 28, 2022.
In addition, the news has become popular in “Vkontakte ” (examples here, here and here).
In 2022, the World Economic Forum was held not in the summer, but in the spring - from May 22 to 26, but the viral video was not filmed during this event.
In fact, the Network is distributing a video recorded at the Davos summit in January 2020.
The public discussion with the participation of the British scientist was devoted to ensuring a sustainable future for the countries of the Amazon.
A 40-minute recording of the discussion was published on the official YouTube channel of the WEF, and at 31: 37, Goodall utters the phrase from the viral video:
We cannot hide from population growth because it is at the root of many other problems.
All these things we are talking about would not be a problem if the world ’ s population was the same as 500 years ago.
Neither in this quote, nor during the entire discussion, did the scientist state or suggest that the population of the Earth should be reduced by 90% and that this would solve all the world's problems.
She only noted that, together with population growth, people face the challenges associated with this process.
The authors of most of the above publications either misunderstood Goodall ’ s words or deliberately misinterpreted them, even when quoting her correctly.
In addition, there is another error in the misinterpretation of the quotation.
According to the UN, in November 2022, the world population reached 8 billion people and is expected to grow until the last quarter of the 21st century.
That is, 10% of the current level is slightly more than 800 million people.
According to various studies, 500 years ago, that is, at the beginning of the XVI century, the number of people on the planet was in the range of 400 – 600 million – about 5 – 7.5% of the 8 billion.

This article was originally published in English
The Japanese authorities intend to introduce a new type of visa - a digital nomad.
It will allow you to stay in the country for up to six months and work remotely.
ADVERTISING
Japan is preparing to launch a digital nomad visa in March.
It will allow citizens of 49 countries, including EU member states, to stay in the country for up to six months.
With vibrant cities, diverse natural landscapes and world-famous pop culture, Japan is the perfect place to combine work and travel.
The country is increasingly opening up to foreigners in the hope of developing the economy and international competitiveness threatened by an aging population.
According to Japan ’ s labor ministry, there are more than two million foreign workers in the country, the highest figure in Japanese history.
Here ’ s everything you need to know about Japan ’ s new digital nomad visa, including who can apply and what the conditions are.
Who can apply for a Japanese digital nomad visa?
Citizens of 49 countries and territories are eligible to apply for a Japanese digital nomad visa.
These include countries that have signed a tax treaty with Japan, as well as those whose citizens do not need to obtain a visa when visiting Japan.
This includes all EU countries, as well as Armenia, Belarus, Georgia, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Moldova, Monaco, North Macedonia, Norway, Serbia, Switzerland, Turkey and the United Kingdom.
Outside of Europe, Australians, South Koreans, Singaporeans and US citizens can also apply.
The visa is aimed at highly qualified specialists – especially those who work in the field of information technology.
It will be issued for “certain activities, ” including working remotely for a company outside of Japan or as a self-employed freelancer for clients overseas.
It is expected that this will also extend to YouTube bloggers receiving income from overseas advertisers.
How much do I need to earn to get a digital nomad visa to Japan?
Applicants for a digital nomad visa must have an annual income of at least 10 million Japanese yen (62,672 euros) and private health insurance.
The visa allows remote workers to stay in the country for up to six months — double the 90 days currently allowed for visa-free “short-term visitors ” who are technically not allowed to work while in the country.
The visa can be extended only six months after leaving the country, that is, "visaran" is not possible.
Children and spouses will be allowed to accompany digital nomads during their stay in Japan, provided they are also insured by private health insurance.
However, applicants will not be eligible for a residence permit and will not be able to rent a dwelling for a long time.
Currently, the proposed visa is open for public comment, and its introduction is expected at the end of March.

The authorities of Germany and the Dominican Republic from February 1 launched a pilot program to transfer employees to a reduced working week.
In 2019, such an idea was put forward by the then head of the Russian government, Dmitry Medvedev.
What they think about the transition to four-day in Russia and the world - in the material RTVI.
In Russia
Yaroslav Nilov, Head of the State Duma Committee on Labor, Social Policy and Veterans Affairs
Commenting on the possibility of transferring Russians to a four-day working week, Yaroslav Nilov recalled that this initiative in 2019 was made by the then Prime Minister of Russia Dmitry Medvedev.
The deputy called the initiative implemented, but not in the near future and not for all spheres and industries.
“For someone there is already a four-day period, especially after the pandemic, after the practice of remote, mixed employment, we have workers who have not a five-day period, but a four-day period, and someone has a three-day period.
The most important thing is that there is no need to impose anything hard in the sphere of labor, no need to introduce strict regulations, no amendments.
Everything should be natural, synergistic and evolutionary.
This is a multifaceted issue, and the labor market should itself line up - taking into account new technologies, artificial intelligence, optimization solutions, "he said.
According to him, the task of reducing the working week is to make people rest more without reducing labor productivity and wages.
“It should be beneficial for both the employee and the employer.
If you shift the four-day period to the employer, this will lead to higher prices, to the closure of enterprises, and an increase in unemployment.
We don't need that.
If you do not shift, then this can lead to a loss in the salary of employees, especially since there is a piecework form of employment - payment depends on the volume of services provided or goods produced, "Nilov explained.
Dmitry Medvedev, Deputy Chairman of the Security Council
In 2019, former Russian Prime Minister Dmitry Medvedev announced the possibility of switching to a four-day working week during his speech at the International Labour Conference in Geneva, timed to coincide with the 100th anniversary of the International Labour Organization.
“Technological progress leads to a reduction not only of jobs, but also of working time, to the expansion of leisure.
It is very likely that the future lies in a four-day working week as the basis of a social and labor contract, "Medvedev said.
Tatyana Golikova, Deputy Prime Minister
After Dmitry Medvedev ’ s statement, Tatyana Golikova said that the government is “analyzing the situation ” in the labor market as part of a discussion of the possible introduction of a four-day working week.
“These four days are just a possible response to the changing world of challenges, when some professions will die, others will come to replace them, ” she said.
According to Golikova, as a result of global digitalization in the future, the need for a large number of labor resources to be occupied “in a particular workplace ” may disappear.
She also noted that in implementing the transition to a shorter working week, it will be necessary to take into account the level of wages and social guarantees.
“What kind of salary they will receive: the same as when they were occupied for five days or a little more, or in a reduced form, the question remains open here, ” she explained.
Anton Kotyakov, Minister of Labour and Social Protection
Speaking about the possibility of shortening the working week, Anton Kotyakov said in 2021 that he considers the idea of switching to a four-day schedule irrelevant.
“Given the flexible forms of employment that we have now provided in the Labor Code, the need to switch to a four-day working week is mandatory for today is irrelevant, ” he said.
According to the minister, thanks to the spread of remote employment, employers have the opportunity to form a flexible schedule.
“And if necessary, you can do four-day work in the office, and three-day, and a couple of days with a certain mode of remote work, you can work because of the city, ” he said.
Valery Fadeev, Head of the Presidential Council on Civil Society Development and Human Rights
In 2021, Valery Fadeev said that he has nothing against reducing the working week, but recalled that the salary of more than half of working Russians is about 27 thousand rubles per month, and urged to think about increasing this amount.
“Work has come to be seen as a burden and as a yoke.
But in fact, work is almost the main thing in a person ’ s life.
A person should live for the sake of family, for the sake of children, for the sake of doing something in life.
Work should bring joy to man.
I can ’ t say that we have such a situation now in our country that everyone can find a job in joy.
Unfortunately, this is not the case, ” he stressed.
Mikhail Shmakov, Head of the Federation of Independent Trade Unions
Answering a question about the transfer of companies to a four-day schedule, Mikhail Shmakov said in 2023 that representatives of the trade union movement supported the idea of reducing the working week in Russia to 36 hours only while maintaining wages for employees.
At the same time, he suggested that in the conditions of a shortage in the labor market, this idea may not be relevant.
Svetlana Bessarab, member of the State Duma Committee on Labor, Social Policy and Veterans Affairs
In November 2023, Svetlana Bessarab promised to make a proposal to switch to a 36-hour working week after the completion of the military operation in Ukraine.
“I can promise that after the end of the SVO and our victory, I will make a proposal to reduce the working week to 36 hours without reducing wages.
This is how rural women now work: they have the right to a shorter working week with the same salary.
And, as practice has shown, we do not lose anything in productivity, ” she said.
In August 2023, Bessarab called for “talking seriously ” about the transition to a four-day working week.
In particular, she drew attention to the fact that labor productivity has increased many times thanks to the introduction of digital technologies, while workers continue to be treated the same way as 50 years ago.
In the world
Iceland
In 2021, the British research center Autonomy called the results of an experiment to shorten the working week in Iceland a “stunning success ”.
As part of this experiment, the working week of 2.5 thousand municipal employees was reduced by 4-5 hours, and those who worked five days a week had another day off.
Autonomy, in particular, praised performance and service delivery in most of the workplaces tested, where employees began to show a higher level of enthusiasm and also began to get more pleasure from the work process.
“As a result, about 86% of the working population will be able to switch to a reduced working schedule or demand a reduction in working hours, ” the study says.
Belgium
Belgian Prime Minister Alexander de Cros said in 2022 that citizens of the country can require their employers to transfer to a reduced working week.
In case of refusal to provide them with such an opportunity, the employer must justify his decision in writing.
“The goal is to allow people and companies to more freely manage their working hours.
If you compare our country with other countries, you will notice that we often act much less dynamically, ” he said.
Britannia
The largest experiment on the transfer of workers to a reduced working week began in Britain in June 2022.
As part of the experiment, 3,300 employees from 70 companies were given the opportunity to work four days a week with full pay.
For the participants of the experiment, a “100: 80: 100 ” model was developed, according to which 80% of working time is paid at 100%, and employees in return agree to show 100% productivity.
“We will study how project participants respond to the extra day off in terms of stress and burnout, life and work satisfaction, as well as overall health, sleep quality, energy expenditure, range of movements and a host of other aspects, ” explained Boston College sociology professor Juliet Shore, who leads the project ’ s research team.
In 2023, sociologists at the University of Cambridge recognized the results of the experiment as successful.
In their study, they pointed out that employees who worked four days a week had significantly reduced levels of stress and illness, as well as increased levels of loyalty to employers.
At the same time, the revenues of the companies that decided to take part in the experiment did not show a significant decrease, and 23 of them even noted a slight increase, the average figure of which was 1.4%.
Spain
In October 2023, a commission of independent experts evaluated the results of a test experiment for the introduction of a four-day working week in the Spanish city of Valencia, in which 360 thousand employees took part.
Experts pointed to a reduction in stress levels, as well as an improvement in the atmosphere by reducing the number of vehicles on the streets of the city.
Representatives of the tourism sector reported that during the experiments, they had increased the flow of customers, while retail chains noted a decrease in sales.
“We want the city to be friendly, healthy and take care of people.
We want people to work to live, not to live to work, ” said the mayor of the city, Joan Ribeau, at the start of the experiment.
Dominican Republic
The Dominican Republic was the first Latin American country to experiment with a four-day work week.
The experiment, which began on February 1, 2024, will last six months.
According to the government, it will last six months – for three months, employees will work on a reduced schedule and receive 100% of their wages, and for the next three months a special commission will collect and analyze information to understand how this change has affected the country ’ s economy.
The experiment was initiated by the Minister of Labor Luis Miguel de Camps.
He stressed that he considers the reduction of the working week not only an innovation in the labor market, but also a significant step towards a more harmonious and humane society.
“Priority is given to people, improving health and well-being, and promoting sustainable and environmentally friendly productivity, ” the official added.
Germany
In September 2023, Germany opened the reception of applications from organizations ready to take part in the experiment to shorten the working week.
Despite the statement of the Minister of Finance of the country Christian Lindner, who questioned the possibility of switching to a four-day working week, 45 companies in test mode transferred their employees to the new schedule from February 1, 2024.
German authorities have agreed to an experiment with a shortened working week amid a crisis associated with rising inflation and a shortage of trained personnel.
As Bloomberg notes, these factors led to the fact that German workers began to actively seek higher wages, as well as to fight for the flexibility and independence that they received during the pandemic.

Throughout this time, the plant is a unique living chemical factory.
