But she added that India did not want to be weakened and needed to ensure its security.
This means that India will continue to rely on Russian military supplies for a long time.
How dependent is India on Russian weapons?
India is one of the world ’ s largest arms buyers and has had close defense ties with the former Soviet Union for years.
India ’ s antagonism with Pakistan, as well as its growing rivalry with China, meant that Moscow remained Delhi ’ s main partner even after the collapse of the Soviet Union in the 1990s.
About two-thirds of India ’ s military equipment since 1992 has come from Russia, according to the Stockholm Institute for International Peace (Sipri), which tracks global arms transfers and military spending.
The Stimson Center, a U.S.-based research organization, estimates that Russian weapons may account for 85 percent of India ’ s major weapons systems.
This includes fighters, nuclear-powered submarines, aircraft carriers, tanks and missiles.
Is India trying to diversify its arms supply?
Over the past decade, India has become less dependent on Russian weapons and has bought more equipment from other countries.
Notable among them are purchases from France, but also from Israel and the United States, and a smaller amount from the United Kingdom.
According to Sipri, France, the United States and Israel sold twice as much weapons to India in 2021 as they did in 2017, although Russia remains a major supplier.
India purchased Gale jets, Mirage fighters, and Scorpene submarines from France.
During Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi ’ s recent visit to France, the two countries said they had agreed to deepen cooperation on advanced defense technology.
Similarly, during Prime Minister Johnson ’ s visit to Delhi in April 2022, the UK and India pledged to deepen their defence and security ties, emphasizing cooperation on advanced jet fighter technology.
India has also turned to Israel for procurement, seeking to meet a number of high-tech defense and security needs, including:
• Drone equipment
• On-board early warning system
• Anti-missile defense
• Precision-guided munitions
India ’ s military relationship with the United States has been growing strongly, with defence trade between India and the United States increasing significantly from 2018 to 2019.
India ’ s major purchases include U.S. long-range maritime patrol aircraft and C-130 transport aircraft, as well as missiles and drones, and a recent Pentagon statement spoke of deepening cooperation with India in space defense and cyber security.
Is India rethinking its reliance on Russian weapons?
Changes in international politics in recent years have meant that India has become closer to countries like France, the United States and Israel.
Nonetheless, India has yet to join the international community in condemning Russia ’ s invasion of Ukraine, and India has made it clear that it does not want to take sides.
Some defense experts believe that given the impact of international sanctions on Russia, India may find it has no choice but to reduce its dependence on Moscow.
Samir Larwani, a defense and security analyst at the Stimson Center, said critical components of Russia ’ s S-400 surface-to-air missile system may now be problematic.
India purchased the system in 2018, and only a portion of it has been delivered.
"There are good reasons to believe... that Russia will not be able to fulfill its contractual commitment to India to deliver all S-400 systems," Mr. Rawani said.
He also argued that Russia ’ s war losses in Ukraine could mean that it might not be able to meet India ’ s needs “because it will be desperate to use all spare parts to replenish its power. ”
He said Indian policymakers may be taking note of some of the problems Russia faces with its equipment on the Ukrainian battlefield.
Without Russia ’ s weapons, would India ’ s defense be able to do so?
At the moment, this seems unlikely.
In October, a U.S. congressional report said the Indian military would not function effectively without Russian equipment and would continue to rely on Russian weapons systems in the near and medium term.
According to the report, Russia offers weapons at a relatively (more) attractive price than the West.
Sanjita Saxena, editor of the Delhi-based magazine Aeronautics and Defense Space, said the Indian army would continue to buy weapons and equipment from Russia.
She said this was not only because its personnel were familiar with their equipment, but also because relations with Russia had stood the test of time.
But she added that India wants to develop its indigenous defence industry, sometimes in joint partnerships with other countries.
Ms Saxena explained that this involved using the most advanced technology abroad to vigorously promote weapons manufacturing under programs such as “Made in India. ”
She explained that India would buy from anyone it felt offered the most suitable or valuable deal, whether it was Russia or another country.

NATO expansion after Iraq: Why did Turkey open its bow in the face of the Russian-Ukrainian conflict?
Author: Liu Yanting

The Russian-Ukrainian conflict is both a playground for the great powers and an operational fulcrum for the interests of the regional powers.
In the Middle East Gulf region, Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates did not fully respond to the demand for increased oil production in the United States, refused to kick Russia out of the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries and oil-producing allies (collectively known as OPEC +), and did not participate in the sanctions against Russia.
For the Gulf states, including Saudi Arabia, the United States remains its most important regional security partner, but now the “return to Asia ” is a foregone conclusion.
Under these circumstances, although the Gulf countries will not immediately abandon the United States, they will increase their interaction with other foreign powers in the consideration of national interests, in order to spread the geopolitical risks of excessive border selection.
The neutrality of Saudi Arabia and the United Arab Emirates in the Russia-Ukraine conflict reflects their increasingly close interaction with Russia and the re-emergence of a Cold War order in the Middle East.
In South Asia, India ’ s position is an indicator.
As early as the outbreak of the war on February 24, it did not participate in the sanctions against Russia, but also took advantage of the decline in the price of Russian energy exports to expand imports of Russian crude oil.
Just over a month after the start of the war, Russia and Ukraine purchased 13 million barrels of Russian crude oil, almost matching the 16 million barrels for the entire year of 2021.
In doing so, in addition to relying heavily on Russian arms, India also intends to strengthen its own "chess player" status in the Indo-Pacific.
If India chooses to be mediated by the United States and sanction Russia, it may prompt Moscow to lean further towards Beijing, so that in the face of the Sino-Indian border conflict, India will have an additional strategic risk. After all, it can not ensure that Russia will maintain its neutral role of non-interference, as it has in the past.
In this context, cooperation with Russia has become the leverage that India uses to offset the United States, and rejection of the United States has become the basis for India to price Russia. At the end of the day, India still puts its national interests first.
At the turn of Europe and Asia, there is also a regional power through the outbreak of the Russian-Ukrainian conflict, which began to open the left and right of the border, and that is Turkey.
On December 6, 2021, Russian President Vladimir Putin visited India and met with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi in New Delhi.
(AP)
From Iraq to NATO.
First, there is the cross-border attack on the northern part of Iraq.
In the early hours of April 18, local time, Turkish Defense Minister Hulusi Akar announced that a new round of cross-border military strikes against the Kurdish Workers' Party (PKK), codenamed Operation Claw-lock, was launched in northern Iraq's Metina, Zap and Avashin regions. (The ock).
In this operation, Turkey first sent F-16 fighters and "Anka-B" drones to carry out large-scale air raids on the Kurdistan camp, then sent the Turkish Army to sharpen the 5th Commando Brigade, carrying "Black Hawk" helicopters into the Kurdistan hinterland to carry out special operations; at the same time, the Turkish ground mobile forces also started from the Turkish-Iraqi border, along the E-90 highway. The Kurdistan Autonomous Region (Ikud) is an attempt to encircle the base of the Kurdistan Workers' Party.
From the perspective of Turkey's deployment, the ideal goal should be to control the Iraq-Turkey border crossing, create a "safe zone" and permanent military base, and then open the actual land bridge between this and the "safe zone" controlled by northern Syria, in order to keep the PKK forces out of Turkey.
However, because the Kurdistan Workers Party has rich experience in mountain warfare, Turkey may fall into a protracted war here, as long as the Kurdistan Workers Party can survive September, the mountains on the Iraq-Turkey border will be covered by autumn and winter rain, and the Turkish army will be forced to withdraw.
To this day, the "claw lock operation" is still underway, and there are casualties on both sides of the Turku, and the actual results of the battle have not been released to the outside world.
In addition to attacking the Iraqi Workers' Party, Turkey has actively charged the United States and Europe on the issue of Finland and Sweden's accession to NATO.
Pictured, on May 18, Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan called on NATO members to respect Turkey 's concerns at the parliament in Ankara. (AP)
As early as May 13, before Finland and Sweden formally stated their position, Turkey publicly opposed the two countries to join NATO, and on the 16th made two key demands: Finland and Sweden should stop supporting the Kurdistan Workers Party, and the United States needs to lift the arms export ban imposed on Turkey.
In response to the allegation that "Finland and Sweden support the PKK", Turkey also explained: First, Finland and Sweden sheltered six and 11 PKK members respectively, "who may have ties to Fethullah Gulen, who is currently living in the United States and masterminded the 2016 coup"; second, in 2019, PKK supporters held a rally in support of Gulen in a Swedish shopping center. The Swedish police did not stop it.
On May 18, after the formal application of Finland and Sweden, Turkey still did not change its position, but reiterated its request again and said that "there is no need to send a delegation to convince Turkey".
And since NATO ’ s addition requires the unanimous consent of the member states, Turkey ’ s “one-man relationship ” has indeed triggered multiple surprises from the United States, Finland and Sweden.
White House spokesman Jen Psaki said Washington was “working to clarify Turkey ’ s position, ” while Finnish President Sauli Niinistö said he had spoken with Recep Tayyip Erdogan in April but had not made a similar request.
Negotiations are still ongoing, and Turkey said at a meeting of NATO ambassadors on Wednesday that “some issues related to Finland and Sweden ’ s accession to NATO still need to be resolved, ” according to The Washington Post.
Finnish President Sauli Niinistö and Finnish Prime Minister Sanna Marin announced Finland ’ s national security policy decision at a press conference in Helsinki on May 15, 2022. The Finnish President and the Government ’ s Ministerial Committee on Foreign and Security Policy approved Finland ’ s application to join NATO.
Geographical calculations of Turkey
Looking at the above performance of Turkey, it can be said that it is taking advantage of the protracted unresolved Russian-Ukrainian conflict to advance its own geographical planning.
When it comes to attacking northern Iraq, Turkey has set its sights on creating a “safe zone ” around Turkey to counter the threat of Kurdish separatist infiltration and repatriate some of its refugees.
In October 2019, Turkey took advantage of the US military ’ s massive withdrawal from Syria and launched a cross-border military operation code-named Operation Peace Spring to attack Kurdish forces on the Syrian border.
In the end, although Turkey succeeded in delineating a security buffer between its homeland and Rojava (the Kurdish government in Syria), it had to accept the reality that it had to coexist with the Russian army in northern Syria.
However, this cross-border attack on the Iraqi Workers' Party in the north has made the international situation around Turkey much more favorable.
First, at present, the strategic focus of the United States and Russia is on Ukraine, and even if the United States can be distracted, the importance of the Indo-Pacific is better than the Middle East, and Turkey can minimize the degree of major power constraints; second, the Turkish military operation to a certain extent, with the tacit approval of the Iraqi government and the support of the Iraqi authorities.
The former has always been inaccessible to the Kurdish forces in the north, and the latter, although a member of the Kurdish forces, has been wary of the entrenchment of the PKK. Therefore, after the launch of the "claw lock" operation, the Iraqi government publicly declared that the military operation was the result of the decision of the PKK and Turkey to "strengthen cooperation to promote security and stability".
In a previous interview with The Economist, French President Emmanuel Macron criticized Turkey ’ s rash attack on Kurds in Syria as one of the cases of “NATO brain death. ”
In response, Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan (second from left) angrily criticized Macron, saying, “You should check if you are brain dead. ” (AP)
As for Finland and Sweden's entry into NATO, Turkey's plan has nothing to do with the Kurdish issue, and it is not even really to prevent the two countries from joining, but to create its own Eurasian "chess player" status by "preventing the expansion of NATO".
To be sure, the request for the extradition of members of the overseas Kurdistan Workers Party and the Gulen Organization, although Turkey ’ s continued foreign policy, has rarely become a diplomatic issue in recent years, and Gulen himself has been in exile in the United States for a long time and has received political asylum.
Turkey will struggle on this issue, and its real purpose remains to disrupt the US layout and force the latter to agree to a series of Turkish demands, from lifting the arms export ban on Turkey, increasing economic and trade investment, to resuming the F-35 fighter order that was terminated because Turkey purchased the Russian S-400 missile defense system.
Although from a practical point of view, Finland, Sweden and the United States may not be able to fully agree, even a partial concession is an additional strategic gain for Turkey. With the upcoming presidential election in Turkey in 2023, Erdogan is facing a domestic dilemma of mass inflation and rising prices.
In addition, the Turkish army is now fighting in northern Iraq, and involvement in the NATO issue will enable Turkey to have a geopolitical status, which can attract the joint fight of the United States and Russia to a certain extent, and help to consolidate the external environment that separates the major powers from the battlefield.
Looking at the Russian-Ukrainian conflict, the United States and Russia are both dependent on Turkey.
Before the outbreak of the Bucha incident, Turkey had hosted a number of Russian-Ukrainian diplomatic negotiations; after the renewal of the NATO expansion issue, Turkey began to make a double-sided offer. In the final analysis, Turkey's special strategic location and NATO membership status have made it an unexpected hub in the game between the United States and NATO, and have a new opportunity to promote the "security zone".

Since June 1 this year, more than 3,000 employees from more than 60 companies in the United Kingdom have conducted a social experiment with a six-month “four-day work ”.
Since 2018, the non-profit organization of "4 Day Week Global" wants to test whether the public interest of "80% working time - 100% wages - 100% productivity" and "three days off a week, labor and management win" really exists.
Due to the COVID-19 outbreak so far in 2020, many enterprises have adopted the method of “working from home, diverting work ”, and in the long process of the epidemic, working from home and working from home has become an emerging work style.
Since the end of the epidemic this year, many countries have returned to their original or new jobs, whether they are blue-collar and white-collar workers who have left or changed jobs.
However, in more than two years, the transformation of various workplaces in the enterprise to survive, and the labor compromise of "unpaid leave + retained work" have made more and more pioneer projects of "four days a week", and the industry category has become more and more diversified, becoming a new opportunity to promote.
Among them, the most representative is Iceland.
According to media reports in the middle of last year: “The three-day weekend experiment in Iceland has been a success, and workers ’ happiness and productivity have improved ”; the reason for this is:“ Employees face less workplace stress, anxiety, depression and exhaustion, and therefore work harder and take fewer sick days; workers feel more leisure time, and therefore are more committed to their work. ”
This conclusion, in addition to the ethical questions of the willingness of enterprises and workers to participate, and whether or not to remain anonymous, also requires the testing of more rigorous research methods, such as the length of the experiment, whether the industry type and size of the experiment is consistent, and the working tolerance of the workers involved in the experiment, are worthy of further investigation.
On the other hand, the three-day experiment, the success stories of Iceland, New Zealand, and British Columbia, Canada, did not clearly describe the type of industry, the development of the industry in each country, and whether the size of the enterprises in the industry varies greatly.
In addition, across all continents of the world, countries have different levels of economic development, industrial structures have their own characteristics, and the government originally conferred statutory labor rights and interests, are also different.
In addition to industries that are not suitable for at-home work, the sense of alienation of human relationships, the synergy of face-to-face communication, and whether innovation requires teamwork have become the focus of discussion.
On the front page of the “Four Days a Week Worldwide ” website, the home page shows where the current pioneer projects are located on every continent around the world. Surprisingly, Central and South America, Africa, and Southeast Asia each launched at least five projects, but in Canada and the United States, there is only one pilot project.
Moreover, the website reveals that “working four days a week makes 78% of employees feel happier and less stressed. ”
It can also be seen that not only developed countries are promoting, in fact, more developing countries are also conducting experiments.
While there is a lack of a more convincing description of the experimental design, it is clear that this is indeed a possible new type of workplace.
Because of this, in addition to the pilot of national enterprises to cooperate with international non-profit organizations, there are also governments taking the lead in responding.
Spain ’ s leftist political party, once launched a “three days off ” policy in 2021, and the Spanish government agreed to test the new work system of“ 32 hours per week (8 hours per day) ” on a limited scale. 200 companies are willing to participate, and 3,000 to 6,000 workers benefit.
The result of such a trial gives more room for imagination to "take three days off every week, and employees will win both."
The social experiment of "80% of working hours - 100% of wages - 100% of productivity" has important policy significance for the harmony of labor relations and the long-term development of the economy.
"High working hours" does not mean "high productivity", which is the general consensus of the current society.
"Shorten working hours, wages unchanged", helps companies retain employees, perhaps without controversy; but whether it can also maintain 100% of the work output is questioned by the business community.
After the epidemic, "three days off a week, labor and management win" is applicable to some specific industry categories, and the nature of the work of individual employees may also be more widely distributed in various industries.
And the flexibility of working hours, the heterogeneity of the workplace, the universalization of work dispatch, and even the high expectations of the young generation for "enterprise decentralization" are all the help of "working four days a week", which may be a major challenge for enterprises in the future.

Survey _ More than 60% of employees interviewed pointed out that the implementation of a four-day work week can improve mental health
Author: Zhang Wei-lun
Published: Updated:
Since the outbreak of COVID-19 in 2020, many corporate employees have sought to achieve a better work-life balance, expect a better quality of life, and reduce the stress caused by work.
A study of 1,083 full-time and part-time employees in Hong Kong last month found that 71% of office workers pointed to work as the main source of stress affecting mental health, 22% of respondents pointed to the negative impact of remote work on mental health, and only 19% pointed to the positive impact of remote work.
How to improve the mental health of employees. 61% of the respondents said that employers can implement a four-day work week, 40% pointed to the flexibility of working hours. 34% and 32% respectively pointed to the participation of companies in mental health days or weeks. Another 21% pointed to the availability of mental health resources such as counselling services.
The study outlines the views of Hong Kong office workers on flexible working environments.
Nearly half of respondents (48%) believe that flexibility means being able to choose the hours they want to work.
The remaining respondents defined it as the ability to choose the day of work (17%) or the freedom to work anywhere (17%). 1 in 10 respondents said flexibility should be measured by performance, not hours worked (11%).
The majority of respondents indicated that they can choose the number of hours or days they work (58%) as the top priority.
In addition, it is important to take flexible leave as needed (54%), to be able to allocate the number of hours needed to do the work (42%), to work anywhere (41%), and to be able to go out and deal with emergencies while working (27%).
85% of employees support performance measurement based on work results
More flexible arrangements, a four-day working week and more paid holidays are also key factors in attracting and retaining talent.
As companies move towards hybrid and even more flexible work models, this has sparked a discussion of measuring employee performance in the new workplace: more employers tend to focus on employee outcomes rather than hours worked.
A majority of respondents (85%) support measuring performance based on work outcomes rather than hours, and believe that this improves efficiency, focus, and recognition.
Nearly half (49%) of respondents said they expect their office hours to gradually decrease in this mode.

Europe ’ s airports are in chaos: what is the state of the aviation industry?
The summer vacation period has begun.
However, the journey of how many people to the land of their dreams begins at the chaotic airport, from hours of queues, flight delays to temporary cancellations, frustration and trouble.
As this year ’ s International Air Show (ILA) in Berlin approaches, let ’ s take a look at the current state of the aviation industry.
Traveling in May and the first few weeks of June is enough to give an accurate sense of what the summer might be like at European airports.
In the coming weeks, passengers will need to carry one of the most necessary “baggage ”: patience.
At German airports, queues at check-in counters are getting longer and longer.
The main reason for this is that there is an acute shortage of staff in the airport services: both security personnel and baggage handlers on the tarmac.
Just recently, easyjet, a low-cost airline, announced that it would cancel thousands of flights in the coming weeks due to a lack of staff.
During the height of the pandemic, many service providers laid off staff.
The client then tends to try to find a better-paid job.
Ralph Beisel, chief executive of the German Airports Association (ADV), explained that if people want to return to work, they first have to go through a lengthy security review.
At present, the airport is short of about one-fifth of its staff.
He therefore called for the review process to be expedited so that people could be hired more quickly: “The security review cannot take eight weeks, because then the summer vacation can be over ”.
We're short of manpower.
It's not just the lack of staff on the ground.
There are also "bottlenecks" in the air.
Lufthansa, for example, will have to cancel hundreds of flights in July because of a shortage of staff.
The union feels its position has been confirmed.
"It has long been clear that radical layoffs in many sectors of the airline industry will have a negative impact on recovery," said Stefan Herth, president of Cockpit.
Finding enough pilots quickly, however, is no easy task -- globally. Heinrich Großbongardt, an aviation expert in Hamburg, points out that in the United States, regional traffic pilots are now employed on even better terms than previously thought to be the best.
As a result, labour rights are on the increase.
Lufthansa may even face a pilot strike because management intends to reduce the number of its parent company ’ s airliners and move them to a cheaper subsidiary, Eurowings, to help achieve the cost-cutting that must be done.
Lufthansa, which was battered during the pandemic, is now trying to reposition itself and hopes to offer services to passengers quickly again.
But it's difficult.
Last month, Lufthansa chairman Carsten Spohr admitted: "I have had to apologise repeatedly to our customers for weeks; I am afraid I will have to do so after the summer."
Long range, expensive fuel.
Then, there are other problems: fuel prices have skyrocketed due to the war in Ukraine; aircraft flying to the Far East have had to make a detour due to the closure of Russian airspace, which has led to a sharp increase in flight costs.
Aviation expert Gros Bangat warned that high costs could leave some airlines in trouble and lead to bankruptcies — for example, small state-owned airlines that are largely state-funded but can ’ t be truly profitable.
They are also unlikely to be sheltered by connected aviation tycoons such as Lufthansa, British Airways or Air France / KLM.
On the contrary, Lufthansa is intent on swallowing smaller airlines such as ITA Airways, the successor to Alitalia.
Grosspungart suspects that Swedish airline SAS may soon be one of the targets of the acquisition.
Berlin Mayor Franziska Giffey and Brandenburg Governor Dietmar Woidke at the Berlin International Aerospace Biennale 2022
Against this backdrop, the International Air and Space Biennale (ILA) opened on Wednesday at Berlin-Schönefeld Airport.
Due to the pandemic, the 2020 session was not held.
Due to the war in Ukraine, military aviation may be more of a concern than before.
Environmental protection will also be a major issue.
There are still huge losses this year.
This has actually given momentum to aircraft manufacturers, first Airbus and Boeing.
After all, using more fuel-efficient aircraft helps airlines meet their emissions targets.
Airbus, for example, expects that 39,000 aircraft will be needed globally by 2040 to replace older, less fuel-efficient aircraft.
Boeing estimates that annual air traffic in Europe alone will grow by 3.1% by 2040.
However, aviation expert Carlos Bongat said the forecast was too optimistic.
He believes that given the large number of problems that still exist, especially due to rising costs and rising ticket prices, it is difficult to achieve the relevant forecasts.
After two consecutive years of losses from the pandemic, the airline industry has some reason for optimism.
Willie Walsh, director-general of the International Air Transport Association (IATA), said at the Doha conference on Monday that it is fully on track to turn a profit in 2023.
However, for this year, the airline industry still expects a loss of 9.7 billion dollars.
Not a small number, of course, but much less than the two pandemic plague years of 2020 and 2021: the total losses for those two years were $138 billion and $42 billion, respectively.

Amazon Alexa reproduces the voice of friends and relatives to remember the dead or help to cheat?
Author: 01 Weekly Report
Published: Updated:
Tech giant Amazon last week hosted its annual developer conference re: MARS to introduce AI applications in machine learning, automation, robotics and space.
A short demonstration video was shown.
A child asked the Panda ’ s child-themed voice assistant, “Alexa, can grandmother continue to tell me the story of The Wizard of Oz? ” Alexa answered“ OK ” with its preset voice line, then switched to another voice that sounded closer to humans and read the plot of the Cowardly Lion seeking self-confidence.
Rohit Prasad, Alexa ’ s chief scientist, introduced at the conference that Alexa can mimic a voice line with less than a minute of recorded content: “The way we do this is by defining the problem as a speech-to-speech task, not a speech-generating path. ”
Amazon has in the past developed voice synthesis technology that allows Alexa to mimic the voice of basketball star Shaquille O ’ Neal or comedian Melissa Mccarthy.
At that time, the practice was relatively backward, requiring someone to record a large amount of audio for a long time.
In contrast, Alexa, the new voice imitation function, is said to be based on recent advances in text-to-speech technology, which can generate high-quality, like-for-like sound lines with less data.
Alexa Chief Scientist Rohit Prasad told re: MARS 2022 that the company is developing AI to reproduce the voice of the deceased family and friends, hoping to deepen the “humanity ” of the AI voice assistant. (Amazon re: MARS 2022 YouTube clip screenshot)
For example, he claims that this advancement in AI can enable consumers to maintain “lasting personal relationships ” with their deceased relatives:“ While AI cannot eliminate the pain of losing a loved one, it can definitely make memories last … There is no doubt that we are living in the golden age of AI, and our dreams and science fiction are becoming a reality. ”
After Amazon announced the latest feature of Alexa, it also caused a lot of negative reviews on the Internet, from the social media Twitter, users criticized the feature as "disturbing", "sick", or they do not want it.
As Tama Leaver, a professor of Internet studies at Curtin University in Australia, points out, the line between humans and machines is beginning to blur in such applications: “You won ’ t remember whether you ’ re talking to Amazon ’ s data collection service or to the voice of your grandparents or a deceased loved one. ”
In a way, it ’ s kind of like the story of Black Mirror. ”
Some scholars have pointed out that the use of AI to reproduce voice lines involves security and ethical issues such as fraud risk, informed consent, and ownership, and should be considered early before such technology is popularized. (Replica)
Leaver also pointed out that the new feature of Alexa has an informed consent problem in the production.
Using the data of the deceased in this way, he said, “is both creepy and unethical, because the deceased himself may not have thought that his data would be so used after death. ”
Subbarao Kambhampati, a professor of computer science at the University of Arizona, agrees: “For people who are grieving, this technology may actually help, as we look back and watch videos of the deceased.
But it also raises serious ethical questions, such as, is it okay to do this without the consent of the deceased? ”
Some scholars and experts have pointed out that AI simulation sound lines may have security and ethical issues.
In terms of security, there are concerns that this technology could be used as a fake scam.
Rachel Tobac, CEO of security firm SocialProof Security, warns that society is not prepared for the risk that this voice technology will be exploited by criminals: “If cybercriminals can easily and reliably copy another person ’ s voice with a small number of voice samples, they can use that voice sample to impersonate others, which could lead to fraud, data and account theft. ”

Talk about pain: "Iron Triangle" campaign to get rid of pain
[Ming Pao News] Exercise is precisely the representative of "medical disease, no disease to strengthen the body", the average person can strengthen the immunity, strengthen the bones and bones through exercise; for patients, the appropriate amount of exercise can help speed up recovery or prevent recurrence, especially for patients with pain.
However, many pain sufferers are deterred because they are worried that exercise may trigger pain, or are afraid that the pain after exercise has not been reduced, but the situation has become worse, and the benefits of exercise are questioned.
In my daily contact with pain patients, I found that the problem is not the failure of exercise, but the failure to do "right" exercise.
Exercise has an iron triangle principle in the treatment of pain, which is the "oxygen", "stretching" and "muscle strength" training.
Through aerobic exercise such as running, swimming, etc., you can reduce weight and reduce the pressure of body weight on the joints; stretching exercises such as yoga can improve the flexibility of the tendons and help maintain the flexibility of the joints; muscle training such as equipment exercises to strengthen the muscles, so that the muscles absorb and share the impact like soft cushions, to achieve the effect of protecting the joints.
Do the "right" exercise with oxygen, stretching and muscle strength
Many pain patients "hear" the doctor's instructions to do more exercise, but do not "understand" how to exercise to eliminate pain, simply according to personal interests to choose.
For example, running is a lot of people's favorite exercise, love its simple and convenient without specific equipment, but even if you wear the shoes to do the right posture, but if the lack of lower limb muscle training, so that the knee lacks muscle protection, running every leg landing will add pressure to the knee.
Yoga is also the preferred exercise for many pain patients, thinking that it is gentle and low in exercise.
However, going back to history, from the previous practice of yoga mostly male, many of the rest movements need strong muscle support to complete, so the lack of sufficient muscle mass often occurs in the case of pulling soft tissue.
However, if you only go to the gym to exercise muscles, increase muscle weight, but do not pay attention to weight control, or ignore the softness of the soft tissue, it will also cause individual joints to be stressed or become rigid, resulting in pain.
If you are worried about the lack of time or physical ability to afford the above three types of exercise, Tai Chi can be said to be the "three-in-one" exercise for even the less physically able elderly. However, it has been able to achieve weight loss, improve tendon flexibility and strengthen muscles at the same time.
Finally, any exercise should also be done according to your strength, especially for patients who want to eliminate pain problems with exercise, it is recommended to discuss the relevant plan with the doctor to find out the appropriate type of exercise and the amount of exercise.

In terms of volume, neodymium is the most important.

A generation of talented son Ni Kuang left the earth and left a book after book … Whether you are a veteran book fan or not, you will surely have seen Ni Kuang ’ s smiling face and heard Ni Kuang ’ s happy laugh.
In the eyes of many people, Ni Kuang is not only a generation of literary giants, but also an "old stubborn child", and there have been many happy things in life, such as a pen name, love to collect shells and so on.
Here are 8 interesting facts about the past, how much do you know?

Science fiction works, "God's prophecies" are wonderful, and the outlook on life is even more wise!
# 1 How many names are there?
Ni Kuang's pen name is numerous, and the most widely known must be "Wesley", and the name is inspired by a village.
Once, when he was riding through Daikeng, he saw a door plate called "Wesley Village", and he felt that the name "Wesley" had a foreign flavor and was suitable for Westernization, so he settled on the pen name.
In addition to "Wesley", "Ni Kuang" is also a pseudonym, and the title of this great name is a whim! Ni Kuang once said that the word "Kuang" is used in the opening of "Ci Hai", and even laughed that fortunately it is not a rough word in the point, otherwise it will be "big"!
(Image source: Look at life.
# 2 Did the Dragon Eight become blind because of Ni Kuang?
Ni Kuang, famous for science fiction, and Jin Yong, the martial arts novelist, have known each other for many years, and there was an interesting incident between the two!
Needless to say, it turned out that Jin Yong had asked Ni Kuang to write the "Eight Parts of the Dragon"! At that time, Jin Yong wanted to travel to Europe, so he asked his friend Ni Kuang to write for a period of time, and Jin Yong told him that he could not write any characters.
As a result, as soon as Jin Yong got on the plane, Ni Kuang blinded him in the afternoon! Why? All because of hate! After the incident, he explained to Jin Yong that the martial arts plot will always be damaged! Jin Yong had to laugh bitterly and shut up to clean up the "mess"!
(Dragon8)
# 3 Do you want to write a book without thinking about it?
In the era of no computer, Ni Kuang's books are written by his own hand, and his writing speed is very fast, once set a record of 4,500 words per hour and write 20,000 words per day, which can be called the writing speed "World One", and is also known as the person who writes the most Chinese characters.
Don ’ t know if everyone will have the same question, the difficulty of writing a book without thinking? Ni Kuang has said that he will not slowly think about how to write before he writes, since he has a character, the plot will naturally develop, and Ni Kuang is born a big writer, destined to eat this line of food!
# 4 Have you ever been called a “bad guy ” by a reader?
Ni Kuang once wrote in the "Wesley" series of novels that a white bear was killed in the Antarctic for warmth and hunger, and some readers felt that there were only penguins in the Antarctic, so they wrote a letter asking for revision, but Ni Kuang did not understand.
However, this enchanted reader continued to write to Ni Kuang, Ni Kuang finally replied in the column "There is no white bear in the Antarctic, and there is no Wesley in the world", and Jin Yong wrote in the column "The South Pole originally had white bears, and they were all killed by Wesley."
As a result, the reader wrote the word "rogue" in reply to Ni Kuang.

Men eat 20 supplements a day, cause cancer, panic, absorb vitamin D 83 times as much

It is not advisable to eat too much or eat too much, otherwise a man in the United Kingdom who has taken too much vitamin D will fall ill and think he has cancer.
The report said that the middle-aged male patient ate 20 kinds of non-prescription nutritional supplements every day. After eating for a month, he began to show symptoms of continuous vomiting, diarrhea and stomach pain, and his body weight dropped by 12 kilograms after 3 months, worried about cancer.
Blood tests revealed that his vitamin D levels in his blood were seven times higher than normal, he suffered from acute kidney dysfunction, was hospitalized for more than a week, received drugs and intravenous injections, and excreted too much “nutrition ” from his body.
Excessive calcium loss in the body
The rare case, published in the medical case journal BMJ Case Reports, involved a person consuming 50,000 milligrams of vitamin D daily, 83 times the recommended amount.
After three months of constant vomiting, nausea, stomach pain and foot cramps, as well as tinnitus, dry mouth and thirst, his weight dropped suddenly, and his family doctor referred him to the hospital.
According to the doctor, it was the dietitian who advised him to start a "fortified vitamin" intake program. When he felt unwell, he stopped taking "vitamin cocktail", which included omega-3, vitamin B2, B9, C, K2 and several mineral and probiotic supplements, but the symptoms of the victim did not subside.
He was admitted to hospital for tests such as magnetic resonance to rule out cancer and bacterial infection, and then other tests revealed that he had too much calcium in his body and impaired kidney function.
In addition to intravenous "detoxification", the doctor prescribed the osteoporosis drug "bisphosphonate" to further reduce the excess calcium in his body.
Two months after he was discharged from the hospital, his calcium levels returned to normal, but his vitamin D levels remained abnormally high.
Toxic Vitamin D
The doctor stated that his vitamin D poisoning could last for several weeks. "This case further reflects the possibility of poisoning with supplements, most of which are safe but dangerous when taken in the wrong amount and in the wrong combination.
Vitamin D poisoning is usually caused by the intake of large doses of vitamin D supplements, not through the daily diet or the sun.
Vitamin D helps regulate calcium in the body to maintain bone, teeth and muscle health.
Vitamin D poisoning mainly causes calcium deposits in the blood, known as high blood calcium, which can lead to nausea and vomiting, weakness and frequent urination. It can also develop into bone pain and kidney problems, such as the formation of kidney stones.

Tips for preventing falls in the elderly
July 8, 2022 08: 26 Source: People 's Daily Overseas Edition
The occurrence of falls is related to various factors such as physical function, health status, behavior and environment in the elderly.
Fall is preventable, and it is necessary to improve the awareness of preventing falls in the elderly.
Correctly understand and adapt to aging, and actively adjust daily behavior habits.
Strengthening balance, muscle strength, and endurance exercises can help reduce the risk of falls in the elderly.
★ Wear well-fitting clothes, wear low-heeled, non-slip, foot-fitting shoes to help prevent falls.
★ Scientific selection and use of age-appropriate aids, active use of walking sticks.
★ When the elderly go out, develop safe travel habits.
★ Prevent osteoporosis and reduce the risk of fracture after a fall.
Take medication according to the doctor ’ s advice and pay attention to the risk of falls caused by drugs.
★ The home environment suitable for aging transformation, reduce the risk factors of falling in the environment.
Caregivers should help the elderly to establish anti-fall habits and create a safe home environment.
Do not panic after the elderly fall, and actively help yourself.
If the elderly fall, first of all to keep calm, do not rush to get up, first determine whether there is any injury, the injured part, the degree, whether you can stand up on your own.
After trying, if you can't get up, don't stand up forcefully; you can use a loud shout, call, knock on the door, floor, pipe and other items to make a sound for help, but pay attention to maintain physical strength.
During the waiting period, cushions, clothes, sheets, etc., can be used to keep warm.
If the injury is not serious, self-judgment can stand up on its own, first of all, the body should be turned into a prone position, use the support around the slowly up, do not blindly suddenly stand up, so as not to aggravate the injury.
After getting up, take a rest for a while and partially regain your strength before seeking rescue or treatment.
Family members and medical staff should be informed of any injuries sustained after a fall, and further examinations should be carried out as appropriate.
★ When rescuing the elderly who fall, first judge the injury and then provide scientific help.
When the elderly are found to fall, the rescuer must first determine the safety of the surrounding environment and rescue the elderly and the rescuer under the premise of ensuring the safety of the elderly and the rescuer.
When rescuing, first judge the elderly's consciousness, breathing, whether there are fractures, heavy bleeding and other injuries, so as to avoid aggravating the injury caused by blindly lifting the injured.
Do not shake the injured violently, pay attention to the elderly to keep warm.
If the injured elderly are unclear and seriously injured, please immediately help to call the emergency telephone; if the elderly are conscious, psychological support such as comfort and comfort can be given.
If the rescuer has certain first-aid skills, the injured elderly can be treated initially.
If you do not have first-aid skills, you can seek help from others and provide help within your ability.
Source: National Health Commission's Bureau of Disease Control and Prevention, China Center for Disease Control and Prevention

Sunday Literature ‧ Always Watching Ni Kuang
Post Date: July 10, 2022
[Ming Pao News] On July 3, after the storm passed, I learned of the news of the death of Luo Kai Rui in the morning, and learned that Ni Kuang had died in the afternoon.
Many Hong Kong people grew up watching Jin Yong ’ s martial arts novels and Ni Kuang ’ s science fiction novels, and we imagined two very different worlds from our textbooks when we were young. One is the traditional Chinese martial arts of ancient China, and the other is the imagined borderless science fiction world.
Hong Kong seems to be absent, but in the vagueness, there seems to be a side image and reflection of Hong Kong.
Moreover, there is no Hong Kong, no Jin Yong; there is no Hong Kong, and no Ni Kuang.
Escape from the dead. Legendary life.
We all know that Ni Kuang ’ s original name was Ni Cong, the word is also Ming, was born in Shanghai, parents and sister also Shu came to Hong Kong in 1951, Ni Kuang stayed in mainland China to go to university, he died many times to escape, the experience is quite strange. In 1956, Ni Kuang stole a wolf dog, bite the party branch secretary of the brigade. The secretary referred to the "destruction of traffic", "counter-revolution", and was quarantined in the cabin.
Some people have been informed that Ni Kuang may be sentenced to 20 years in prison or even death.
So Ni Kuang rode to the train station overnight, took the train, took the boat and walked from Shanghai to Guangdong, and smuggled to Hong Kong via Macau, arriving on July 5, 1957.
It's July again.
When I was a teenager, I watched the TV series “The Original Man ” (1993) starring Dawn and Li Jiaxin, and the theme song“ I Wish You Don ’ t Leave Tonight ” by Dawn ’ s lead singer was heard all night, but as far as the novel is concerned, the Wesley series is better than the original series.
In the past, I saw a lot of Ni Kuang's novels, which had been lowered for a period of time, and I did not think that in fact, I had never left Ni Kuang's works.
In 2016, the Hong Kong Book Fair set its annual theme for the first time. That year, the theme was “The Literature of the Martial Arts ”. For the book“ Jin Yong: From Hong Kong to the World ”, I reviewed a series of five principal research books written by Ni Kuang. The film is all about Ni Kuang scriptwriting.
These two things are explained below.
When I was a teenager, I watched Ni Kuang. Ni Kuang wrote science fiction, martial arts novels, movie scripts, newspaper essays, financial commentary, etc., as well as being the host of the TV talk show “Don ’ t Defend Tonight ” with James Wong and Lan Choi. Ni Kuang is a legendary writer in Hong Kong.
Wesley Science Fiction: A Change of Head
When Ni Kuang saw the entrance sign of Wesley Village one day, he thought of using Wesley as a pen name and writing a series of novels in which Wesley was the main character.
Ni Kuang's Wesley series began with "Diamond Flower", when the positioning is modern martial arts romance novels, Wesley is a traveler, but also a deep martial arts famous, the novel fusion martial arts, words, adventure in a furnace, can not be seen at the beginning of the science fiction road, began in 1964 serialized "Demon Fire", only science fiction materials.
From Diamond to New Year, the Wesley series ran for ten years in the Ming Pao supplement from 1963 to 1973, including "Blue Blood Man", "Alien Man", "Old Cat", "Golden Globe", "Pen Friends", "Building", "Old Voice" and "Change of Head".
Between 1978 and 1992, he published several novels from "Hair" to "Bad Root" in the supplement of Ming Pao.
The novel was published only in book form, and no longer serialized in newspaper supplements, until the 2004 edition of Friends Only, which ended the Wesley series.
Over the years, the Wesley series has been popular, and it has attracted the attention of readers in Hong Kong and Taiwan. There are also some papers with the Wesley series as the main research object. Unfortunately, in recent years, the discussion of Chinese science fiction has focused too much on contemporary Chinese fiction writers.
But it is a shame to see it and not to see it.
In fact, there is plenty of room for discussion about the features of Wesley ’ s novels.
There is no shortage of ingenious works in Wesley's novels. The "Artificial President" (renamed "Head-Changing" when it was published), which began to be serialized at the end of 1967, has a rather unique political meaning.
So, the dictator's "soul" takes Wesley away, and asks Wesley to persuade the biologist Professor Oz to perform head replacement surgery for the dictator.
Wesley refuses, but Professor Oz is captured by the "soul", and Wesley risks himself and even impersonates the person who gave birth.
In the midst of a thousand dangers, the dictator changed his mind...
The book is reminiscent of the Chinese Communist Party ’ s atomic bomb test in the mid-1960s, the animal experiments of the two major powers during the Cold War, and even the authoritarian politics of terror at that time.
Sin and Religion: The Hair
"Hair" (Old Version: "Nameless Hair") is one of the masterpieces of the Wesley series. In the novel, Wesley is entrusted by a friend of the professor to find the son of a hippie, Barry, in Nepal, Wesley can not find Barry, but find Barry's friend, Sinny, and Barry, from a dream instrument, learned that the flesh is useless, and people can go back to their original paradise. With Sini, Burley is dead, but his soul is reincarnated as a Black Army natives in South America, and becomes quite evil, but Burley is shot and killed after breaking into a military zone.
Instead, Wesley went to heaven and found the truth through devices and hair that could send beams of thought light (souls)...

New Quantum Control Law Could Advance the Development of Quantum Computers
July 29, 2022 09: 07 | Source: Science and Technology Daily
Small number
Previous: New Quantum Control Law Could Advance the Development of Quantum Computers
To the extent that quantum computers can meet their expected performance potential, large-scale quantum processors and memories need to be developed.
To do this, precise control of the qubits is critical, but the method of controlling the qubits has limitations for high-precision large-scale high-density wiring.
Researchers at Yokohama National University in Japan have found a way to precisely control qubits.
This advance is a step toward larger quantum computing.
The findings were published in the journal Nature Photonics on the 26th.
Scientists at Yokohama National University Graduate School of Engineering said: Microwaves are usually used for separate quantum control, but require separate wiring of microwave circuits.
In addition, it is possible to manipulate qubits locally, but not to use light precisely.
Using the nitrogen atom vacancy center in the diamond, the team demonstrated control of the qubit by manipulating the electron spin through a combination of microwave manipulation and local optical movement of atomic and molecular transition frequencies.
This process is known as the Stark shift.
In other words, they were able to combine laser-dependent optical methods with microwaves to overcome previous limitations.
The researchers demonstrated that this control of electron spin, in turn, controls the nuclear spin of nitrogen atoms at the nitrogen vacancy center, and the interaction between electrons and nuclear spins.
Simultaneous irradiation of light and microwaves can individually and precisely control qubits without individual wiring.
The team says this paves the way for the realization of large-scale quantum processors and memories, which are crucial for the development of large-scale quantum computers.
In addition, quantum entanglement between electron spin and nuclear spin has been realized.
This allows the connection between qubits and photons, requires less computing power, and transmits information to quantum processors and quantum memories through the quantum teleportation principle.
The new method meets all of the DiVincenzo standards, which are required for quantum computers to operate, including scalability, initialization, measurement, general gates, and coherence.
It can also be applied to other magnetic field schemes other than the Stark offset, in which qubits can be manipulated separately, and it prevents common types of computational errors, such as gate errors or ambient noise.
Researchers say that by further improving the resolution of individual quantum operations and entanglement operations, large-scale integration of diamond quantum computers, quantum storage and quantum sensors can be achieved.
It will also improve the data transmission capabilities of quantum relay networks for long-distance quantum communications and distributed quantum computer networks or quantum internet.

In economic terms, the two countries have close cooperation, and the trade between the two countries has developed vigorously. In 2019, the bilateral trade volume between Canada and China was 7.46 billion US dollars, ranking first in Africa.

Under the framework of the Belt and Road Initiative and the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation, China has played an important role in Ghana ’ s economic transformation, especially in infrastructure construction and health and health development.
China's investment in Ghana is very broad, covering agriculture, industry, services, mining, health and infrastructure.

Ghana is looking forward to deepening economic and trade cooperation with China.

With the support of the Ghanaian government, such flagship projects as "One County, One Plant" and "Planting for Food and Employment" have developed smoothly.

In addition, Ghana attaches great importance to cultural exchanges with China.
The establishment of the Confucius Institute at the University of Ghana is an important milestone in the process of teaching and disseminating Chinese language and culture in Ghana.
Since the establishment of the college, the number of Ghanaians studying Chinese, martial arts and other elements of Chinese culture has increased significantly.
The Chinese government also offers scholarships to Ghanaian students to study in China.
Ghana hopes to work with China to explore the "gold mine" of tourism, and has introduced a number of tourism incentives to attract foreign investment.
When the epidemic has passed, welcome Chinese friends to Ghana!

“The company is like a study room.

Gary Conroy, CEO of the British cosmetics manufacturing company "5 Squirrels", told CNN on the 1st that the company's internal landscape has changed after the implementation of the four-day working week.
In order to shorten the working hours of employees and improve work efficiency, Conroy designated two hours a day in the morning and afternoon to do not reply to emails, phone calls, company internal information, etc., also known as "deep working hours".
That is to say, the design can work less, but can focus on the "real thing to do" environment.
London advertising company Unity also implemented the four-day week early, after a chaotic adaptation period, quickly found a way out.
All meetings are limited to 5 minutes and customer meetings are limited to 30 minutes.
In addition, in order not to let unnecessary dialogue hinder the work, also introduced a "signal light system".
Every worker on the table is marked "don't talk" in red, "although busy, but there is time for dialogue" in yellow, "no relationship" in blue.
The British think tank Autonomy, in collaboration with research teams from Cambridge University, Oxford University and Boston University, started a four-day workweek demonstration operation in June with 3,300 workers from 70 companies. “As of last month, the quality of life of Icelanders working 36 hours per week has improved dramatically in many ways, ” says Autonomy. The United States, Canada, Australia and other countries have also decided to implement a four-day week in the near future.

It is expected that the hot weather last month caused Cordyceps to migrate to cooler waters, causing a large number of corals to bleach rapidly. Recently, the temperature has dropped slightly, and the Cordyceps may "return" to their native corals.
In 1998, 300 million fish were lost to El Nino.
He recalled the El Niño phenomenon in 1998, when the continuous heat and increased rainfall caused the stratification of the water body, the "lack of oxygen" in some areas of the sea, and the red tide ravaged Hong Kong waters, resulting in the loss of nearly $300 million in fish catches, but it is expected that coral bleaching will return to normal after a period of time last month, and the ecological impact will not be too great.

Zhongshan "mother 's post" why call
August 09, 2022 08: 16 | Source: Guangming Daily
Small number
Original title: Zhongshan "mother 's post" why call
In Chengdu, Sichuan Province, children visited the construction site where their mothers worked.
In recent years, the "mother's post" in Zhongshan City, Guangdong Province, and other places have attracted much attention.
As the name suggests, this is a special position for mothers, with flexible working hours so that mothers can balance family and work.
In other words, the key word of “mother ’ s post ” is flexible work and flexible management.
Women are not only the main body of reproduction, but also the important human capital of society.
Maternity issues and employment issues are intertwined here “she ”.
With the implementation of the "comprehensive three-child" policy, it is more urgent to reduce the family's fertility costs and ease the pressure of female parenting.
In the context of the decline of the demographic dividend, it is also true to attach importance to half of the human capital of "she". "Mom's post" allows mothers to return to the workplace and realize their personal social value, which is an attempt to reshape the employment environment and gender concept.
So, what are the forms of flexible and flexible employment of "mother's post"?
What value and impact will it have?
What are the implications of the current exploration?
Let's share our concerns.
“Mom wants it and wants it. ”
In the port town of Zhongshan City, Huang Chunhua, a 29-year-old female worker, took down a sound host that appeared at a constant speed on the conveyor belt and expertly affixed operating instructions to the bottom of them.
These speakers will then float across the sea and appear on the shelves of supermarkets in Europe and the United States.
Although this kind of work has to be repeated hundreds of times a day, she can get about 4,000 yuan in a month.
And the working time is very flexible, you can ask for leave at any time, the vacancy of the leave is filled by the on-site all-around workers, and the delayed working hours can be selected in other times of the month whether to fill up.
This allows Huang Chunhua no longer to pick up children to and from school and work time conflict and experience inner ripping.
It is worth mentioning that her salary income and welfare benefits should not be affected at all.
In Zhongshan, this kind of work that allows mothers to both work and earn money and take care of their children, flexible scheduling of time, has a loud and warm name: Mom Gang.
It is understood that in the company where Huang Chunhua worked, there are 236 "mother posts" like her, accounting for about one-third of the company's front-line employees.
In the whole city of Zhongshan, more than 160 enterprises have set up "mother's post", and the number of posts exceeds 4,000, and it is still growing.
At the same time, in Foshan, Guangdong, more than 250 enterprises have opened "mother's post", covering e-commerce, business, industrial production, domestic service and other fields, providing employment opportunities for more than 3,200 mothers.
Similar attempts have been made in some parts of the country.
A pharmaceutical factory in Jiangxi Jian Xijiang County has set up a production line for left-behind mothers; in Chongren County, Fuzhou, clothing enterprises have set up sewing "community workshops" near the school to attract mothers to work.
In recent years, China's fertility policy has been intensively adjusted and gradually liberalized, following the implementation of the "comprehensive two children" in 2016, last May, the "comprehensive three children" era officially opened.
In this context, reducing the cost of childbearing and alleviating the pressure of childcare have become the focus of social attention.
A number of studies on the desire to have children have found that because women spend more time caring for their families, career development is limited and income is reduced, causing them to hesitate in multi-child decision-making.
Shen Yang, associate professor of the School of International and Public Affairs of Shanghai Jiao Tong University and researcher of the China Urban Governance Research Institute, cited relevant research in China that under the background of educational competition, the spread of "intensive parenting" has exacerbated the role conflicts faced by women.
Yang Juhua, a professor at the School of Ethnology and Sociology of the Central University of Nationalities, said that reducing the cost of pregnancy, childbirth, parenting and education is an important goal of improving the policy of supporting fertility.
In addition to the production stage, the guarantee of the upbringing stage also needs to be paid attention to, among which it is necessary to guarantee the rights and interests of the child-rearing subject to return to the stage of employment
From this perspective, the "mother's post" defuses the role of women, so that those who are forced to interrupt their careers due to childbirth can return to the labor market, even if only as a transition in a special period, which to a certain extent alleviates the economic pressure of childbearing families.
"This has a positive effect on alleviating reproductive anxiety among women of childbearing age and releasing their reproductive potential," said Chen Mei, an associate professor at Zhengzhou University's Business School.
How flexible employment is possible
Huang Chunhua and her workers encountered a job search dilemma before finding a "mother's post" job. "It is not that work requires overtime or travel, can not take care of home, or the company thinks that we can not devote ourselves to work."
However, on the other hand, under the impact of the epidemic, migrant workers have accelerated their return to their "home", and employment tensions have intensified.
In the face of the continuous recovery of the order volume, many business owners can only look at the "single" sigh.
In order to rush to complete the order, often in a hurry to "borrow people".
On one side, women who want to work are bound by their families and cannot “start ”, and on the other side, there is a large number of employment enterprises.“ Is it possible, we can make a link between enterprises with employment needs and women with employment needs? ”
In May 2021, the exploration of “Mama ’ s Gang ” was officially launched in Zhongshan.
Zhongshan people's social departments and women's federations at all levels have joined forces to visit labor units and collect information on the flexible work needs of some enterprises, and intend to start from the link of supply and demand information.
Hair stylists, oil sprayers, dates, general workers, room cleaners, assemblers … Soon, the first batch of employment information was released on the WeChat public account of Zhongshan City Women ’ s Federation, and this flexible work and flexible management employment model was officially named “Mom ’ s Gang ”.
The name just rang out.
"The number of clicks in two or three hours reached six or seven thousand, which is very rare," said Zhang Hui, director of the Missions Department of the Zhongshan Women's Federation.
In the comments section below, netizens left a message: "I hope to spread to all townships" and suggested adding some posts with certain cultural requirements such as editing and proofreading. "These feedback let us see the strong demand for women postpartum employment, and also strengthen the determination to continue to be a 'mother'." Yu Jiansi said.
In the promotion process, some people think that the "mother's post" is a part-time worker, a production worker or a part-time job.
In this regard, Guangdong Provincial Women's Federation President Xu Hong clarified that in fact, this is not the case, "mother's post" can also be a normal work of 8 hours, occasionally need flexible management positions, or the need for professional skills can work from home.
According to reports, after more than a year of exploration, "Mom Gang" has developed at least four different models.
The first is the flexible "mother's post" where Huang Chunhua is located, the company selects pure manual operation or low technical threshold from the original process of the assembly line to split out, female workers work 5 to 8 hours a day, commuting time is free to master.
The second is called the elastic "mother class", enterprises according to the performance and capacity of different machines, divided into different working hours, female workers can choose on their own.
The third is the outgoing "mobile post", for easy to carry, purely handmade small parts, enterprises regularly door-to-door delivery, timed door-to-door delivery, very friendly to women in high demand for family care.
In contrast, the last one is to be trendy, is the work place of the double flexible "mother new format post".
Such as creative design, copywriting planning, live broadcast anchors, e-commerce operations and other new flexible employment needs.
This kind of work is highly autonomous, flexible, and has certain requirements for professional skills, which is becoming the preferred choice of more and more white-collar mothers.
In Henglan Town, Zhongshan City, which has the reputation of "the hometown of Chinese flowers and trees", more than 200 "treasure mothers" have been transformed into "flower sisters" and live broadcast goods in local flower and wood stalls.
As the "sister" of IP, it is accelerating to develop.
“Mothers ’ posts ” increase female labor force participation
For the decision to set up a "mother's post", in the interview, some enterprises claimed to be out of social responsibility and other considerations of "making profits" behavior.
Huang Chunhua's company's head Yu Qing first thought so.
"Let the profit" said, the default premise is that the employment of postpartum women, enterprises to pay higher employment costs.
Take the assembly line where Huang Chunhua is, because mothers may take time off at any time, in order to not let the production be affected, the company has to add "all-round workers" positions in order to "top the post" at any time.
For enterprises, the loss of working hours, the transformation of production processes and management, etc., are indeed additional costs to bear.
Li Lei, a professor at the School of Economics at Nankai University, also pointed out that compared with men, due to the natural division of labor in childbirth and child care, women are at a disadvantage in terms of work time input and work continuity, which determines that enterprises may bear additional costs when hiring women.
But what Yu Qing did not expect was that although the women workers in the "mother's post" worked flexibly, their work performance was very strong.
They have counted that the "mother's post" staff turnover rate is low, stable at about 5%, while other employment models often 15%, and in some seasons even more than 30%.
And because of the strong sense of belonging and high loyalty, the work efficiency and product qualification rate of "mother's post" are also higher than that of ordinary workers.
Therefore, the company assured the production of high-end products to the "mother" staff.
Yu Qing's statistics and observations have been confirmed in earlier studies by Chen Mei and Li Lei.
In a paper published last year, two scholars found that the increase in the share of female employment has a positive effect on the export scale of enterprises, and the impact is greater in foreign-funded enterprises, skill-intensive enterprises, female-intensive industries, high-tech industries and areas with low female education levels.
More importantly, Li Lei added, in the long run, the policy bias or care for female employees during childbirth is of positive significance for enterprises to fully obtain the future benefits of human capital investment such as employee training, and harvest the productivity growth brought by inclusive and diverse labor groups, "which is conducive to reducing the labor cost of unit output in the long-term development of enterprises."
"At the beginning, it was the mentality of the enterprise to make profits to do this thing, and the enterprise eventually became the real beneficiary." Yu Qing said, after seeing the huge potential of "mother's post", the company absorbed more work shares to recruit "mother's post".
Right now, the new “sweet annoyance ” is that the company ’ s labor demand is still increasing, but“ the mothers who need it nearby are already employed. ”
In recent years, with the economic and social development of China, the fertility rate has decreased, the working-age population has decreased, and the demographic dividend has gradually faded and is irreversible. Chen Mei believes that women of childbearing age are both the main body of fertility and an important human resource. The use of skills to promote economic growth is of great importance.
It is also based on this, many scholars stressed that we should shift from the "demographic dividend" to pay attention to the "gender dividend", and pointed out that increasing the female labor force participation rate and realizing the use of the existing female population's labor force and skills can bring a new round of economic growth, and bring a wide range of economic and social impact.
Chen Mei and Li Lei both said that the exploration of this form of employment, "full of warmth and wisdom", "may form a win-win situation for employees, families, enterprises and the country."
Shen Yang also pointed out that the promotion of "mother's post" is conducive to the fundamental promotion of women's development.
Share the cost of birth
In the company where Huang Chunhua worked, "mother's post" is equal pay and equal treatment with other posts.
This also means that in addition to salary, the company has to pay 732 yuan of social security and 95 yuan of provident fund every month for every "mother's post" female employee.
However, a few months later, the company will save nearly 400 yuan per person per month, nearly half of the payment amount. In early July, the Zhongshan government issued a number of measures to vigorously promote the new mode of employment of "mother 's post", and formally implemented the work of "mother' s post" into the city 's State Council solid and stable economic policy package implementation plan.
The support document clarifies the tax relief, training support, employment service management and many other "mother's post" support policies, "including the amount of 'gold' is very high," said Xu Hong, chairman of the Guangdong Provincial Women's Federation.
According to the policy, every worker who successfully applies for a labor contract and signs a labor contract with the worker for more than one year and pays social security for the worker according to regulations, will receive 300 yuan of social security subsidy and 100 yuan of post subsidy each month.
If the qualified worker and the employer sign a labor agreement rather than a labor contract and pay social security in an individual capacity, then the social security subsidy of 300 yuan is paid to the mother herself.
In addition, whether it is labor contract employment or labor service employment, enterprises that successfully declare "mother's post" can enjoy a precision training subsidy of no more than 500 yuan per year; if the employed are people who are out of poverty or registered unemployed for more than half a year, then enjoy a variety of tax benefits of 7800 yuan.
It is understood that the special fund set up by the government of Zhongshan City reached 5 million yuan.
In order to promote flexible forms of employment such as "mother's post", Zhongshan people's social departments opened up online and offline information dissemination and recruitment channels, and carried out inspections and supervision according to law, and urged enterprises to implement labor laws and regulations.
This subsidy of real money is considered to be a practical measure for the government to share the cost of childbirth with individuals and enterprises, so it has been highly praised.
Li Lei, chairman of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the Communist Party of China (CPC) Central Committee, said that the new policy will
Yang Hui, deputy researcher of the Women's Institute of the All-China Women's Federation, also believes that the relevant subsidies will benefit women in high-skilled, high-quality professional and technical posts and management positions in large and medium-sized enterprises, which will produce more positive social benefits.
With the intensive adjustment of maternity policies, various localities have introduced supporting measures, such as extending maternity leave and increasing paternity leave.
Lu Jiehua, a professor of sociology at Peking University, said in an interview with the media that enterprises, as the main body of economic development, may lack the initiative to hire female employees.
However, Huang Xueli, director of the Zhongshan Municipal People's Society, believes that the flexible employment of postpartum women such as "mother's post" can be included in the scope of provincial and municipal and central employment subsidies.
At present, the subsidies of the above-mentioned special funds are mainly targeted at people with employment difficulties, college graduates and so on.
Since some of the "mother jobs" are flexible employment, some people label them as low-skilled.
Chen Mei said that there is no need to worry about this.
Although flexible employment may seem "irregular", it does not mean low-skilled, low-quality employment.
In the future, with the expansion of flexible employment scale, the improvement of employment quality, and the strengthening of relevant policy guarantees, the related discrimination will be alleviated.
In this regard, Huang Xueli also pointed out that for flexible employment people need to further strengthen vocational ability training and fundamentally improve their employability.
"We need to realize that supporting the family, or more accurately, balancing the professional development and childcare responsibilities of women, is more likely to rely on the government to vigorously develop the public childcare service system, and further share the responsibility of family care," said Yang, an associate researcher at the Institute of Population and Labor Economics of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences.
"The experience of foreign and domestic provinces and cities to increase male paternity leave and parental leave is worth learning and encouraging." Yang Ge and Shen Yangjun pointed out that this will be conducive to guiding men to readjust the time allocation of work and family investment and assume more parental responsibilities.
On this hot summer day, Huang Chunhua and the children of the workers play in the exclusive activity room 100 meters away from the mother to accompany her mother to work.
Elsewhere, more uncles and aunts are actively rushing to find more possibilities for that “half sky. ”
(Reporter Dan Wang)
