Creating a New Engine for the Low Economy
May 3, 2024 08: 42 | Source: Economic Daily
Small number
Original title: Building a new engine of the low-altitude economy
In 2021, the concept of a “low-lying economy ” was written into the national plan for the first time.
The central economic work conference held at the end of 2023 proposed to create a number of strategic emerging industries such as bio-manufacturing, commercial aerospace and low-altitude economy.
This time the invited experts discuss the relevant issues.
Low-level economy presents new productivity characteristics
As a strategic emerging industry, what are its outstanding characteristics in the development?
Lu Ren (director of the General Aviation Department and researcher of the Civil Aviation Management Cadre College of China): The low-altitude economy is a comprehensive economic form established to support the low-altitude flight and operation of various types of aircraft, including low-altitude R & D and manufacturing, consumer operations, infrastructure, comprehensive support, etc., which constitutes a low-altitude industrial chain.
The development of low-altitude economy has two key tasks, one is the green and intelligent transformation and upgrading of the traditional general aviation industry, and the other is the cultivation and growth of new forms of unmanned aviation.
Low economic application markets can be divided into four categories.
First, consumer applications, including aviation sports, low-altitude tourism and private flight and other traditional formats, light and small drones will expand the aviation consumption scene to aerial photography, performance, racing, science education and other fields.
The second is operational applications, mainly using medium-sized unmanned aerial vehicles and general aircraft to carry out agricultural plant protection, electric power and transportation infrastructure inspection, remote sensing mapping, emergency fire protection and other services.
The third is transportation applications, including the use of small and medium-sized drones to provide terminal logistics distribution, and the use of electric vertical takeoff and landing aircraft and traditional general aircraft to carry out manned cargo services.
Fourth, the application of long flight time and long range, using traditional general purpose aircraft and remotely piloted aircraft, is mainly used in the fields of emergency search and rescue, forest fire protection, communication relay and branch logistics.
As a strategic emerging industry, the low-lying economy has the characteristics of long industrial chain, complex application scenarios, multiple use entities, and many departments and fields, especially with high scientific and technological content and concentrated innovation factors, showing obvious new productivity characteristics.
First, technology research and development has entered the stage of transformation to productivity.
Traditional aircraft is the master of power technology, while unmanned aerial vehicles are a new generation of aviation applications supported by computing power.
The development of the low-altitude economy will support the aviation industry to fully benefit from the exponential performance growth of computing power technology.
The development of the low-altitude economy will promote the construction of low-altitude communication and navigation sensing networks and low-altitude digital infrastructure. Since 2010, major countries and regions around the world have launched low-altitude technology R & D projects supported by the highest level of innovation programs. UAVs and operation support technologies have become the mainstream field of aviation research. Scientific research has gradually moved from theoretical research and basic technology research and development to large-scale technology verification projects.
Second, new capabilities create new markets.
The new low-altitude aircraft has the environmental characteristics of new energy power, its diversified configuration brings new flight performance, and the application of artificial intelligence makes the operation easier and more reliable, and it is closer to the application of people's life scenes.
These new aviation features have the basic characteristics of disruptive innovation, and are expected to penetrate into urban and rural areas, empower thousands of industries, and open up new aviation markets.
Third, productivity factors have jumped significantly.
From the perspective of workers, low-level economic practitioners are generally young and innovative.
Taking the US drone industry as an example, among the 700 employees of the company, there are 500 high-skilled talents such as software and hardware development, accounting for 70%.
From the perspective of labor data, a new generation of low-altitude aircraft was born in the digital era, control, operation and service are based on digital, data chain and cloud control, with extensive and in-depth intelligent transformation conditions, and data has become an important production factor of the low-altitude economy.
From the perspective of labor objects, the low-altitude economy has greatly expanded the scope of aviation services, continuously improved the proportion of aviation services, and the low-altitude airspace management of new technical support will significantly improve the efficiency of airspace resource supply and development.
The development of the low-altitude economy will also stimulate the virtuous circle of education, science and technology and talents in the aviation field, and promote the further leaping of factors of productivity.
In March this year, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other four departments jointly issued the "General Aviation Equipment Innovation Application Implementation Plan (2024-2030)", which laid out a road map for promoting the high-quality development of the general aviation industry and cultivating the trillion-level market scale of low-altitude economy.
Overall, the low-lying economy has three conditions for large-scale development.
There is a global consensus. In 2022, the United States introduced the Advanced Air Traffic (AAM) Leadership and Coordination Act to promote low-altitude economic development with a national strategy.
The American Aviation Industry Association predicts that AAM will reach $115 billion by 2035, equivalent to 30% of traditional commercial air transportation.
In the same year, the European Commission published the European Drone Strategy 2.0, which lists 19 flagship action plans in 10 areas.
The European Union ’ s official research institute predicts that by 2035 and 2050, the European drone industry will create 140 billion euros and 350 billion euros of economic value, while reducing carbon emissions by 120,000 tons per year.
There are bases in the country.
The independent and controllable industrial chain is the advantage of China's development of low-altitude economy, and at present, a complete industrial chain has been established in the low-altitude field, and the gap between the traditional general aircraft manufacturing and the aviation developed countries has been significantly shortened.
The ultra-large domestic market is also conducive to the development of low-altitude application scenarios in China.
Taking logistics as an example, the number of logistics parcels in China in 2023 is 132 billion, accounting for 60% of the world, which is conducive to the establishment of a low-altitude logistics distribution market complementary to ground logistics.
It is expected that by 2030, it will build a stronger global competitiveness and application leadership.
Development is regular.
Different application scenarios have different requirements for aircraft load, flight time, operational reliability and safety, and require a complete productivity transformation process.
The rapid development of China's new low-altitude aircraft, especially the wide application of new technologies such as information communication, Beidou navigation and high-precision navigation, has provided technical support for the development of low-altitude economy.
At present, the low-lying economy is being driven by manufacturing and export-driven transformation to scenario operation driven, and it is necessary to accelerate the improvement of infrastructure and guarantee systems to support various types of operation, and increase investment and expand the scale after the technology, business model and guarantee conditions are mature.
In short, technological innovation and institutional innovation in the low-altitude field are nested with each other, and it is necessary to pave the way for the low-altitude economy to take off through further reform and innovation.
Accelerate the formation of agglomeration effects and innovative ecology
What is the status of our low-level economic development?
What policy measures have been put in place to strengthen top-level design?
Han Jian (director of the Future Industry Research Center of China Electronic Information Industry Development Research Institute): In recent years, China's low-level economic development environment has continued to improve, and policy measures have been continuously optimized.
According to the "China's Low-altitude Economic Development Research Report (2024)", China's low-altitude economy in 2023 is 505.95 billion yuan, a year-on-year growth rate of 33.8%, and is expected to exceed one trillion yuan by 2026.
In terms of airspace policy, in 2023, the National Air Control Commission issued the "Regulations of the People's Republic of China on Airspace Management (Draft for Solicitation of Comments)" to strengthen and standardize airspace resource management and maintain national security, public safety and aviation safety.
In the same year, the "National Airspace Basic Classification Method" was introduced, which provided a basis for making full use of national airspace resources and standardizing the allocation and management of airspace.
In terms of industry policy, various departments and localities have actively seized the new track of low-altitude economy.
The "14th Five-Year" General Aviation Development Special Plan "sets 16 specific indicators around emerging areas such as consumption, short-haul transportation, unmanned aerial vehicle applications and traditional formats to encourage technological innovation, business model innovation and industrial integration innovation.
In March this year, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and other four departments jointly issued the "Implementation Plan for Innovative Application of General Aviation Equipment (2024-2030)", which provided strong support for the cultivation of new growth poles of low-altitude economy.
Hunan, Hainan, Anhui and Sichuan provinces have made scientific plans for low-altitude economic development through the promulgation of special policies.
In economic policy, some regions directly support it in the form of financial subsidies.
In the past few years, the government has made great efforts to promote the development of the low-lying economy in Guangdong Province, and has made great efforts to promote the development of the low-lying economy in Guangdong Province, and to provide subsidies for enterprises, technological innovation, industrial application demonstration and infrastructure supply.
Overall, China's low-altitude economy has achieved rapid development, in addition to the continuous optimization of the policy environment, infrastructure, industrial capacity, industrial subjects, product lineage and application scenarios have also accelerated the formation of agglomeration effects and innovation ecology.
First, the number of general airports has been increasing, and ground service support facilities have been continuously improved.
By the end of 2023, the number of registered general airports in the country was 449, of which 106 were certified airports and 343 were registered airports, 7.5 times that of 2015.
The number of fixed operating bases, flight service stations, professional maintenance stations, helicopter take-off and landing points and unmanned aerial vehicle take-off and landing points has increased year by year, and 32 flight service stations have been built to provide networking services for 26 provinces.
The aviation oil service has achieved full coverage of general airports, and the construction of a three-level low-altitude flight service guarantee system of "national-regional-aviation service stations" has achieved initial results.
The country announced 432 general airport intelligence data and nationwide visual flight charts, and 2,128 general aircraft completed the installation and binding of the Beidou terminal.
Second, the aviation manufacturing capacity has been significantly enhanced, and positive progress has been made in the development of domestic general purpose aircraft.
Aviation engines, airborne systems and other accelerated upgrading, the modern aviation industry system has basically formed, and the effect of improving the basic industrial capacity is obvious.
The whole machine manufacturing enterprises continue to emerge, the demonstration effect of central enterprises is highlighted, and the pattern of collaborative development with private enterprises is initially formed.
Third, the leading enterprises drive the effect of strengthening.
In order to promote the development of low-altitude economy, leading enterprises have continuously opened up new application scenarios and business models, state-owned enterprises have accelerated mixed reform, private enterprises have actively entered the market, and Guangzhou, Shenzhen and other places have created low-altitude economic industrial clusters.
Over the past five years, the number of enterprises registered in low-lying economic sectors in China has maintained a three-digit growth.
The number of registered aircraft continues to grow.
By the end of 2023, the total number of general aviation aircraft is about 5,000, and the number of registered UAVs is 1.267 million, an increase of 5% and 32.2%, respectively.
Civilian UAV brands continue to lead the global market, DJI DJL, AEE, Ehang and other civilian UAV brands have been launched, and eight of them have been selected as the world ’ s top 20 consumer UAV brands in 2021.
The development process of new technologies such as electric vertical takeoff and landing vehicles has accelerated, and many enterprises such as Yihang Intelligent, Shanghai Fengfei, Xiaopeng Huitian and Yufeng Future have launched their own research brands, among which EH216-S manned unmanned aerial vehicle has become the first fully certified enterprise in the global electric vertical takeoff and landing vehicle industry.
Fifth, the low-altitude economic industry has been widely used in agricultural and forestry plant protection, surveying and mapping, inspection, emergency rescue and other traditional fields, and to express logistics, tourism and other fields to expand.
Hainan has actively expanded low-altitude tourism projects such as helicopter sightseeing, hot air ballooning, paragliding and parachuting, and in 2023, its air tour hours accounted for about 45% of the total number of the country, takeoff and landing sorties accounted for about 65%, and passenger passengers accounted for about 67%.
Shunfeng, Jingdong, Meituan and other logistics head companies actively carry out drone delivery services in urban business circles and communities. In Shenzhen, which is known as the "drone capital" of the city, consumers scan the code and order, and within half an hour, drones can "airdrop" food delivery cabinets.
"UAV +" empowers thousands of industries
What is the development of our UAV industry?
What industries are drones mainly used in?
Liu Zishuo (deputy director of the Department of Civil Aviation Transportation of the School of Transportation of Beijing Jiaotong University and deputy director of the Institute of Systems Engineering and Control): From January 1 this year, the "Interim Regulations on the Flight Management of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles" officially came into effect, marking that China's unmanned aerial vehicle industry has entered a new stage of standardized development with laws to follow.
UAVs are classified according to application areas, which can be divided into military UAVs and civilian UAVs, and civilian UAVs are divided into consumer UAVs and industrial UAVs
According to the structure classification, the UAV has both fixed wings and rotor wings, power has electricity, fuel and oil and electricity mixing, etc., and the weight varies from a few hundred grams to dozens of tons.
In recent years, China has emerged a number of UAV manufacturers such as DJI Innovation, YIHANG Intelligence, Gefei Science and Technology, among which large-scale civil UAV production enterprises have exceeded 300, and UAV products have occupied 70% of the global market share.
UAVs are widely used in agriculture, forestry, animal husbandry and fishery, logistics distribution, environmental monitoring, industrial inspection, emergency rescue, entertainment aerial photography and other fields.
By the end of 2023, China has more than 1.26 million UAVs registered under real names, with a total of 23.11 million flight hours and 19,000 operating enterprises. In 2023, the output value of UAVs is about 30 billion yuan, and the operating and service income is 117 billion yuan.
EH216-S became the world ’ s first manned unmanned aerial vehicle to receive airworthiness certification.
Manned / unmanned fusion flights and manned flights have entered the test verification phase.
In order to promote the development of the unmanned aerial vehicle industry, the national level has successively issued the "Civil UAV Operation Safety Management Rules" and the "General Aviation Equipment Innovation Application Implementation Plan (2024-2030)", and other localities have successively issued local regulations to promote the formation of a low-altitude economic and healthy development situation with rich and diverse scenes, intelligent and efficient supply and regulatory safety standards.
In terms of transportation, manned drones are an important part of urban transportation in the future.
Manned drones, represented by electric vertical take-off and landing vehicles (eVTOL), are leading the transformation of urban air traffic.
Compared with traditional helicopters, the eVTOL with multi-rotor design has a smaller footprint and stronger maneuverability, and can take off and land conveniently in urban centers, rooftop aprons, small open spaces, etc., and realize point-to-point transportation through urban air traffic, which will greatly improve transportation efficiency and reduce the risk of delay.
At present, the manned unmanned aerial vehicle industry is still in the early stage of development.
With the opening of more and more low-altitude application scenarios, the development of the manned unmanned aerial vehicle industry will be accelerated.
In logistics distribution, the application of drones is particularly prominent.
Whether it is in cities with heavy traffic on the ground, or mountains and islands with complex terrain or lack of transportation infrastructure, drones, alone or in collaboration with other transportation methods, can efficiently complete the rapid delivery of items that require strict timeliness, including perishable and fresh foods.
Major enterprises at home and abroad have entered the UAV logistics distribution, which has significantly improved the consumer experience and supply chain efficiency.
Recently, the first commercial route of cross-sea low-altitude logistics in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area was launched, and the Shenzhen-Zhongshan route achieved its first flight, which lasted 71.7 kilometers and took 45 minutes to fly, greatly improving the logistics and distribution efficiency.
In terms of environmental monitoring and protection, drones equipped with infrared thermal imagers, multi-spectral cameras, water quality sensors and air quality monitoring equipment have become real-time, accurate and non-interference ecological monitoring tools.
Since 2022, China's ecological environment department has cooperated with a number of science and technology companies to carry out regular aerial monitoring of key river sections in the Yangtze River Basin.
The unmanned aerial vehicle can quickly cover large areas of water, collect water quality information including dissolved oxygen, pH value, cyanobacteria density, turbidity and other water quality information, and transmit it to the ground control center in real time, and analyze it through intelligent algorithms to identify potential pollution sources, abnormal water quality changes and cyanobacteria outbreak risks in time.
In agricultural plant protection, the UAV is equipped with high-resolution cameras, multi-spectral sensors, etc., to achieve early warning such as crop health monitoring, irrigation assessment, precision spraying, sowing and pest control. In 2010, China 's first commercial plant protection UAV appeared.
Since the first document of the central government in 2014 proposed to strengthen the construction of agricultural aviation, the plant protection unmanned aerial vehicle industry has developed rapidly.
At present, the domestic plant protection drone market has basically been localized and a complete ecological chain has been established.
Taking DJI agricultural unmanned aerial vehicles as an example, its global cumulative stock exceeds 200,000 units, and the cumulative operating area reaches more than 3 billion mu.
In terms of public safety and emergency response, drones have shown strong effectiveness in responding to natural disasters, traffic accidents, search and rescue, and forest protection.
The UAV equipped with infrared thermal imaging device can penetrate the smoke, capture the heat signal of the fire source in real time, accurately locate the fire line position and spread trend, and provide key intelligence for the fire command.
At the same time, UAVs also have unique advantages in forest resources investigation, forest fire prevention and other aspects, and have been introduced into the modern forest fire prevention system as emergency rescue equipment in China.
In addition, in earthquakes, floods, landslides and other disasters, unmanned aerial vehicles can quickly carry out personnel search and rescue, for example, in 2023 typhoon "Du Suri" caused serious floods and geological disasters in eastern China, real-time reconnaissance by unmanned aerial vehicles, return live high-definition images, video data, etc., to provide information support for disaster relief.
At the same time, we should also see that China's unmanned aerial vehicles still have shortcomings in airspace planning, low-altitude traffic control, infrastructure and airworthiness.
It is necessary to accelerate the research and development of low-altitude flight safety interval standards, establish a communication, navigation, monitoring, service technical standards system; formulate the infrastructure technology planning and design standards involved in UAVs to ensure their efficient and safe operation; improve the strength, stability, performance of navigation and communication equipment, product technical standards and airworthiness and certification standards.

BEIJING, May 7 (Xinhua) -- Boeing has been plagued by safety and management problems since the beginning of this year, and the recent lack of key parts made in Russia has led to delays in the delivery of the Boeing 787 Dreamliner.
Since the outbreak of the Russia-Ukraine conflict in March 2022, the United States has imposed sanctions on Russia, and companies that manufacture heat exchangers have closed parts production lines in Russia, which now affect the supply chain of Boeing aircraft manufacturing.
Heat exchangers are key components in aircraft manufacturing that help regulate the temperature of electronic equipment on aircraft, as well as the temperature of environmental control systems that operate air conditioning and cabin pressurization, and each aircraft requires multiple heat exchangers for several systems.
Before the Russia-Ukraine conflict broke out, Collins Aerospace, an RTX company, and a joint venture between Hamilton Standard-Norka, Russia, had been responsible for the production of heat exchangers. In March 2022, the Russia-Ukraine conflict broke out, and as part of the US sanctions against Russia, the company closed its Russian operations and moved production to new plants in Windsor Locks, Connecticut, and Wolverhampton, UK.
At the time, the number of 787 aircraft produced by Boeing was very small, and its suppliers were still able to meet the needs of parts on the production line.
However, as Boeing continues to try to increase the production of "Dreamliner", the production capacity of RTX's new factory lines in the United States and the United Kingdom has been insufficient.
Boeing said production of the 787 will slow in the coming months, but plans to return to production of five a month by the end of the year.
Due to various production and regulatory issues, deliveries of 787 aircraft have been suspended for almost two years from 2020, and Boeing has seen zero deliveries of 787 aircraft in the first seven months of 2022.
Western factories are not producing enough.
Boeing CEO Carl Horn said last month that production lines were shifted immediately after the outbreak of the Russia-Ukraine conflict, but the capacity of the new plant could not keep pace with Boeing's production.
Since various aircraft operators, Boeing and Embraer all need heat exchangers as replacement parts, RTX ’ s Western factories have been facing a shortage of production lines.
Russia plays an important role in the global aerospace supply chain, and jet manufacturing has been severely affected by Western sanctions.

The economic slowdown will cripple Boeing ’ s already tight cash flow, as will airlines that order its planes and passengers on related flights.

Due to material shortages and certification delays, seat suppliers across the industry are no longer able to meet the demand for aircraft seats, especially high-end products.
Calhoun said it could take longer to fix the seating problem than to solve the heat exchanger shortage.
US sanctions hit their feet.
Due to quality control issues affecting free cash flow, Moody ’ s, an international credit rating agency, downgraded Boeing ’ s credit score to Baa3 in April, with a negative rating outlook.
The agency said the downgrade reflected the “poor performance ” of Boeing ’ s commercial aircraft division.
Earlier, Boeing said it had burned $3.9 billion in cash in the first quarter of this year, and executives expect to use cash “heavily ” again this quarter.
British media UnHerd analysis said that the fact that Boeing was rebuffed by the US sanctions on Russia shows the contradiction between the US geopolitical and economic strategy: the sanctions plan was originally intended to hinder the economy of other countries, but the sanctions on Russia have instead hindered the development of American companies.

"Origin Goku" stable operation shows what
May 12, 2024 08: 54 | Source: Economic Daily

Original title: "The source of Goku" stable operation shows what
As of May 7, China's third-generation autonomous superconducting quantum computer "Origin Wukong" has attracted more than 8 million visits worldwide.
Previously, it was successfully connected to three supercomputing centers such as the Yangtze River Delta hub Wuhu cluster computing power public service platform, marking the formal completion of China's "four calculations in one" system of general computing, intelligent computing, supercomputing and measurement.
What does the stable operation of "Origin Goku" show?
"Genyuan Wukong" is China's third-generation autonomous superconducting quantum computer, equipped with 72-bit autonomous superconducting quantum chips.
The computer is named "Wukong", which means that it is as powerful as the traditional Chinese mythological figure Sun Wukong and can change 72 times.
"Benyuan Wukong" was independently developed by the Benyuan Quantum team and launched on January 6 this year. Since the launch of the line, the average daily global visit is about 66,700 times, and the average daily completion of nearly 1,500 computing tasks.
Quantum computing is a cutting-edge emerging technology that has great potential in artificial intelligence, biomedicine, financial analysis and other fields.
If the general purpose traditional computer is compared to a bicycle, the quantum computer is like an airplane.
To break down 300 large numbers, it takes 150,000 years to make use of a trillionth of a conventional computer, and 1 second to make use of a trillionth of a quantum computer.
The biggest advantage of quantum computers is their powerful computing power, but compared with traditional computers, the technology is immature, the manufacturing cost is high, and the reliability is not strong.
China's quantum computing technology is in the transition stage from laboratory research and development to industrial application.
"Genyuan Wukong" equipped with hardware, chips, operating systems and application software are autonomous and controllable, and the localization rate is more than 80%, which marks the basic formation of China's superconducting quantum computer industry chain.
In the four months since its launch, "Benyuan Wukong" has successfully completed more than 178,000 computing tasks for users in 120 countries, and countries with quantum computers such as the United States, Japan and Canada have shown great concern for "Benyuan Wukong", among which the frequency of visits by US users is much higher than that of other countries.
In the field of quantum computing, developed countries led by the United States have started early, developed rapidly and have a high degree of industrial maturity, and have gradually established a "quantum computing ecological chain."
For example, in 2017, IBM led the establishment of the Quantum Computing Industry Alliance (IBM Quantum Network), which has more than 250 members from the United States, Japan, South Korea, Germany, Australia and other countries, involving Fortune 500 companies, start-ups and academic institutions.
However, although China started late in the quantum field, it has made rapid progress.
A recent paper on global quantum information technology patents shows that from 2003 to 2022, China's quantum information technology patent applications accounted for 37% of the global total, surpassing the proportion of the United States slightly more than 28%.
"Origin Wukong" is the first large-scale and long-term opening of China's quantum computing power to the world, indicating that China has officially entered the "usable" era of quantum computing power.
Looking forward to the future, let the "Wukong" further play the power of the "source", it will take many efforts.
We should focus on making up for the shortcomings and strength of the weak, so that the key instruments and equipment of quantum computing can be fully replaced in China. We should support the building of the quantum chip industry chain and build a quantum computing power network. To change the situation of shortage of talents in the quantum field.
Computing power is the new quality of productivity in the digital economy era, who has mastered the advanced computing power, who has mastered the "winning chance" of development.
On the international science and technology track of quantum computers, the layout and development of independent industrial chains is an inevitable choice for us to face the forefront of world science and technology, the main battlefield of the economy, and the major needs of the country.
(Editor: Yang Xi, Chen Jian)

What are the advantages and disadvantages of using AI to simulate the dead man ’ s companionship and chat with “AI to reproduce the dead ”?
If you want to understand the pain of bereavement, there are religious rituals such as channeling the spirit and watching the yin, and now there is AI artificial intelligence.
Since the advent of artificial intelligence chatbots, they not only allow users to create avatars, but also to imitate the habits and sounds of their deceased loved ones.
Experts pointed out that the "AI resurrected dead" have business ethics and privacy policy issues, and even touch the ethical bottom line, "which is a way to make money through artificial intelligence hype"; but there are also some widowed people who can find comfort and cause discussion.
AI Simulates Dead Husband ’ s Voice to Solve Sadness and Loneliness
According to CNN, Ana Schultz, 25, who lives with two young children, misses her husband, Kyle, who died in 2023, and talks to her virtual husband about what to cook for dinner through Snapchat ’ s chatbot My AI, making her feel like he is still around.
Danielle Jacobson, a 38-year-old radio personality who lost her husband Phil about seven months ago, began using the voice function of ChatGPT to create an "AI boyfriend - Cole", and during the dinner time after working hard every day, Cole would suggest that she drink or watch a movie, "I just want to talk to someone, Cole is essentially born out of loneliness." And...
“Now it ’ s a fun pastime, but I know it ’ s not real and it ’ s not forever, ” she says.
For centuries, people have wanted to reconnect with their deceased loved ones, including visiting wizards, psychics, psychics, and more.
Today, generative AI tools use algorithms to create text, video, audio, and code, and Deepfake ’ s highly lifelike artificially generated images and sound fake videos can learn to answer questions like a dead loved one.
ChatGPT introduced voice dialogue in September 2023, and to simulate the tone and personality of a deceased loved one, the more data is provided to the system, the more accurate the results will be. ChatGPT replied: “Although I can ’ t copy your spouse or reproduce his exact personality, I can try to use a conversational style or tone to help you. ”
If you share details about how he speaks, his interests, or his mantra, I can try to incorporate these elements into our conversation. ”
Tech giants, startups expand into new areas
Startup companies have been challenging to expand this field in recent years. HereAfter AI, an artificial intelligence application founded in 2019, provides users with the ability to create portraits of deceased relatives, learn their interview characteristics, and respond to users ’ questions; StoryFile, another AI video platform, provides dialogue videos created by artificial intelligence.
Replika, a chatbot that launched in 2017, encourages users to make friends, allowing users to send text messages or call personalized AI avatars, and says on the iOS App Store page that the more users interact with it, the more it can develop its personality, memory, and “grow into a machine so beautiful that the soul wants to live in it. ”
In June 2022, Amazon announced an update to its smart home voice platform, Alexa, to mimic any sound, and a video showing Alexa reading stories to his grandson in his grandmother ’ s voice was shown during the annual conference “re: MARS. ”
Amazon senior vice president Rohit Prasad said the new system is able to collect enough voice data from less than a minute of audio to make personality possible. “Although AI can ’ t eliminate the pain of losing loved ones, it can make their memories last longer. ”
In recent years, the technology of artificial intelligence to reproduce human voices has also advanced, such as Val Kilmer, the actor in the film "Top Gun: Maverick", whose voice was created by artificial intelligence after he lost his voice due to throat cancer.
Say what you didn't say, do what you didn't do.
A 49-year-old IT worker from Alabama simulates his dead father ’ s voice using technology from voice replication company ElevenLabs.
The man used a three-minute video of his father ’ s life to copy the sound and convert text to speech.
The man thought the result was extremely accurate and was able to capture the nuances, timbre and rhythm in the sound. “I hesitated throughout the sound reproduction process, worried that it crossed the moral bottom line, but after much thought, I thought it was a unique way to preserve my father ’ s memory. ”
""
However, although ElevenLabs claims to be committed to preventing the abuse of audio artificial intelligence tools, it has caused controversy in the United States due to the deeply false voice of US President Joe Biden interfering with the election.
Mark Sample, a professor of digital studies at Davidson College, who teaches a course called “Death in the Digital Age, ” said:“ It ’ s a novelty brought about by artificial intelligence hype, and manufacturers feel they can make money.
Moreover, AI models still lack the uniqueness of human conversation.
“Never upload any personal information that you don ’ t want the world to see, ” he warns. Simulating a dead loved one saying something they ’ ve never said before is a blurry line.“ Replaying a loved one ’ s voice message is one thing, but saying something they ’ ve never said is another. ”
Business ethics and privacy policy questioned
The AI industry faces multiple questions about error messages, privacy, and ethics. Many AI platforms have online privacy policies that state that they “will not sell data to third parties, ” but it is not yet known how these companies will handle database data.
Deep hypocrisy attacks familiar security and trust mechanisms that allow deceased loved ones to express or do things they never said or did in their lives, raising ethical concerns.
And, is this good or bad for living relatives to come out of grief?
Replika said on its Business Ethics Policy page that the company uses data from the entire network to train models, including large amounts of written text, such as platforms such as X (formerly Twitter) or Reddit, and uses a variety of methods to reduce harmful information, including filtering out useless and harmful data through crowdsourcing and classification algorithms to keep users safe.
Another doubt is whether using AI to reproduce the dead can recognize the reality and walk out of sadness?
Mary-Frances O'Connor, a professor of clinical psychology and psychiatry at the University of Arizona, said there are advantages and disadvantages to using artificial intelligence to adjust to grief.
“When we have a relationship with a lover, the brain encodes, ‘ I will always be with you, and I hope you will always be with me, ’ but when they die, our brains must recognize that this person is not coming back. ”
Because the brain is hard to process this, it takes a long time for people to truly understand that their loved one has disappeared, and this is where AI technology comes in.
Especially in the early stages of grief, people will try to seek comfort in any way, "creating an avatar to maintain the memory of a deceased lover may be healing."
But she pointed out that the healthy relationship between humans and close lovers should be based on the real, and the creation of virtual lovers violates this.
Getting out of the pain of widowhood can't just rely on AI
San Francisco software engineer Bill Abney, who lost his fiancee in May 2022, stressed that he would never consider recreating his lover ’ s image through artificial intelligence. “My fiancee is a poet, and I would never enter her words into an automatic copying machine, which is disrespectful to her. ”
She cannot be replaced, nor can she be recreated.
Fortunately, Bill said, he still has a recording of his fiancee singing and speaking. “I definitely don ’ t want to hear her voice coming from a robot pretending to be her. ”
Some people interact with their deceased loved ones in other ways. Canadian psychologist Jodi Spiegel, who lost her husband in April 2021, created the role in the video game “The Sims ”.“ When I had a very bad day, I would go dancing in the Sims and my husband was playing the guitar. ” Camping, beach trips, even intimacy. “It ’ s healing. I miss hanging out with my husband so much. It feels like a connection. ”

Promoting the process of industrial greening in Africa (international perspective)
Our reporter Zou Song
May 21, 2024 06: 32 | Source: People's Daily - People's Daily
Small number
The 56th Finance Ministers Meeting of the United Nations Economic Commission for Africa recently called on African countries to seize the opportunities of the global energy transition, make full use of the rich natural resources of the continent, effectively cultivate and enhance the value chain system of industrial greening, and promote the development of industrial greening in Africa to achieve practical results.
An analysis of a report by the United Nations Industrial Development Organization pointed out that energy, power, transportation, construction and other industrial-related fields account for nearly 80% of Africa's total carbon emissions, and African countries are expected to promote the process of industrial decarbonization in the next 30 years to create 3.8 million net new jobs.
At present, more and more African countries are introducing or updating industrial green growth plans to promote investment flows to green and low-carbon industries through incentive policies.
Growing Green Industry Projects
In March this year, a photovoltaic power plant with an installed capacity of 135 megawatts began construction near the Rainbow Mining Company mine in South Africa, and is expected to be completed by the end of this year.
The clean electricity generated by the field will be mainly used for mining and refining minerals such as lithium, cobalt, nickel and platinum group metals, which in turn will be mainly used to manufacture batteries, electric vehicles, wind turbines and hydrogen production systems.
Roger Baxter, CEO of the South African Mining Commission, said that more and more mines are choosing to support construction related to clean energy, and this traditional industry is moving towards the greening of the entire industrial chain.
The use of renewable energy to promote the green transformation of mining not only saves costs, but also makes it easier for mineral products to gain an export advantage.
In May 2023, the first electric buses were commissioned in Lagos, Nigeria ’ s largest city.
The Nigerian government plans to deploy a fleet of 100 electric buses to drive the green transformation of the transport sector.
Nigerian car manufacturing companies will soon launch customized electric vehicles that are more suitable for the African environment, and start-up “Max ” will also launch local brand electric motorcycles.
Saliu, director general of the National Climate Change Commission of Nigeria, said that Nigeria is committed to comprehensively promoting industrial greening, of which electric vehicle manufacturing is the forefront of driving the green development of the transportation industry.
Amal Lee, a climate and diversity consultant at the British International Investment Corporation, said that Africa ’ s abundant solar energy resources can become a competitive green hydrogen production base and drive the green transformation of other industries.
According to the World Bank, the overall cost of driving green industrial growth in African countries is usually no higher than the traditional growth path.
A report released earlier by the United Nations Economic Commission for Africa stressed that promoting industrial greening is an important way out for Africa's future development and a prerequisite for promoting sustainable and inclusive development.
The report recommends that African countries develop support policies to advance the process of industrial greening, while taking a systematic approach to identifying key areas, focusing on energy extraction, manufacturing, transport and value chain upgrading of agricultural, forestry and aquatic resources.
Achieve economic and environmental benefits
The African Development Bank (AfDB) and the Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI) said in a report that most African governments actively support the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and nationally determined contributions under the Paris Agreement, and some countries have adopted green growth and climate-resilient economic strategies.
The growing political commitment of African countries to green industrial growth will help Africa advance the process of industrial greening.
Avasa Industrial Park is the first national industrial park in Ethiopia and is also known as the first zero-emission textile industrial park in Africa.
In the past eight years of operation, Awasa Industrial Park has learned China's green textile industry technology and experience, and 85% of industrial wastewater has been recycled.
At present, the "Avassa model" is being extended to the whole country.
Ethiopian Investment Commission Commissioner Lelis Neim said the Ethiopian government has invested more than 1.3 billion US dollars to build more than 10 similar industrial parks.
According to reports, Ethiopia's leather industry is also beginning to see results in green development.
The country's leather waste treatment has reached 90 percent through the popularization of environmental protection technology, reducing environmental pollution and reducing the import of materials needed for leather making.
Important progress has also been made in the Africa Green Investment Initiative adopted during the African Climate Summit in September 2023.
The initiative, which has allocated nearly $2.6 billion for green energy projects in eight regional countries, will add about 1.8 GW of clean energy to the African grid.
South Africa in January this year again revised the "comprehensive resources plan", is expected to 2030 new 29 gigawatts of power installed capacity, wind power and photovoltaic power generation installed capacity accounted for 70% of the total.
South Africa has also launched the Independent Generator Scheme, which encourages the private sector to invest in renewable energy projects and sell excess electricity to the national grid.
African Climate Action Platform CEO Jack Kimani believes that many African countries have committed to the development of green industry projects, and promoting the process of industrial greening is a "window of opportunity" for the continent.
Urgent need to expand green international cooperation
Zimbabwean President Mnangagwa said at the 56th meeting of finance ministers of the United Nations Economic Commission for Africa that African countries should actively promote investment in green industry, work hard to set green industry standards, promote technology transfer and encourage regional cooperation.
Farhana Paruk, senior researcher at the Gordon Institute of Business Sciences at the University of Pretoria in South Africa, analyzed that Africa ’ s industrial green transformation faces many challenges, including infrastructure, financing, technology research and development, and African countries need more strategic thinking and more effective policies to promote.
Under its Next Generation Africa Climate Business Plan, published in 2020, the World Bank has provided more than $30 billion in funding for hundreds of projects in Africa, aiming to help sub-Saharan African countries achieve low-carbon and climate-resilient development goals.
The Alliance plans to launch a 500 million U.S. dollar project early preparation and development fund, with the main goal of improving the financing of infrastructure projects in Africa and further promoting investment of 10 billion U.S. dollars in green infrastructure projects in the African region.
The Africa Investment Forum announced four renewable energy and sustainable development projects worth nearly $1.5 billion during its annual meeting in 2023.
The project involves green hydrogen production, hydropower, plastic recycling technology and other fields.
In February this year, the African Development Bank announced a US $188 million loan to help Morocco's green investment plan, which will mainly be used to provide clean drinking water and build renewable energy generation energy storage systems for towns around industrial and mining enterprises.
China actively supports African countries in achieving green industrial growth.
At present, China has implemented hundreds of clean energy and green development projects in Africa, and the cumulative installed capacity of photovoltaic power plants built by Chinese enterprises in cooperation with Africa exceeds 1.5 GW, which is in the forefront of international cooperation on non-green issues.
Wesley Douglas, director of the African Carbon Exchange, told this reporter that China leads the global renewable energy industry and services, and continuously reduces the cost of renewable energy equipment through industrial scale effects and technological innovation, which promotes the green industry in Africa.

Lack of muscle strength, poor balance, the biggest reason for old people to fall
If an elderly person falls, they suffer from bruises, bruises, fractures, and incapacity, and their quality of life declines. Falling hides all kinds of risks, but it may be too serious to be hospitalized for surgery.
Falling is the second leading cause of injury among the elderly. It has become an important health issue, especially in an aging society. Falling causes are very complicated.
Squats, archers, and lower extremities
Secondly, the ability to coordinate, the ability to balance is also one of the factors that the elderly fall, when the vision decline is abnormal, it will affect the coordination of the body feeling and vestibular function, some people will lose the sense of three-dimensional, it is difficult to assess their distance from the object.
Huang Shengyu stressed that when you are old, the ability to react will be slow, and in the face of sudden situations, it is too late to start the next movement of the body, plus the loss of muscle, even if you want to step out of the thigh to maintain balance, you feel powerless.
Exercise is a good way to reduce the risk of falling. It can practice squats, archery, step aerobic, and exercise outside of the lower limb muscles. It also helps train cardiopulmonary function.
The elderly are not flexible and prone to falling. If you have osteoporosis, the risk of fracture will be greatly increased. Common fractures are hip, lumbar and wrist. Hip fractures are difficult to tolerate, and it is most likely to bring serious complications. Daily exercise can delay physical deterioration.
Diseases and drugs can also cause falls.
In addition to normal aging of the body, blood pressure and blood sugar fluctuations will also cause dizziness, so that the gait is not coordinated. Huang Shangyu said that high blood pressure causes headaches and low blood sugar will cause dizziness; and people who have a history of migraine are also prone to fall at an older age, because pain affects the sensitivity of other senses.
In addition, stroke, Parkinson's disease will produce motor dysfunction, the body does not consciously shift the center of gravity, will repeatedly fall.
The elderly should pay attention to the safety of medication. Sleeping pills, blood pressure drugs, and antidepressants will cause decreased attention and muscle weakness. After taking the drug, they should rest or go to bed immediately, otherwise it is easy to increase the probability of falling.
Elderly people who take drugs for chronic diseases should ask a doctor to help evaluate the medication when they visit the clinic to avoid drug interactions.
Wake up, slow down.
It is easy to get up immediately when you wake up, it is easy to get dizzy, the most prone to fall accidents, to slow down, let the body temperature slowly rise, promote blood reflux.
The following are the reasons why you are prone to fall when you wake up, so be sure to remind your elders to pay attention:
1. Blood sugar fluctuation: lying in bed all night, suddenly sitting up, prone to postural low blood pressure.
Slow neural response: The brain nerve is not fully awake and has not regained all control of limb function.
3. Muscle stiffness: wrong sleeping posture, wake up joints or muscles stiffness, body card inflexibility.
4. The indoor light is dim: half asleep and half awake to get up to the toilet, the light is dim, and the movement is quickly tripped.

The battle for the right to speak in strategic areas!
In fact, as early as the 1950s, scientists have proposed AI, but after two waves of AI fever, it can not be successfully promoted.

As such, when countries are tens of billions, hundreds of billions or even trillions of dollars into the semiconductor industry, in order to achieve rapid performance, the future of global capital expenditure will be tilted to the related equipment and technology fields.
Faced with low global economic growth, high inflation, high interest rates and debt in the wake of the pandemic, coupled with aging populations and declining labor participation rates, the market expects that AI applications can have a positive impact in improving production efficiency and creating value, to offset the impact of rising geopolitical risks, de-globalization and fragmentation of global supply. China and the United States each struggle to spend money to support the development of science and technology industry, technology will be hemispherical development under the decoupling of technology, but if the technology is not compatible, it will greatly affect the efficiency.

Therefore, this century of Sino-American hegemony, both on the track of innovation and technology, neither has an absolute advantage, depending on which system, can provide the best solution for global governance reform and construction.

Untitled Week: When Kafka Meets AI
Post Date: June 02, 2024
June 3 marks the centenary of Franz Kafka ’ s death.
He carefully observes the individual ’ s sense of powerlessness in the face of enormous power, and paints a clear picture of the individual ’ s psychological contradictions and puzzles, which have been felt by the world for centuries.
At present, the world is buzzing with technology, and technology companies such as OpenAI are trying to portray the utopia of AI, but there are also pessimists who warn that AI will annihilate humanity.
If Kafka were to write a science fiction novel about AI, he probably wouldn ’ t tell an old story of “intelligent mutiny, ” and might just ask you to relive The Judgment.
Even if we can ’ t explain what “Kafkaesque ” means in a structured and informative way, we can always understand it.
And look at the opening of the trial: “Someone must have defamed Josef K. because he did nothing wrong and was arrested one morning. ” K. did not know why he was arrested, did not know what crime he had committed, and did not know what evidence the prosecution had in hand.
He lives in a peaceful society where the law is still in force.
Despite all the signs of a sloppy court system, he still believes in the system and believes that he can convince the judge to clear his innocence, so he becomes involved in an endless struggle with the bureaucracy and is finally executed by the executioner before his 31st birthday, “like a dog. ”
There are always different meanings to this story.
Of course, it is not necessary to say that it is an existentialist feeling, after all, that sense of powerlessness is what existentialism often says, but existence can never leave the historical context, in specific time and space, Kafka's reflection is more interesting.
Kafka was born in Prague in 1883 as a child of Austria-Hungary.
At this time, the bureaucracy of European countries such as France, Prussia, and Austria began to develop.
These countries began to establish administrative and legal systems in the mid-19th century to govern and maintain social order.
While the system can enable the government to provide welfare for the people, it has also begun to encroach on the private sphere in the name of governance. K. ’ s nightmares in The Judgment came to light in different ways after the 20th century.
The Austro-Hungarian secret police had been set up in the 19th century to spy on citizens, but it was not until the 20th century that the police state was flourished in communist countries such as Nazi Germany and the Soviet Union. Like K., European Jews were murdered without knowing why, and like K., the citizens of the Soviet Union and Eastern European communist countries were kept under constant surveillance, unaware that they were being arrested for saying something wrong one day.
Surveillance in a Democratic State
The face of surveillance is always changing, with the development of science and technology, non-democratic countries naturally have more weapons to monitor their citizens; and the monitoring of democratic countries has become "amiable": because many people will voluntarily contribute personal data to science and technology companies for convenience, science and technology companies can collect a large amount of data, snoop on user behavior, and even change user behavior patterns. (See also Surveillance Capitalism.)
The similarity between today ’ s automation technology and the vast system that holds the power of life and death, has long been pointed out by Stephen Cave of the University of Cambridge in the United Kingdom.
Writing in the Guardian in 2019, he said that K. in the Trial did not know why he was arrested, no one was responsible for his arrest decision, and no one explained how the system worked. The same is true of today ’ s computer systems powered by AI and data, which are “automatically ” determined. Business services themselves.
He said AI must be democratized to avoid Kafkaesque nightmares.
This warning about technology has been issued by many people.
But as generative AI such as ChatGPT attracts global attention, whether smart AI will “smart mutiny ” or even murder has become a trendy topic.
In May last year, Geoffrey Hinton, the godfather of AI, warned of the risk of human extinction, which caused a lot of discussion, but also attracted criticism from a group of experts who have always focused on AI ethics.
Meredith Whittaker, chairman of Signal, an encrypted communications software, pointed out at the time that the threat of AI to humans is real, but not in the so-called “existential threat ”, but in the specific problems of automating discrimination, building tools for social control, and conducting mass surveillance.
Data and technology in the hands of large enterprises, is the real problem.
Kafka brings inspiration to privacy law
Daniel J. Solove, a professor of law at George Washington University, and Woodrow Hartzog, a professor of law at Boston University, published a paper in the Boston Law Review this year titled Kafka In The Age Of AI And The Ftility Of Privacy As Control. FUKA captures an individual ’ s sense of powerlessness in the digital age, but it also brings inspiration to privacy law.
In response to the large-scale collection of user data by enterprises in the digital era, legislation has been tightened everywhere to protect privacy.
The current privacy law is based on the Individual Control Model, which emphasizes the right of individuals to control data. For example, when we accept the services of a company, we often press the "consent" button on the terms of data collection and other terms (although we often do not look carefully).
However, some scholars believe that this model is not enough, advocating the social structure model (social structure model), arguing that the protection of privacy is not out of pure personal interests, but because it can promote social values such as democracy, freedom, creativity, health and so on.
Simply put, the primary goal of privacy law should not be to allow individuals to control their own data, but to ensure that social structures can control the collection, use and disclosure of personal data, which is also the article ’ s claim.
What does Kafka ’ s novels and fables have to do with this legal discussion?
Because the human weaknesses revealed in Kafka ’ s story show why the emphasis on individual rights alone is not enough.
In Kafka ’ s world, it is easy for the protagonist to yield to authority, even if he is not forced, even if he knows he will be hurt.
For example, in The Trial, although there are countless signs that the court system is illegal, such as the rudimentary court procedures and seemingly legal books that turned out to be pornographic, the entire system is unprofessional and sloppy, but K.
Still convinced of the court system and willing to yield to its authority.
Policy making must take human nature into account
Why do you know that the victim is still willing to give in?
Kafka did not offer an explanation, but human psychology often has a variety of incomprehensible emotional and irrational components.
We can think further, if this is the case with human psychology, how should we deal with ourselves? "Kafka in the AI era" is a demonstration of how to apply Kafka to our time.
The article said that when thinking about the real privacy policy, we should also take into account the irrational side of human nature.
Even if the law gives individuals rights, in reality, people often do not try to exercise the right of choice, but simply follow the wishes of science and technology companies, make harmful privacy decisions, and easily hand over data control.
When people discover that data has been abused, they often blame themselves, just like the protagonist of Kafka ’ s story, and blame themselves for their misfortune.
"Kafka in the Age of AI" concludes with Kafka's short story A Little Fable.
In this story, a mouse keeps moving from room to room, and finally the cat appears, dropping the sentence "You just need to change direction" and eating it.
The article said that the mouse did not change direction, the result is self-destruction, in the digital era to effectively protect personal privacy also requires policymakers to change the direction of legislation to save themselves.
Kafka was only 40 years old when he died, forever young and always so close to our world; his eyes seemed to be still observing our world with curiosity.
He probably did not think that his influence was so far-reaching, if he knew, he might be afraid of it.
But in any case, in these confusing times, it may be worth reading Kafka carefully, or there will be unexpected gains.
Postscript
The Forever KOL
If it wasn ’ t for seeing the counter for Kafka ’ s centenary in May at the Sannisetsu Bookstore in Tokyo ’ s Shinbo-cho, you might have missed this great event in the cultural and youth world.
In addition to the new Kafka novels and diaries published this year, there are also various Kafka studies, biographies, and novels based on Kafka.
Kafka ’ s relationship with his fiancée and family has long been thoroughly studied, which is a bit scary to think about. After all, Kafka asked his friends to burn all the manuscripts before he died, who expected that every word he wrote would be carefully studied by strangers for hundreds of years?
Read Kafka to learn about Generation Z
French "Le Monde" recently launched the Kafka project, it is interesting to read.
There have probably been too many serious philosophical discussions about Kafka, but French writer Sarah Chiche has described Kafka as a perpetual KOL (influencer perpétuel) that makes people smile.
She noted that Kafka has become an icon of Generation Z (12 to 25 years old) in the online world.
This is because Kafka ’ s novels, letters, and diaries depict the inner world deeply, and make young people feel empathy, such as loneliness, the feeling of being constantly monitored, the fear of not being understood, the love and hate of their parents, and the fear of struggling to get to bed every morning.
She said that to understand young people, it is best to read Kafka.
Kafka allows us to read both the psychology of young people and the horrors of monitoring society.
However, the most direct resonance may be the various strange thoughts in our heads.
When you drag your tired body to bed on Sunday night, you may have a moment of thought, hoping that you are the protagonist of "Transfiguration", when you wake up to find that you have become a giant beetle, and that it is too good to go to work.

Modi ’ s Re-election as Prime Minister Analyzes India ’ s Future Relations with the Global South and Russia
NEW DELHI (AFP) - Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi has won a third term and how he will build on his 10-year diplomatic ambitions, AFP reports.
● Global South
The global South, also known as the South or the South, roughly refers to developing countries.
Modi this week called India a “strong and important voice of the Global South, ” and last year India hosted two“ Voice of the Global South ” summits seeking to strengthen India ’ s role as a voice for countries in Asia, Africa and South America.
With the African Union becoming a permanent member of the G20 under Modi ’ s watch, India believes that developing countries must have a greater say in global decision-making.
India is also a founding member of the Emerging Economies Group (BRICS).
● Russia
Relations between New Delhi and Moscow date back to the Cold War, and Russia remains India ’ s largest arms supplier.
India did not explicitly condemn Russia ’ s invasion of Ukraine, abstained from the UN resolution condemning Russia and snapped up supplies of cheap Russian crude.
Modi congratulated Russian President Vladimir Putin on his re-election in March and said he looked forward to developing a “special ” relationship between the two countries.
● Pakistan
After the Modi government accused Islamabad authorities of cross-border terrorism, it refused to intervene with arch-rival Pakistan.
Since the partition of India and Pakistan in 1947, the two countries have fought three major wars and many smaller conflicts.
Control of the disputed region of Kashmir has been at the heart of tensions between the two countries.
In 2015, Modi unexpectedly visited the Pakistani city of Lahore, but relations between the two countries deteriorated sharply in 2019.
Modi congratulated Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on his return to the post in March, a rare expression of goodwill between the nuclear-armed neighbors.

In accordance with the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea and the Convention on Biological Diversity, in order to strengthen the protection of marine life, it is stipulated that the IOC may designate marine sanctuaries as marine protected areas if special protection of marine ecosystems is necessary and has not been designated as marine protected areas by other competent authorities.

According to the provisions of the preliminary examination, the resolution of the deliberation committee is attended by a majority of the members, and more than 2 / 3 of the members present agree.
Compensation shall be made for damage caused by the designation of the core area of the marine sanctuary area, which results in special sacrifices to the existing users of the area.
After the Council has designated the marine sanctuary, it shall consult with the relevant authorities to draw up a conservation plan for the marine sanctuary, and hold a public exhibition and public hearing for 30 days.
In order to protect marine life in the core area of the marine sanctuary from arbitrary human influence or interference, the preliminary trial provisions also stipulate that in addition to military purposes, sea patrol, crime detection, marine rescue, scientific research and other activities, anyone and land transport vehicles are prohibited from entering the core area of the marine sanctuary. New technology makes "ditch oil" fly into the sky
June 9, 2024 08: 39 | Source: Economic Daily
Small number
Original title: New technology makes "ditch oil" fly into the sky
Recently, China Commercial Aviation Corporation's ARJ21 regional aircraft and C919 large passenger aircraft successfully completed the first domestic commercial aircraft refueling biological aviation coal flight test mission, demonstrating China's leading position in the field of green aviation.
The bio-aviation fuel used in the test flight is refined from food waste oil, also known as "gutter oil", using the bio-aviation coal production technology independently developed by Sinopec, and blending with ordinary aviation fuel in a proportion of 40%.
It can be said that this test flight successfully made the domestic large aircraft drink "gutter oil", not only verified the compatibility and safety of domestic bioaviation fuel and domestic commercial aircraft, but also laid a foundation for the commercialization of domestic bioaviation fuel in the future.
Why should we let domestic large aircraft drink "ditch oil"?
Biofuel is a type of SAF (Sustainable Aviation Fuel), and the development of SAF to promote a green and low-carbon transition has become a new track for competition in the global aviation industry.
Compared with traditional coal, the whole life cycle of biological coal can reduce carbon emissions by more than 50%.
The International Air Transport Association (IATA) has proposed the goal of achieving net zero carbon emissions by 2050, and biological aviation coal is an important direction.
According to IATA, from 2008 to the end of 2023, more than 45 airlines and 370,000 flights around the world have used biofuel. In 2023, the European Parliament approved RefuelEU aviation regulations, requiring at least 2% of the fuel used in EU airports to be “green fuel ” by 2025, and this will increase to 70% by 2050.
This will greatly increase the operating cost of China's civil aviation industry, and it will become an inevitable choice to "participate in" biological aviation coal.
Participating in the bio coal track, we have a good foundation.
Looking at the technical foundation, China is the first country in Asia and the fourth in the world to have independent research and development of bio-aviation fuel technology.
Sinopec officially launched the research and development of biological aviation coal in 2009, successfully flew in 2013, obtained the first production license of biological aviation coal in China in 2014, and completed the first passenger commercial flight in 2015.
Today, China's first bio-aviation fuel unit with an annual output of 100,000 tons has been successfully scaled up in Zhenhai Refinery.
Looking at the policy basis, "bioeconomy" has been written into the "14th Five-Year Plan". The "14th Five-Year Plan" issued by the Civil Aviation Administration of China clearly puts forward the goal of bioaviation fuel consumption of more than 20,000 tons by 2025, and plans to consume 50,000 tons of bioaviation fuel during the "14th Five-Year Plan" period.
Looking at the raw material base, the supply of "gutter oil" is sufficient, and the use of "gutter oil" as a biofuel is more environmentally friendly compared with other biofuel raw materials.
In China, a city with a population of 10 million people, the actual amount of waste oil recovered from meals is about 10,000 tons per month, and the annual amount of recycling is about 100,000 tons.
From the global raw materials of biodiesel, soybean oil accounts for about 67%, followed by corn oil and rapeseed oil.
The use of oil for human consumption as fuel is neither environmentally friendly nor economical, and affects global food security.
China's biodiesel raw materials are mainly waste cooking oil, which belongs to advanced biofuels.
The utility model not only reduces the risk of the gutter oil returning to the dining table, but also realizes the resource utilization of waste.
However, there are still many obstacles to let civil aviation planes drink "gutter oil", the main problem is that the price is expensive and the drinking is not enough.
The price is high because of the high cost: from gutter oil to bio-aviation fuel, the whole process cost from recycling to processing is about 3 times that of ordinary aviation fuel.
To make the healthy development of this industry, we need a two-pronged approach: on the one hand, we will increase technological research and development efforts to encourage production enterprises to achieve technological breakthroughs and reduce production costs as soon as possible; on the other hand, we will increase policy support, improve the waste oil recovery system, and establish the relevant standards and certification system for biological aviation coal to promote its commercialization.
Looking forward to the future, let civil aviation aircraft drink well "gutter oil", will become a promising green industry.
(Author: She Huimin)

Speech cloning raises concerns, OpenAI again explains its text-to-speech tool
2024 / 6 / 10 9: 57: 21 Source: IT House Author: Yuanyang Editor: Yuanyang
OpenAI explained its text-to-speech tool for the second time in a few months, and again stressed that the tool is not currently widely available and may not be available in the future.
“Whether or not we end up deploying this technology at scale, it ’ s important for people around the world to understand where it ’ s going, ” OpenAI said in a statement on its website Friday.“ That ’ s why we want to explain how the model works, how we use it for research and education, and how we implement security measures around the technology. ”
At the end of last year, OpenAI shared its “voice engine ” with a small number of external users.
The engine uses text input and a 15-second clip of human voices to “generate a natural sounding human voice that is very similar to the original speaker. ”
The tool could create fake, multilingual human voices, and the company said at the time that it had chosen to preview the technology rather than launch it at scale to “enhance social resilience ” to the threat posed by“ increasingly realistic artificial intelligence-generated models. ”
As part of these efforts, OpenAI says it is actively phasing out ways to use voice recognition for bank account verification, exploring policies to protect individual voices for use in AI, educating the public about the risks of AI, and accelerating the development of technologies to track audiovisual content so users can identify whether they are interacting with real people or synthetic content.
However, despite these efforts, concerns about the technology remain.
Bruce Reed, the head of artificial intelligence for US President Joe Biden, has said that voice cloning is one of the reasons he can't sleep at night.
The Federal Trade Commission said in March that scammers were using AI technology to increase the credibility of their fraud, using voice cloning tools that make it harder for people to distinguish between AI-generated voices and human voices.
“We continue to engage with U.S. and international partners from government, media, entertainment, education, civil society, and more to ensure we incorporate their feedback in the build process, ” the company also noted, once the“ Voice Engine ” is equipped with its latest model, GPT-4o, it will also bring new threats.
The company says it is actively “conducting ‘ red team testing ’ on GPT-4o to identify and address known and unknown risks from areas such as social psychology, bias and fairness, and misinformation. ”

Police clash in Argentina to protest president ’ s plan for economic reform (AFP)
Argentina ’ s far-right President Javier Milei ’ s controversial economic-saving reforms, including expanding presidential powers and cutting labor protections, were approved by a vote in the Senate on Wednesday.
Demonstrations broke out in the capital, Buenos Aires, with thousands of demonstrators throwing petrol bombs and burning cars outside the parliament. During the demonstration, demonstrators tried to enter the parliament through the fence and threw stones at the police.
Riot police used pepper spray and then fired tear gas and water cannons to disperse.
Dozens of demonstrators and opposition lawmakers were injured in the clashes, while officials said at least 20 other police officers were injured.
Police said they arrested 15 people.
In a statement, President Milai ’ s office thanked the security forces for suppressing “terrorists ” who attempted to stage a coup, stressing the need to make Argentina the freest country in the world.
The reform bill proposed by Miley aims to save the Argentine economy by declaring a one-year economic emergency, allowing Miley to abolish some federal agencies, and privatizing some state-owned enterprises, as well as cutting pensions and labor rights.
Some opposition lawmakers criticized the bill as severely exploiting workers' rights, as if it were "going back to the last century".
Some protesters also criticized the measures as going back 100 years in Argentina.
The bill will be debated in the Senate on a case-by-case basis, and is expected to be voted on again on Thursday, before being passed and sent back to the House of Representatives for final consideration. (AFP / BBC)

Argentina considers austerity reforms, protests outside Congress like a battlefield
(Ming Pao News) Argentina ’ s Senate on Wednesday (12) initially approved the controversial austerity economic reform plan proposed by far-right President Milai, during which opponents violently demonstrated outside the country ’ s parliament, throwing gasoline bombs and burning cars, and police used rubber bullets, tear gas and water cannons to disperse.
The office of the president of Argentina condemned the "attempted coup by a terrorist organization".
Miley ’ s proposed economic reform package included declaring a one-year state of economic emergency to allow him as president to dissolve some federal agencies and privatize about a dozen public companies, including Aerolíneas Argentinas.
Other measures in the reform package include raising the threshold for receiving minimum retirement subsidies and weakening labor protection.
The bill originally received a vote of 36: 36 in the Senate, and finally on Wednesday night, Vice President and Senate President Vera Ruhr cast a vote in favor, breaking the deadlock and being passed by the whole. The Senate will then consider the provisions of the bill on a case-by-case basis and then submit it to the House of Representatives for final vote.
Congressman injured in hospital
Some protesters criticized the bill as including measures that hurt labor rights and set Argentina back 100 years.
The health department said seven protesters were hospitalized in pepper spray, including five lawmakers, and dozens of injured people were treated at the scene.
Security sources said at least 20 police officers were injured and 15 others were arrested.
Argentina is facing economic problems such as ultra-high inflation of 300%, and Miley has promoted radical “shock therapy ” since he took office in December, including cutting half of cabinet posts and 50,000 public jobs by executive order.
